local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMainPartASection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldMainPartA @
		Comment = SRPG 파트 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_1'

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'super_guardian_wars'

	self.sgw_game = nil

	self.dialog_ui = nil
	self.dialog_object = nil

	self.is_dialog_skip = false

	self.is_directing_acting = false

	self.acting = false

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		battle_1 = 1,
		battle_2 = 2
	}

	-- 다이얼로그 타이핑 스피드
	self.dialog_typing_speed = 0.05

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsDialog'), function(p)
		self.dialog_object = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		self.dialog_object:SetActive(false)
		self.dialog_ui = self.dialog_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsDialog))
	end))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_applebomb_fire')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_bombarrow_explosion')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_game_start, self))
end

function local_class:first_game_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:game_setting()
	self:game_start()
end

function local_class:game_setting()
	-- 미니게임 준비
	-- 미니 게임이 로드 될 때 까지 기다림.
	self.sgw_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate('SuperGuardianWars')
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource('SuperGuardianWars', 'demon_world', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local custom_atlas

	coroutine.yield(res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'srw_ui_custom'), function(prefab)
		custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))

	-- 에임 custom sprite 세팅
	local character_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(vector(-7.1, 0.6, 6.5))
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_object.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	local custom_sprite = character_object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(1.8, 1.8)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'hh_b.png'
	custom_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 4
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	res_holder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self.acting = true

	self.sgw_game:load_characters('one')
	self.sgw_game:load_star_piece('star_piece')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local invader_boss_1 = self.sgw_game:get_character_from_object_name('invader_3')

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	-- 타겟 사정거리 진입!

	self:dialogue_func('sgw_invader_fighter', 'portrait/invader_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_1')

	-- 오염 종족들의 실드는 곧 무너진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_srpg_invader_hit_02')
	self.sgw_game:show_active_frame_from_object_name('invader_3')
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_invader_leader', 'portrait/invader_leader_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_2')

	-- 이제 본성의 엔진을 파괴하면…..응?
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_invader_leader', 'portrait/invader_leader_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_3')
	self.sgw_game:dispose_active_frame()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-2, 0, 8), 4.5, 0.5)

	self.sgw_game:load_characters('two', 0.1, '01_character_warp_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.12)
	self.sgw_game:load_characters('three', 0.1, '01_character_warp_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.12)
	self.sgw_game:load_characters('four', 0.1, '01_character_warp_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- Mk-7, Mk-11, Mk-19 작전지에 돌입합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	self.sgw_game:show_active_frame_from_object_name('sweeper_1')
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_sweeper', 'portrait/sweeper_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_4')

	-- 망치질로 단련된 근력, 확실히 보여드리죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	self.sgw_game:show_active_frame_from_object_name('builder_1')
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_builder', 'portrait/builder_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_5')

	-- 청소 유닛까지 전투에 동원시켜야 하는 마스터의 전술적 안목에 경탄할 따름입니다.
	self.sgw_game:show_active_frame_from_object_name('sweeper_2')
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_sweeper', 'portrait/sweeper_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_6')
	self.sgw_game:dispose_active_frame()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-7.1, 0, 6), 4.5, 0.5)

	-- ..들었어요, 기사님?
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_mad', 'demonworld_part1_s3_7')

	-- 반성은 나중에 하시는 걸로 하고, 일단은 이 상황을 타개하는 것이 먼저죠.
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_8')

	-- 3 기의 안드로이드의 행동을 지시해서 적의 전투기를 요격해주세요.
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_9')

	-- 맵병기 같은 편한 기술은 없으니까 하나하나, 확실히 숨통을 끊어버리자구요.
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_idle', 'demonworld_part1_s3_10')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-2, 0, 8), 4.5, 0.5, false)



	--[[ 유닛 공격 연출 예시
	self.sgw_game:attack_character_target_tile(114, 107, 7)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	]]


	--[[ 유닛 방어 연출 예시
	self.sgw_game:block_character_target_tile(114)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	]]


	--[[ 유닛 회복 연출 예시
	self.sgw_game:heal_character_target_tile(80, 114, 101)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	]]

	self.acting = false

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle_1

	self.sgw_game:set_battle_end_type('all_kill')

	-- 게임 시작
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame('SuperGuardianWars')
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'directing_move' then
		self.is_directing_acting = false
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'directing_skill' then
		self.is_directing_acting = false
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'directing_heal' then
		self.is_directing_acting = false
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'directing_block' then
		self.is_directing_acting = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and not self.is_dialog_skip then
		if self.dialog_ui ~= nil and self.dialog_ui.IsTyping then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_click_party_preset_01')
			self.dialog_ui:SkipTyping()
			return true
		end
		self.is_dialog_skip = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 게임 끝날 때 받아오는 이벤트
function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Success == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_over, self))
	elseif e.Name == self.game_name and self.acting == false then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_end, self))
		elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_end, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:game_over()
	self.acting = true

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none
	self.sgw_game:set_control_block(true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-7.1, 0, 6), 4.5, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_idle', 'sgw_dialogue_heavenhold_hit')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(3, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	self.sgw_game:reset_game_data()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.sgw_game:load_characters('five', 0.1, '01_character_warp_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(2, 0, 3), 4.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.sgw_game:load_characters('six', 0.1, '01_character_warp_01')

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_10', 64, 8)

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_9', 80, 8)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.sgw_game:change_tint_color_target_character('invader_9', 0.3, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_8', 78, 8)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.sgw_game:change_tint_color_target_character('invader_8', 0.3, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-12, 0, 10), 4.5, 0.5)

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_6', 168, 8)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.sgw_game:change_tint_color_target_character('invader_6', 0.3, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_7', 170, 8)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.sgw_game:change_tint_color_target_character('invader_7', 0.3, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.sgw_game:move_character_target_tile('invader_5', 184, 8)
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.sgw_game:camera_move_end_target_tile(vector(-8, 0, 7), 4.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local invader_5 = self.sgw_game:get_character_from_object_name('invader_5')
	self.is_directing_acting = true
	self.sgw_game:aim_to_target_pos(invader_5:get_position(), vector(-7.1, 0.5, 6), function()
		self.is_directing_acting = false
	end)
	while self.is_directing_acting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	self.sgw_game:aim_dispose()


	--region 임시 부유성 피격 연출
	-- BattleUI 로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local battle_ui_object
	local battle_ui

	local sgw_constants_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsConstantsManager')
	local skill_id = 15
	local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(skill_id)

	local get_skill_voice_name = function(skill_data)
		local is_language_base = skill_data.voice_sfx.is_language_base

		if is_language_base then
			local current_voice_language = music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage
			return skill_data.voice_sfx[current_voice_language]
		end

		return skill_data.voice_sfx['ko']
	end

	coroutine.yield(res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI'), function(p)
		battle_ui_object = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		battle_ui_object:SetActive(false)

		battle_ui = battle_ui_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI))
	end))

	-- AnimationEvent를 처리하는 함수
	local event_listener = {}
	event_listener.on_event = function(self, e)
		if e.EventName == 'waiting' then
			battle_ui.dialog:SetNameLabel(game_string:GetString('sgw_invader_leader'))
			battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait('portrait/invader_leader_idle')
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString(''))
		elseif e.EventName == 'attack_dialog' then
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString('sgw_dialogue_invader_fighter_leader_skill_2'))
			local dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue('sgw_dialogue_invader_fighter_leader_skill_2')
			-- FIXME : 기본 보이스 처리하던 방식 남겨둠, 추후 다이얼로그 방식으로 일원화 하는게 좋을 듯..
			if dialogue_holder == nil then
				local skill_voice_name = get_skill_voice_name(skill_data)
				if skill_voice_name then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(skill_voice_name)
				end
			end
		elseif e.EventName == 'attack' then
			battle_ui.enemyInfo:DecreaseEn(0)
		elseif e.EventName == 'hit' then
			battle_ui.myInfo:DecreaseHp(516)
		elseif e.EventName == 'hit_dialog' then
			battle_ui.dialog:SetNameLabel(game_string:GetString('sgw_maiden'))
			battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait('portrait/maiden_mad')
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString('sgw_dialogue_heavenhold_hit'))
			music_player:PlayDialogue('sgw_dialogue_heavenhold_hit')
		elseif e.EventName == 'destroy' then
			battle_ui.dialog:SetNoiseActive(true)
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString('sgw_dialogue_heavenhold_hit'))
		end
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_event')

	-- SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI를 활성화
	battle_ui_object:SetActive(true)

	-- HP/En Bar UI 초기 세팅
	battle_ui.myInfo:InitHpBar(2000, 2000, 300, 300)
	battle_ui.enemyInfo:InitHpBar(300, 300, 30, 30)

	-- 전투 연출 로드
	local attack_theatre = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, skill_data.bundle_name, skill_data.asset_name)
	attack_theatre.transform.position = vector(500, 0, 500)

	local skill_sfx_name = skill_data.sfx
	if skill_sfx_name then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(skill_sfx_name)
	end

	local scene_hit = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(attack_theatre.transform, 'scene_hit')
	local hit_defender_sprite = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(scene_hit.transform, 'battle_character'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsBattleCharacter))
	hit_defender_sprite:SetSprite(6)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	-- 스킬 애니메이션이 끝날 때 까지 대기
	local animator = attack_theatre.transform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	while animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 1 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	-- 애니메이션이 모두 끝나면, 오브젝트를 파괴함
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_theatre)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(battle_ui_object)

	res_holder:Dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_event')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	--endregion


	self.sgw_game:change_tint_color_target_character('invader_5', 0.3, 0.075)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 당했군요… 정면의 적은 미끼…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_mad', 'demonworld_part1_s3_15')

	-- 이대로는…
	self:dialogue_func('sgw_maiden', 'portrait/maiden_mad', 'demonworld_part1_s3_16')

	-- 나 보고 싶었어?

				local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-100, 100)

				rand_z = rand_z / 100
				if i % 3 == 1 then

				else
					temp_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new'):Instantiate(vector(-7.1 + rand_x, 0, 7 + rand_z))

	})

			local temp_effect = bomb_effect_table[i]

			-- 이펙트 수명이 다 될 때 까지 대기

function local_class:dialogue_func(name, port, string_key, data)
	local dialog_name = game_string:GetString(name)
	local dialog_string = game_string:GetString(string_key)
	local life_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'life_time', 4)
	local type_speed = self.dialog_typing_speed
	local dialogue_voice_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(string_key)

	self.dialog_ui:SetNameLabel(dialog_name)
	self.dialog_ui:SetPortrait(port)
	self.dialog_ui:SetDialogLabelTyping(dialog_string, type_speed)
	self.dialog_ui:SetNoiseActive(false)
	self.dialog_object:SetActive(true)

	self.is_dialog_skip = false

	local dialog_string_len = string.len(dialog_string)
	local type_duration = dialog_string_len * type_speed
	local wait_for_sec = function(duration, voice_holder)
		local time_passed = 0
		local voice_playing = false
		if voice_holder then
			voice_playing = voice_holder.IsUsing
		end

		while not self.is_dialog_skip and (time_passed < duration or voice_playing) do
			coroutine.yield()

			if voice_playing then
				voice_playing = voice_holder.IsUsing
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(type_duration + life_time, dialogue_voice_holder)

	if dialogue_voice_holder then
		dialogue_voice_holder:Stop()
	end
	self.dialog_object:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil

	self.sgw_game = nil

	self.dialog_ui = nil
	self.dialog_object = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

return local_class

-- 캐릭터가 벽을 붙잡고 매달려서 흔들리는 연출
function local_class:catch_wall(fo, direction, duration, rotate)
	character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	character_util.set_direction(fo, direction)

	local z = fo.Position.z
	local offset_z = 0.1
	local angle = -75
	local angle_offset = 7.5
	local speed = 4
	local time_passed = 0

	local rotation = lua_helper.get_or_default(rotate, angle)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * speed * time_passed)

		character_util.spine_rotate(fo, rotation + (sin_val * angle_offset), 0)
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Position, z + (sin_val * offset_z))

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:tint_loop_func()
	local bg_table = { }
	local bg_renderer_table = { }

	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/bg_front'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/hologram'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/hologram/hologram (1)'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/hologram/hologram (2)'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/hologram/hologram (3)'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/bg_back'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/bg_front (2)'))
	table.insert(bg_table, self.bg_order_room.transform:Find('bg_bridge/platform'))

	for i = 1, 9 do
		table.insert(bg_renderer_table, bg_table[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer)))
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 2.75 do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 2.75))
		for i = 1, 9 do
			bg_renderer_table[i].color = unity_color{ 1, 1 - (progress * 0.7), 1 - (progress * 0.7), 1 }
		end
		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 1 do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 1.5))
		for i = 1, 9 do
			bg_renderer_table[i].color = unity_color{ 1, 0.3 + (progress * 0.7), 0.3 + (progress * 0.7), 1 }
		end
		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 2 do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 2))
		for i = 1, 9 do
			bg_renderer_table[i].color = unity_color{ 1 - (progress * 0.4), 1 - (progress * 0.6), 1 - (progress * 0.2), 1 }
		end
		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	bg_table = nil
	bg_renderer_table = nil
end

function local_class:bg_rotation()
	local time_passed = 0
	local worker_roll = false
	character_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right')
	character_util.move_to(self.lorain, self.lorain.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0), 1, nil)
	character_util.move_to(self.workers[3], self.workers[3].Position + vector(3.1, -1.8, 0), 1, nil)
	while time_passed < 3 do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 3))

		self.bg_order_room.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -(progress * 5))

		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	wait_for_sec(2)
	while self.room_scene_end == false do
		worker_roll = false
		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 4 do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 4))

			self.bg_order_room.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -5 + (progress * 10))

			if self.room_scene_end == true then
				break
			end
			if progress > 0.5 and worker_roll == false and self.lorain_cliff_stop == false then
				worker_roll = true
				character_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'left')
				character_util.set_direction(self.workers[3], 'left')
				character_util.move_to(self.workers[3], self.workers[3].Position + vector(-3, 1.8, 0), 1, nil)
				character_util.move_to(self.lorain, self.lorain.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, 0), 2, nil)
			end
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 0.5 do
			if self.room_scene_end == true then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		worker_roll = false
		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 4 do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, 4))

			self.bg_order_room.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 5 - (progress * 10))

			if self.room_scene_end == true then
				break
			end
			if progress > 0.5 and worker_roll == false and self.lorain_cliff_stop == false then
				worker_roll = true
				character_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right')
				character_util.set_direction(self.workers[3], 'right')
				character_util.move_to(self.workers[3], self.workers[3].Position + vector(3, -1.8, 0), 1, nil)
				character_util.move_to(self.lorain, self.lorain.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0), 2, nil)
			end
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 0.5 do
			if self.room_scene_end == true then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end
end

-- 카메라 셰이크
function local_class:order_room_shake(magnitude, duration)
	local start_pos = self.bg_order_room.transform.localPosition

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		self.bg_order_room.transform.localPosition = start_pos + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		if self.room_scene_end == true then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.bg_order_room.transform.localPosition = start_pos
end

	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.current_progress > self.progress_state.idle and
				self.current_progress < self.progress_state.defeat_android and
				e.Zone.Name == self.block_android_event_zone_name then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_android_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.fight_with_android and
				e.Zone.Name == self.jail_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.fight_with_android

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fight_with_android_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.remove_tint and
				e.Zone.Name == self.jail_out_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.get_out_police

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.jail_out_event, self)
		end
	end

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_investigator_event, self)

-- 다일로그와 말풍선 같이 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:dialogue_with_speech_balloon()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	self.is_streaming = true

	self:talk(self.main_script..0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.talk, self, self.main_script..1, true, false))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fake_speech_bubble, self, self.main_script..3))

	while self.is_dialogue_on do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.talk, self, self.main_script..2, true))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fake_speech_bubble, self, self.main_script..4))

	while self.is_dialogue_on do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_streaming = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

-- 말풍선 구현
function local_class:fake_speech_bubble(str)
	local speech_bubble_obj = self.news_theatre.transform:Find('speech_bubble_new').gameObject
	speech_bubble_obj:SetActive(true)

	local speech_bubble_text_obj = self.news_theatre.transform:Find(
			'speech_bubble_new/anchor/balloonRoot/text').gameObject
	local speech_bubble_text = speech_bubble_text_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))

	local dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogueLowerPriority(str)

	local cur_str = game_string:GetString(str)
	local str_length = string.len(cur_str)

	local main_language = game_string.MainLanguage

	local timer = 0.04
	local type_duration = 0.04
	local index = 0

	while self.is_dialogue_on do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= type_duration and index <= str_length then
			timer = 0

			speech_bubble_text.text = string.sub(cur_str, 0, index)

			if main_language == 'enUS' or index == str_length - 1 then
				index = index + 1
			else
				index = index + 3
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if dialogue_holder ~= nil then
		dialogue_holder:Stop()
		dialogue_holder = nil
	end

	speech_bubble_text.text = ''
	speech_bubble_obj:SetActive(false)
end

-- 대사 출력
function local_class:talk(key, skip, deactivate_dialogue)
	skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true)
	deactivate_dialogue = lua_helper.get_or_default(deactivate_dialogue, true)

	self.is_dialogue_on = true

	self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local routines = { self.dialogue:Show('nil', key, skip) }

	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 해당 효과음은 생략한다.
	if not CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_dialogue_sound, self))
	end

	wait_all(routines)

	self.is_dialogue_on = false

	if deactivate_dialogue then
		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

-- 다일로그 소리 출력
function local_class:play_dialogue_sound()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local dialogue_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while self.is_streaming and self.dialogue.IsTalking do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dialogue_sfx:Stop()
end

-- 경찰과 시민 루프 이벤트
function local_class:police_civilian_loop_event()
	local police = self.event_police_list[6]

	local civilian_1 = self.event_civilian_list[3]
	local civilian_2 = self.event_civilian_list[4]

	local timer = 0
	local event_duration = 2
	local phase = 0
	local phase_end = 4

	while self.current_progress < self.progress_state.move_to_jail do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= event_duration then
			timer = 0

			phase = phase + 1

			if phase == 1 then
				character_util.set_direction(civilian_1, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(civilian_1, { name = 'release' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'attack' })

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_2, { name = 'cast' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'attack' })
			elseif phase == 2 then
				character_util.set_anim(civilian_2, { name = 'jingak' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'attack' })

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_1, { name = 'cast' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'damaged' })
			elseif phase == 3 then
				character_util.set_direction(police, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(police, { name = 'seat', loop = true })

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_1, { name = 'gauntlet_idle' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'attack' })

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_2, { name = 'gauntlet_idle' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'attack' })
			elseif phase == phase_end then
				character_util.set_anim(police, { name = 'cast2' })
				character_util.set_emotion(police, { name = 'mad' })

				character_util.set_direction(civilian_1, 'right')
				character_util.jump(civilian_1, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.set_anim(civilian_1, { name = 'embarrassed' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'damaged' })

				character_util.jump(civilian_2, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.set_anim(civilian_2, { name = 'embarrassed' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'damaged' })
			else
				phase = 0

				character_util.set_direction(police, 'down')
				character_util.remove_anim(police, true)
				character_util.set_anim(police, { name = 'idle' })
				character_util.remove_emotion(police)

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_1, { name = 'cast' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_1, { name = 'tired' })

				character_util.set_anim(civilian_2, { name = 'cast' })
				character_util.set_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'tired' })
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(civilian_1, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(civilian_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(civilian_1)

	character_util.remove_anim(civilian_2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(civilian_2)

	character_util.set_direction(police, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(police, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(police)
	character_util.remove_emotion(police)
end

-- 스카우터 깜박이는 연출
function local_class:scouter_blink(item, target_color)
	local is_tint = false
	local time_passed = 0

	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor

	while self.is_scouter_blink do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / self.scouter_pulse_duration)

		if time_passed >= self.scouter_pulse_duration then
			time_passed = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false
			else
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_beep_02')

				is_tint = true
			end
		else
			if is_tint then
				item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(item_start_color, target_color, progress)
			else
				item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(target_color, item_start_color, progress)
			end
		end

		item_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 의자 미는 연출
function local_class:push_chair(pos)
	local chair = get_field_object(self.chair_name)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = 1

	local start_pos = chair.Position
	local end_pos = chair.Position + pos

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, chair)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'cast', upper = true })
	character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + pos,
			move_duration, nil, false, true)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_duration

		chair.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, normalized)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	chair.Position = end_pos

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader, true)
end

-- 사이렌 틴트
function local_class:siren_tint()
	local tint_duration = 1
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_out_police do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)
end

function local_class:is_alt_police(id)
	return id == 2 or id == 4 or id == 6 or id == 8
end

-- 플레이어가 근접 시 경찰 반응 처리
function local_class:police_check()
	local check_table = {}

	for i = 0, self.event_police_list.Count - 1 do
		check_table[i + 1] = {
			character = self.event_police_list[i],
			near_player = false,
			play_sfx = false
		}
	end

	local dialogue_table = {}
	local need_remove = {}

	local notice_distance = 3

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_out_police do
		-- 다이얼로그 보이스관련 사운드 홀더 및 화자 상태 체크
		for k, holder in pairs(dialogue_table) do
			if not holder.voice_holder.IsUsing then
				holder.voice_holder = nil
				holder.talker = nil
				table.insert(need_remove, k)
			elseif holder.talker.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				holder.voice_holder:Stop()
				holder.voice_holder = nil
				holder.talker = nil
				table.insert(need_remove, k)
			end
		end

		-- 지워야하는 보이스 클립이 있다면 제거한다.
		for i = #need_remove, 1, -1 do
			local key = table.remove(need_remove, i)
			dialogue_table[key] = nil
		end

		for i = 1, #check_table do
			-- 죽은 경우 처리 안 함
			if not check_table[i].character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not check_table[i].near_player then
					if (user_party_leader.Position - check_table[i].character.Position).magnitude
							<= notice_distance then
						check_table[i].near_player = true

						if not check_table[i].play_sfx then
							check_table[i].play_sfx = true

							if i == 2 then
								music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_02')
							end

							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
						end

						speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(check_table[i].character)

						character_util.look_at(check_table[i].character, user_party_leader)
						character_util.jump(check_table[i].character, 0.5, 0.3)
						character_util.set_anim(check_table[i].character, { name = 'embarrassed' })
						character_util.set_emotion(check_table[i].character, { name = 'damaged' })

						-- FIXED : 77번 스트링 키 대사를 확인했을 때 완전 다른 상황의 내용인것이 확인되었기 때문에 랜덤 범위 수정함
						-- 사용 스트링 : demonworld_part1_s6_75 ~ demonworld_part1_s6_76
						local talk_num = random_util.get_random_int(75, 76)
						local dialogue_key = self.main_script..talk_num
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(check_table[i].character,
								{ key = dialogue_key, bubble_type = 'shout', dialogue = false })

						if self:is_alt_police(i - 1) then
							dialogue_key = dialogue_key .. '_alt'
						end

						if dialogue_table[dialogue_key] == nil then
							local voice_holder = music_player:PlayDialogueLowerPriority(dialogue_key)
							if voice_holder ~= nil then
								local holder = {}
								holder.voice_holder = voice_holder
								holder.talker = check_table[i].character
								dialogue_table[dialogue_key] = holder
							end
						end
					end
				else
					if (user_party_leader.Position - check_table[i].character.Position).magnitude <=
							notice_distance then
						character_util.look_at(check_table[i].character, user_party_leader)
					else
						check_table[i].near_player = false

						character_util.set_anim(check_table[i].character, { name = 'cast' })
						character_util.set_emotion(check_table[i].character, { name = 'tired' })
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- Exit에 상호작용해서 경찰서 나간 경우
function local_class:get_out_police_event()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.office_sfx:FadeOut(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.finished

	-- 파티원 활성화
	for i = 0, self.saved_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.saved_party[i], user_party, false)
	end

	-- 경찰 전부 NPC로 복구
	for i = 0, self.event_police_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.event_police_list[i])
	end

	-- Exit Interactable 복구
	self.exit_police.Interactable = self.exit_interactable

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	-- 전투 종료 팡파레 다시 나오게 설정
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

	-- 모든 파티원들을 알파 페이드 아웃하고 비활성화
	self.saved_party = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		self.saved_party:Add(user_party[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.saved_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'disabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.saved_party[i], 0, 0)
	end

	local constants = require('minigame/DemonWorldBasicSystem/DemonWorldCivilianConstants')
	local civilian_npc_data = constants[stage.Name].civilian_type_data

	for i = 1, self.civilian_num do
		local cur_civilian = get_character(self.civilian_name..i)
		local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.civilian_marker_name..i..'_'..1)

		cur_civilian.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.set_position(cur_civilian, cur_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(cur_civilian, cur_marker.direction)
		character_util.set_anim(cur_civilian, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_civilian, { name = 'tired' })

		self.civilian_table[i] = {
			character = cur_civilian,
			runaway = false,
			male = civilian_npc_data[i].male
		}
	end

	local index = 1
	local group_index = 1

	for i = 1, #self.block_police_nums do
		for j = 1, self.block_police_nums[i] do
			self.block_police_table[index] = {
				character = get_character(self.block_police_name..i..'_'..j),
				group = i,
				group_index = group_index
			}

			index = index + 1
			group_index = group_index + 1
		end

		group_index = 1
	end

	index = 1
	group_index = 1

	for i = 1, #self.monster_nums do
		for j = 1, self.monster_nums[i] do
			self.monster_table[index] = {
				character = get_character(self.monster_name..i..'_'..j),
				group = i,
				group_index = group_index
			}

			index = index + 1
			group_index = group_index + 1
		end

		group_index = 1
	end

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	if not user_util.has_knight_male() then
		self.fake_guardian = get_character(self.fake_guardian_male_name)
	else
		self.fake_guardian = get_character(self.fake_guardian_female_name)
	end

	self.mk2 = get_character(self.mk2_name)

	self.android_turing_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.android_turing_num do
		self.android_turing_list:Add(get_character(self.android_turing_name..i))
	end

	local reset_npc = get_character(self.notoriety_reset_npc_name)
	character_util.set_active_state(reset_npc, 'disabled')

	-- 위치 설정
	for i = 1, #self.block_police_table do
		local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.block_police_marker_name..self.block_police_table[i].group..
				'_'..self.block_police_table[i].group_index)

		character_util.set_position(self.block_police_table[i].character, cur_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.block_police_table[i].character, cur_marker.direction)

		self.block_police_table[i].character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.block_police_table[i].character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				self.block_police_table[i].character, self.detected_event,
				self.police_sight_distance, self.police_sight_angle, false, true)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.monster_table do
		local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.battle_marker_name..self.monster_table[i].group)

		local val = math.floor((self.monster_table[i].group_index - 1) / 2)
		local mod = (self.monster_table[i].group_index - 1) % 2

		character_util.set_position(self.monster_table[i].character,
				cur_marker.position + vector(-1 + 2 * mod, 0, 1.5 - 1.5 * val))
		character_util.set_direction(self.monster_table[i].character, cur_marker.direction)
	end

	local park_center_marker = field:GetMarker(self.park_center_marker_name)
	character_util.add_listener(self.princess, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(self.princess, park_center_marker.position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 몬스터 비활성화
	local parent_transform = stage.StageTransform
	local child_count = parent_transform.childCount

	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
		local cur_child = parent_transform:GetChild(i)
		local character = cur_child:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Character))

		-- 이미 죽은 몬스터는 무시함
		if character ~= nil and
				lua_helper.type_compare(character.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController) and
				not character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			character.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')
		end
	end

	local battle_groups = {
		'battle1',
		'battle3',
		'battle4',
		'battle5',
		'section_7_battle_3'
	}

	-- 배틀 존에 들어가도 몬스터들이 강제 활성화되지 않도록 설정
	for i = 1, #battle_groups do
		stage.BattleManager:GetBattleGroup(battle_groups[i]).IgnoreZoneEvent = true
	end

	-- ShootHelper 로드
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.mk2)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	-- Effect 로드
	self.siren_effect_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)

	-- 바리케이트로 막힌 아파트 Exit 상호작용 불가능하게 수정
	local front_apart_exit = get_field_object(self.entry_apart_2_1_name)
	front_apart_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	coroutine.yield(self:load_uis())
end

function local_class:load_uis()
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 악명 UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'notoriety_ui', function(prefab)
				self.notoriety_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			end)

	-- 소지금 UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'dollar_ui', function(prefab)
				self.dollar_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)

				self.dollar_ui_label = self.dollar_ui.transform:Find(
						'Contents/Button/item/Amount/Label'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.dollar_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/Amount/Dollar'):GetComponent(
						typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = game_string:GetString('demonworld_part1_dollar')
			end)

	-- 악명 증가 UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'warning_ui', function(prefab)
				self.level_up_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.level_up_ui:SetActive(false)
			end)

	-- UI 설정
	self.dollar_ui_label.text = 0

	self.notoriety_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/Title'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel)).text =
	game_string:GetString('demonworld_part1_notoriety_title_5')

	self.notoriety_ui_gauge_bar_list = create_generic_list(CS.UISprite)
	for i = 1, 5 do
		self.notoriety_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/GaugeBar/GaugeBar_'..i..'/After'):GetComponent(
				typeof(CS.UISprite)).fillAmount = 1.0
	end

	self.notoriety_ui.transform:Find(
			'Contents/Button/item/GaugeBar/Gauge_Label'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = 300

	for i = 1, 5 do
		self.notoriety_ui.transform:Find(
				'Contents/Button/item/stars/star_'..i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite)).alpha = 1
	end

	self.level_up_ui.transform:Find('Warning/Title'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = game_string:GetString('demonworld_part1_notoriety')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civilian_check, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.block_police_table = nil
	self.monster_table = nil

	self.princess = nil
	self.fake_guardian = nil
	self.mk2 = nil

	self.android_turing_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent) then
		self:on_field_ui_show_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent) then
		self:on_field_ui_hide_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if string.find(e.Zone.Name, self.battle_event_zone_name) then
			local battle_zone_string = self.battle_event_zone_name..'_'
			local zone_idx = tonumber(string.sub(e.Zone.Name, #battle_zone_string + 1, #battle_zone_string + 1))

			if not self.is_battle_flags[zone_idx] then
				self.is_battle_flags[zone_idx] = true

				self:battle_start_event(zone_idx)

				self:battle_start()
			end
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.chopper_move_start and
				e.Zone.Name == self.chopper_move_start_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.chopper_move_start

			-- 헬기 1기만 이동 시작
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'patrolling_start', 'patrol_chopper_3' }))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shout_event, self))
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.drone_follow_start and
				e.Zone.Name == self.drone_follow_start_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.drone_follow_start

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(-48, 0, -60.5))

			-- 드론 추적 시작
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'stalking_start'}))
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.drone_follow_end and
				e.Zone.Name == self.drone_follow_end_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.drone_follow_end

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, get_field_object(self.entry_apart_1_1_name))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drone_give_up_event, self))
			-- 아파트 입장 1
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.apart_event_zone_1_name and
				(self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_apart or
						self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_out_apart) then

			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_apart

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.exit_apart_1_2_name))

			field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)
			-- 아파트 입장 2
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.apart_event_zone_2_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.exit_apart_1_3_name))

			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				user_party[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			end

			if not self.is_apart_event then
				self.is_apart_event = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.screaming_mom_and_daughter_event, self))
			end
		elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.enter_park and
				e.Zone.Name == self.park_event_zone_name then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.narration_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_park and
				e.Zone.Name == self.park_near_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_park

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_princess_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		-- 아파트 퇴장 1
		if e.Zone.Name == self.apart_event_zone_1_name and
				self.current_progress == self.progress_state.enter_apart then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.get_out_apart

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

			if field:IsOnUpperFloor(user_party_leader.Position) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.princess)
			else
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.entry_apart_1_1_name))
			end

			-- 틴트 실행
			field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 0.7, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 }), 0)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tint_pulse, self))
			-- 아파트 퇴장 2
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.apart_event_zone_2_name and self.is_apart_event then
			if not field:IsOnUpperFloor(user_party_leader.Position) then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.exit_apart_1_2_name))
			end

			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				user_party[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.princess) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fake_guardian_event, self)
	else
		for i = 1, #self.deactivate_exit_names do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.deactivate_exit_names[i])) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party_leader, { key = 'err_cant_enter_now' })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if string.find(e.BattleGroupName, self.battle_group_name) then
		local battle_group_string = self.battle_group_name..'_'
		local group_idx = tonumber(
				string.sub(e.BattleGroupName, #battle_group_string + 1, #battle_group_string + 1))

		-- 배틀게이트 염
		for i = 1, self.battlegate_nums[group_idx] do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..group_idx..'_'..i))
		end

		self:battle_end()
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local mom = get_character(self.mom_name)
	local daughter = get_character(self.daughter_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, mom) then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_fly_02')
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, daughter) then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_victim_girl_01')
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_ui_show_event(e)
	self.dollar_ui:SetActive(true)
	self.notoriety_ui:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:on_field_ui_hide_event(e)
	self.dollar_ui:SetActive(false)
	self.notoriety_ui:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == self.current_touch_event_type then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.is_detected and e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detected_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.police_detected_event, self, e.Sender)
	end
end

-- 스테이지 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 일부 Exit 비활성화
	for i = 1, #self.deactivate_exit_names do
		cur_exit = get_field_object(self.deactivate_exit_names[i])
		cur_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- ExclusiveQuestStartEvent Publish
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('notoriety_variance', false))

	-- 차 이동 중단하고 비활성화
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.pause_car_event }))

	-- 플레이어 위치 설정
	local exit_marker = field:GetMarker(self.police_exit_marker_name)

	party_util.align_party(exit_marker.position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(exit_marker.direction),
			'up', 0, 'arc')

	-- 플레이어를 제외한 파티원 달리기 이펙트 해제
	for i = 0, self.saved_party.Count - 1 do
		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(self.saved_party[i])
	end

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0)

	-- 몬스터 위치 이동
	local cur_monster_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 1, #self.monster_table do
		if self.monster_table[i].group == 1 then
			local cur_monster = self.monster_table[i].character

			character_util.set_position(cur_monster, cur_monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -8))

			cur_monster_list:Add(cur_monster)
		end
	end

	-- 헬기 위치 미리 설정해놔서 튀는 것 방지
	local patrol_chopper = get_field_object(self.patrol_chopper_name)
	patrol_chopper.Position = vector(-12, 4.5, -10)
	patrol_chopper.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

	-- 장애물 설치
	for i = 1, self.fence_num do
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.fence_name..i, 'enabled')
	end

	-- 사이렌 생성
	for i = 1, self.siren_marker_num do
		local siren_marker = field:GetMarker(self.siren_marker_name..i)

		self.siren_effect_list:Add(
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.siren_effect_preset):Instantiate(siren_marker.position))
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우 소리 재생할 필요 없음
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 6 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music(
				{ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_police_02', state = 'field' })
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	-- 현상 수배 레벨 올라가는 것 보여줌
	self.level_up_ui:SetActive(true)
	self.level_up_ui.transform:Find('Warning/Title'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = game_string:GetString('demonworld_part1_notoriety_title_'..5)
	self.level_up_ui.transform:Find('Warning/Debuff'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = game_string:GetString(self.main_script..44)

	local animator = self.level_up_ui.transform:Find('Warning'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('open_5')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dw_police_02')

	coroutine.yield(nil)

-- 배틀 시작 시 호출되는 이벤트, 파티원들 등장해서 전투 참여
function local_class:battle_start()
	-- 파티원 활성화
	for i = 0, self.saved_party.Count - 1 do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.teleport_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.saved_party[i].Position)

		--배틀 시작되면 Immortal 설정 해제
		character_util.set_immortal(self.saved_party[i], false)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'enabled')
		self.saved_party[i]:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.3)
	end
end

-- 배틀 종료 시 호출되는 이벤트, 파티원들 사라짐
function local_class:battle_end()
	-- 파티원 비활성화
	for i = 0, self.saved_party.Count - 1 do
		-- HeroDeadState인 경우, 강제로 관에 넣음
		if lua_helper.type_compare(self.saved_party[i].FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.HeroDeadState) then
			self.saved_party[i]:SetCoffin(true)
		end

		-- 파티원이 배틀 끝난 뒤에도 죽지 않도록 Immortal 설정
		character_util.set_immortal(self.saved_party[i], true)

		self.saved_party[i]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.teleport_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.saved_party[i].Position)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'disabled')
	end
end

-- 시민 확인해서 플레이어 근접하면 정해진 루트대로 도망침
-- 근접 조건은 시민 Direction에 해당하는 방향의 거리, 실제 거리 두 가지로 판단
function local_class:civilian_check()
	while self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_park do
		for i = 1, #self.civilian_table do
			if not self.civilian_table[i].runaway then
				local dir_distance

				if self.civilian_table[i].character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or
						self.civilian_table[i].character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					dir_distance = math.abs(user_party_leader.Position.z -
							self.civilian_table[i].character.Position.z)
				elseif self.civilian_table[i].character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
						self.civilian_table[i].character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					dir_distance = math.abs(user_party_leader.Position.x -
							self.civilian_table[i].character.Position.x)
				end

				local distance = (user_party_leader.Position - self.civilian_table[i].character.Position).magnitude

				if dir_distance < self.civilian_detect_dir_distance_min or
						dir_distance < self.civilian_detect_dir_distance_max and
								distance < self.civilian_detect_distance then
					self.civilian_table[i].runaway = true

					local cur_civilian = self.civilian_table[i].character

					local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

					for j = 1, self.civilian_waypoint_nums[i] do
						waypoint_list:Add(field:GetMarker(self.civilian_marker_name..i..'_'..j).position)
					end

					character_util.set_anim(cur_civilian, { name = 'run' })
					character_util.set_emotion(cur_civilian, { name = 'damaged' })

					if i == 14 or i == 16 then
						character_util.jump(cur_civilian, 2, 1)
					end

					character_util.move_waypoint(cur_civilian, waypoint_list, 6,
							true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

					-- 대사 출력
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(cur_civilian)

					if self.civilian_table[i].male then
						if i % 2 == 0 then
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_villain_scream_04')

							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
									cur_civilian, { key = 'demonworld_part1_civilian_'..4 })
						else
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_villain_scream_02')

							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
									cur_civilian, { key = self.main_script..51, lower_priority = true })
						end
					else
						if i % 2 == 0 then
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_scream_01')

							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
									cur_civilian, { key = 'demonworld_part1_civilian_'..5 })
						else
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_teatan_scream_02')

							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
									cur_civilian, { key = self.main_script..52, lower_priority = true })
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 틴트 펄스 이벤트
function local_class:tint_pulse()
	local tint_duration = 1
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	while self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.enter_apart and
			self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_park do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.tint_key_2, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, 1)
	end
end

-- 전투 시작
function local_class:battle_start_event(idx)
	-- 몬스터로 설정
	for i = 1, #self.monster_table do
		if self.monster_table[i].group == idx then
			local cur_monster = self.monster_table[i].character

			character_util.convert_to_monster(cur_monster, self.battle_group_name..'_'..idx, nil)
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(cur_monster, user_party_leader, 'battle')
		end
	end

	-- 배틀게이트 닫음
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_nums[idx] do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..idx..'_'..i))
	end

	self:battle_start()
end

-- 경찰에게 들킴
function local_class:police_detected_event(sender)
	self.is_detected = true

	local cur_group

	for i = 1, #self.block_police_table do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.block_police_table[i].character, sender) then
			cur_group = self.block_police_table[i].group

			break
		end
	end

	local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.reset_marker_name..cur_group)

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, sender)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader,
			{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'scared' })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sender, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'mad'})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_police_01')

	camera_util.move_async(sender.Position, 0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sender, { key = self.main_script..1, skip = true })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	party_util.align_party(cur_marker.position +
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_marker.direction),
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(cur_marker.direction), 0, 'arc')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sender)

	-- 디텍션 초기화
	message_system:SendSync(sender.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_detected = false
end

-- 드론 추적 중지하고 날아감
function local_class:drone_give_up_event()
	-- 드론 추적 중지
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'stalking_pause' }))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local drone = get_field_object('drone_stalker_1')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = 5
	local start_pos = drone.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(20, 10, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_duration)

		drone.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	drone.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

	character_util.shake(daughter, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_direction(daughter, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(daughter, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(daughter, { name = 'tired' })

	stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(daughter)

	end

					character_util.set_direction(mom, 'right')
					character_util.set_anim(mom, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
					character_util.set_emotion(mom, { name = 'damaged' })
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.ordeal = get_character(self.trouble_shooter_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.ordeal, vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.gremory = get_character(self.mad_scientist_name)
	self.gremory.SpineController:AddColor(self.gremory.Name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)
	character_util.add_listener(self.gremory, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(self.gremory, vector(-128, 0, -21))
	character_util.set_direction(self.gremory, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.gremory, { name = 'sing' })

	self.desk = get_field_object(self.ordeal_desk_name)

	self.exit_office = get_field_object(self.exit_office_name)
	self.exit_office_interactable = self.exit_office.Interactable
	self.exit_office.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우 나레이션 메시지 나옴
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_2_event, self))
		end
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.ordeal = nil
	self.gremory = nil

	self.desk = nil

	self.exit_office = nil
	self.exit_office_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.desk) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.interact_with_desk then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.interact_with_desk

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_desk_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_office) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_out_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gremory) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gremory_event, self))
	end
end

-- 버거 흔들리면서 줄어들고 사라지는 연출
function local_class:eat_burger(burger, duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local shake_duration = duration

	local item_pos = burger.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local shadow_pos = burger.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local shake_range = 0.05

	local shrink_start = duration - 1
	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0.3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_duration do
		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		burger.SpriteTransform.localPosition = item_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)
		burger.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= shrink_start then
			local cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) - shrink_start,
					start_scale, end_scale - start_scale, shake_duration - shrink_start)

			burger.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
			burger.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	burger.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
	burger:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- Perspective 카메라 이동
function local_class:perspective_camera_move()
	local timer = 0
	local camera_duration = 6.5

	local is_finished = false

	local start_pos = vector(14.5, -1.5, 0)
	local end_pos = vector(14.5, -1.5, -9)

	while self.is_turing_march do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer < camera_duration then
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / camera_duration)

			camera_util.move(cur_pos, 0)
		elseif not is_finished then
			is_finished = true

			camera_util.move(end_pos, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

		if not self.is_in_trouble_shooter_house and

			self.is_in_trouble_shooter_house = true

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

					nil, 3, true, true)

			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.ordeal, self.controller)
			character_util.set_active_state(self.ordeal, 'disabled')

			self.desk.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

			camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })

			if self.exit_office ~= nil and self.exit_office_interactable ~= nil then
				self.exit_office.Interactable = self.exit_office_interactable
			end

			user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)

			-- 프로세스 종료 알림
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.end_main_quest_custom_event }))

			-- 다음 섹션으로
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		else
			if dollar_val >= self.target_dollar then
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(self.ordeal)
			else
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(self.ordeal)
			end

			-- 프로세스 종료 알림
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.end_main_quest_custom_event }))
		end
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.ordeal, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ordeal, { key = self.main_script..1, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.ordeal)

		-- 프로세스 종료 알림
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.end_main_quest_custom_event }))
	end
