local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMotherPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
        Type = pre @
        QuestName = DemonWorldMother @
        Comment = 아이 엄마로 부터 퀘스트 받기 전 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		kid_bag_mother = 2,
		mother_ask_player = 3
	}

	self.current_section_stage = self.section_state.none

	self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_4'
	self.script_key = 'demonworld_mother_pre_'

	self.convenience_quest_marker = 'convenience_marker'

	self.kid_bagging_zone = 'kid_bagging'

	self.is_quest_started = false

	self.is_bagging_scene_playing = false
	self.get_homeless = function() return get_character('store_homeless') end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')

	self:set_character_by_section_state(self.section_state.none)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()

	-- 퀘스트 컨트롤러 관련
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self.controller:disable_all_bug_controller()
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.kid_bagging_zone and self.is_bagging_scene_playing == false and self.is_quest_started == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_kid_bag_mother, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()

	if self.current_section_stage == self.section_state.none then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, mother) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_mother_ask_favor_to_knight, self)
		end
	elseif self.current_section_stage == self.section_state.mother_ask_player then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, mother) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_quest_request_popup, self)
		end
	end
end

--region 루틴들
function local_class:set_character_by_section_state(state)
	if state == self.section_state.none then
		local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
		local kid = self.controller.get_kid()

		character_util.set_active_state(mother, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(kid, 'enabled')

		local mother_init_pos = field:GetMarker('mother_init_pos').position
		local kid_init_pos = field:GetMarker('kid_init_pos').position

		character_util.set_position(mother, mother_init_pos)
		character_util.set_position(kid, kid_init_pos)

		character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_anim(kid, { name = 'seat' })

		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'cast', upper = true })

		kid.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		mother.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		local homeless = self.get_homeless()
		local homeless_init_pos = field:GetMarker('homeless_init_pos').position
		homeless.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		character_util.set_active_state(homeless, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(homeless, homeless_init_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(homeless, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(homeless, { name = 'seat' })

		local store_door = get_field_object('store_mother_door')
		store_door.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
end

function local_class:scene_kid_bag_mother()
	self.is_bagging_scene_playing = true
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()

	-- 아이: 꼭 가야해 ...?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = false })
	self.is_bagging_scene_playing = false
end

function local_class:scene_mother_ask_favor_to_knight()
	self.current_section_stage = self.section_state.kid_bag_mother

	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()

	party_util.align_party(mother.Position, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 아이: 엄마. 안가면 안돼…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 엄마: 먹을게 얼마 안남았잖니..
	character_util.remove_anim(mother)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 엄마: 너 앞으로 키도 쑥쑥 커야 하는데 잘 먹어야지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 22, skip = true })

	-- 아이: 하지만 가는길에 괴물이랑 바이러스가 잔뜩 있잖아요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(kid, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	-- 아이: 가지마... 응? 나 앞으로 조금만 먹을게..
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(kid, { name = 'sing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	-- 엄마: ..얘가...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 엄마: ...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 엄마 기사 발견함
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(mother, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- ! 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(mother, nil, 'notice')

	-- 엄마와 아이 서로 바라봄
	character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')

	-- 엄마:  여기 좀 보렴. 여기 강한 기사 님이 계셔.
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })

	self.current_section_stage = self.section_state.mother_ask_player

	-- 퀘스트 수락 창 띄우기.
	self:show_quest_request_popup()
end

function local_class:show_quest_request_popup()
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(mother, user_party_leader)

	-- 엄마: 기사님. 저와 함께 남쪽 편의점에 가주지 않으시겠어요?
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 23, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(mother)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mother)

	-- 엄마: 구한 식량은 반씩 나눠 가지는 걸로..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 9, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(mother, true)

	-- 엄마: 제가 길을 안내할게요!
	character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 11, skip = true })

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

		-- 엄마 : 봐. 기사님이 같이 가주신대.
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'clap' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 14, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 아들 : 그, 그렇지만..
		character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.remove_anim(kid)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 15, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 무슨 일 생기면 엄마는 잘 숨어있을테니까.
		character_util.nod_twice(mother)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 16, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 걱정하지 말고 조금만 기다려. 엄마가 맛있는거 가져올게.
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 17, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 남자아이니까. 울지 않기다?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 18, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 아들 : ...응...
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.script_key .. 19, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 기다리게 해서 죄송해요, 기사님.
		character_util.look_at(mother, user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'basket_idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 20, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 엄마 : 가요! 이 도로를 따라서 가면 금방 도착할 거에요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 21, skip = true })

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(mother, self.controller)
		self.is_quest_started = true

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 아이 인터렉터블 제외
		kid.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		character_util.move_distance_async(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, -3), 1 ,
				nil, true, true)

		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(mother, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		mother:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		mother.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.remove_emotion(mother)
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		local homeless = self.get_homeless()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.convenience_quest_marker, homeless)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		-- 엄마: 어떻게 안될까요..?
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'sing' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'damaged'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 12, skip = true })

		-- 엄마: 혹시 마음이 바뀌시면 말씀해주세요.
		character_util.remove_emotion(mother)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.script_key .. 13, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(mother)
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired' })
	end
end

--endregion

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 프리 섹션을 통해 해당 섹션에 진입한 것인지, 스테지이즈를 재시작해서 들어온 것 인지 확인해야함.
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin
	else
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mother_ask_knight
	end

	self:set_characters_by_section_state()

	return true
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self.controller:disable_all_bug_controller()
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.give_up_zone
			and (self.current_section_state < self.section_state.escaped_virus_zone
			and self.current_section_state > self.section_state.mother_ask_knight)
			and self.did_ask_give_up == false then

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ask_give_up, self)
	end
	if zone_name == self.mother_monologue_1
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin
			and self.cnt_mother_monologue == 0 then
		self:add_monologue_line()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mother_monologue, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.mother_monologue_2
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin
			and self.cnt_mother_monologue == 1
			and self.entered_puzzle_zone == false then
		self.entered_puzzle_zone = true
		for i = 1, 3 do
			self:add_monologue_line()
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.mother_monologue_3
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin then
		self:add_monologue_line()
	elseif (zone_name == self.spike_puzzle_zone or zone_name == self.spike_puzzle_zone_2)
			and self.is_first_time_stepping_on_switch == false
			and self.seen_pushing_spike_event == false then
			self.seen_pushing_spike_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_mother_push_spike, self)
	elseif zone_name == self.u_road_tint_zone and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.passing_u_road then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mother_tinting_black, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.leave_u_road_zone and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.got_food then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_virus_infects_homeless, self)

	elseif zone_name == self.leave_store_zone and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.got_food and self.seen_say_goodbye == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_homeless_say_good_bye, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.red_blue_event_zone and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.running_away_from_virus then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_mother_went_back_to_store, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.virus_safe_zone and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.escaped_virus_zone then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.escaped_virus_zone then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_mothers_death, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local second_switch = self.get_second_switch()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, second_switch) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin
					or self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_end then
				if self.is_first_time_stepping_on_switch then
					self.is_first_time_stepping_on_switch = false
					return true
				end
			elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_pushing_spike then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_open_spike_gate, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	local homeless = self.get_homeless()
	local store_door = get_field_object('store_mother_door')
	local store_door_out = get_field_object('store_mother_out')
	local store_rb_switch = get_field_object('store_rb_swith')

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_ask_knight then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, mother) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mother_ask_player_again, self)
		end
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.reached_store then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, homeless) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_homeless_takes_exclusives, self)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, store_door) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_store, self))
		end
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.got_food then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, store_door_out) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.move_out_store, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, store_door) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_store_warning_narration, self)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, store_rb_switch) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.homeless_shout, self)
	end
end

function local_class:set_characters_by_section_state()

function local_class:ask_give_up()
	self.did_ask_give_up = true

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetString('demonworld_mother_system_giveup'), 0, 1)

	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'demonworld_mother_giveup_positive', 'brutal' },
		{ 'demonworld_mother_giveup_negative', 'mercy' }}
	)

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	if choose == 1 then
		self:give_up_quest_routine()
	else

	end

end

			{ itemid = 20367, pos = store_leader_pos + vector(1.1, 1.5, -0.3), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			  notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.929, showoncharacter = true })
	drop_item_1.SpriteTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(10, 0, 0)
	drop_item_1.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.red_cans[#self.red_cans + 1] = drop_item_1

	local drop_item_2 =  drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20367, pos = store_mother_pos + vector(1.1, 1.5, -0.3), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			  notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.929, showoncharacter = true })
	drop_item_2.SpriteTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(10, 0, 0)
	drop_item_2.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat'})

	camera_util.move((mother.Position + user_party_leader.Position)/2, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_store', state = 'event', mix = 1.2 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)

function local_class:move_out_store()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:remove_mother_from_party()

	local pos_to_teleport = field:GetMarker('store_mother_exit').position

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)

	for i = 1, #self.red_cans do
		local can = self.red_cans[i]
		if can ~= nil then
			can:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end

	local count = 0
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		count = i
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos_to_teleport - vector(i * 0.6, 0, 0))
	end

	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	character_util.set_position(mother, pos_to_teleport - vector((count + 1) * 0.6, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'down')

	coroutine.yield()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld', state = 'field'})

	self.controller:add_mother_to_party()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.kid_marker, kid)
end

function local_class:mother_ask_player_again()
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()

	party_util.align_party(mother.Position, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(mother, user_party_leader)

	-- 엄마: 기사님. 저와 함께 남쪽 편의점에 가주지 않으시겠어요?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 23, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(mother)

	-- 엄마: 구한 식량은 반씩 나눠 가지는 걸로..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 9, skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 11, skip = true })

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted then
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

		-- 엄마 : 봐. 기사님이 같이 가주신대.
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'clap' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 14, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 아들 : 그, 그렇지만..
		character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.remove_anim(kid)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 15, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 무슨 일 생기면 엄마는 잘 숨어있을테니까.
		character_util.nod_twice(mother)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 16, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 걱정하지 말고 조금만 기다려. 엄마가 맛있는거 가져올게.
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 17, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 남자아이니까. 울지 않기다?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 18, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 아들 : ...응...
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 19, skip = true })

		-- 엄마 : 기다리게 해서 죄송해요, 기사님.
		character_util.look_at(mother, user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(mother, { name = 'basket_idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 20, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		-- 엄마 : 가요! 이 도로를 따라서 가면 금방 도착할 거에요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 21, skip = true })

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(mother, self.controller)
		self.is_quest_started = true

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.move_distance_async(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, -3), 1 ,
				nil, true, true)

		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(mother, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		mother:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		mother.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.remove_emotion(mother)
		character_util.remove_anim(mother)

		local homeless = self.get_homeless()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.convenience_quest_marker, homeless)
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin
	else
		-- 엄마: 어떻게 안될까요..?

		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'damaged'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 12, skip = true })

		-- 엄마: 혹시 마음이 바뀌시면 말씀해주세요.
		character_util.remove_emotion(mother)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = self.pre_script_key .. 13, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(mother)
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'tired' })
	end
end

function local_class:mother_monologue()
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()

	while (self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_monologue_begin) or
			(#self.mother_monologue_queue ~= 0) do
		local line_to_play = self.mother_monologue_queue[1]

		if line_to_play ~= nil then

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, {
				key = self.script_key .. line_to_play })

			if line_to_play == 5 then
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mother_monologue_end
			end

			table.remove(self.mother_monologue_queue, 1)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:add_monologue_line()
	self.cnt_mother_monologue = self.cnt_mother_monologue + 1
	table.insert(self.mother_monologue_queue, self.cnt_mother_monologue)

function local_class:apply_damage_to_mother_periodically()
	local mother = self.controller.get_mother()
	local time_passed = 1.7
	local waiting_duration = 1.5
	while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mother_pushing_spike do
		if (time_passed >= waiting_duration) then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(mother, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mother)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(mother, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.33)
			time_passed = 0
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enable_bug_controllers_sequentially(from, to, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local idx_to_activate = from
	-- 구간 갯수
	local number_to_activate = (to - from) + 1
	local activated_cnt = 0

	-- 구간 갯수만큼 틀어줌.
	while (activated_cnt < number_to_activate)  do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			time_passed = 0
			self.controller:enable_bug_controller(idx_to_activate + activated_cnt)
			activated_cnt = activated_cnt + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.bug_loop ~= nil then
		self.bug_loop:FadeOut(1)
		self.bug_loop = nil
	end
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)

		self.controller:disable_all_bug_controller()
	end

function local_class:mugger_run_away()

    local z_pos = field:GetMarker('mugger_waypoint_4').position.z
    character_util.move_to_async(mugger, vector(mugger.Position.z, 0, z_pos),

function local_class:hold_until_player_get_far_away_from(target)

    while distance < 17 do
        distance = vector_util.sqr_distance(user_party_leader.Position, target.Position)
        coroutine.yield()
    end

    local mugger = self.get_mugger()
    -- 일정 거리 이상 벌어졌는지 확인하기
    yield_return_func(self.hold_until_player_get_far_away_from, self, mugger)

    -- 주변을 둘러보는 소매치기 소녀

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mugger, { key = self.script_key .. 10, skip = true })

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil

end

end

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMuggerPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
        Type = pre @
        QuestName = demonworld_mugger @
        Comment = 소매치기 조우 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    self.section_state = {
        none = 1, -- 스테이지에 막 진입한 상태
        chasing_player = 2, -- 소매치기가 플레이어를 쫒아오고 있는 상태.
    }

    self.current_section_stage = self.section_state.none

    self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_2'
    self.script_key = 'demonworld_mugger_pre_'

    -- 이펙트
    self.hit_effect_name = 'FX_hit'

    self.mugger_rubbery_1_zone = 'mugger_rubbery_1'
    --self.mugger_rubbery_2_zone = 'mugger_rubbery_2'

    self.get_mugger = function() return get_character('mugger') end

    self.required_minimum_gold = 1000

    self.mugger_init_pos = field:GetMarker('mugger_spawn_1').position

    self.main_quest_num = 216

    self.keep_update = true

    self.initial_mugger_pos = nil

    self.start_chasing_dist = 10
    self.start_return_dist = 15
    self.start_rubbery_dist = 0.1
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)
end

function local_class:enter()
    -- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
    if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

    -- 메시지 구독 관련
    --message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

    local mugger = self.get_mugger()
    character_util.set_active_state(mugger, 'enabled')
    character_util.set_position(mugger, self.mugger_init_pos)
    character_util.set_direction(mugger, 'right')
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mugger, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'doyagao'})

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    self.initial_mugger_pos = self.get_mugger().Position

    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
            util.cs_generator(self.mugger_update_routine, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
    --message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()

    -- 퀘스트 컨트롤러 관련
    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:on_event()
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
    if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'dollar_load' and
            e:GetParamAt(1) ~= nil and tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1)) ~= nil then
        self.dollar = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
    elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'pause_npc_logic' then
        self.controller.s_exclusive_event_on = true
    elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'resume_npc_logic' then
        self.controller.is_exclusive_event_on = false
    end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    -- 퀘스트를 선행 조건이 만족하는지 파악
    local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_num)
    if( main_quest == nil or main_quest.InnerProgress < 4 ) then return end

    if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
    if self.controller.is_exclusive_event_on then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if ((zone_name == self.mugger_rubbery_1_zone or zone_name == self.mugger_rubbery_2_zone)
            and self.current_section_stage == self.section_state.none) then
        -- 소지금이 충분한지 확인
        if (self:evaluate_player_has_more_dollar_than(self.required_minimum_gold)) then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                    util.cs_generator(self.scene_knight_get_robbed, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:scene_knight_get_robbed()

    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

    local mugger = self.get_mugger()

    local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(mugger.Direction) * 2
    self:apply_knock_back_to(mugger, user_party_leader, dir_vector)

    message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'pause_car_logic' }))

    -- 소매치기: 아... 죄송해요...한 눈을 팔다가...
    character_util.set_anim(mugger, { name = 'sing' })
    character_util.set_emotion(mugger, { name = 'tired' })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mugger, { key = self.script_key .. 1 })

    -- 도망가는 소매치기
    character_util.set_emotion(mugger, { name = 'doyagao' })
    character_util.move_to_async(mugger, vector(-5.5, 0, mugger.Position.z),
            nil, 8, true, true, true)
    character_util.move_to_async(mugger, mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, 20),
            nil, 8, true, true, true)

    message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'resume_car_logic' }))

    party_util.reset_controllers()
    field_ui_manager:Show()

	local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
	demon_world_dollar:remove_dollar(self.required_minimum_gold)

    yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

--region 루틴들
function local_class:mugger_update_routine()
    local mugger = self.get_mugger()
    local dash_sfx = nil

    while self.keep_update do
        if not self.controller.is_exclusive_event_on then
			local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
			local dollar_val = demon_world_dollar:get_dollar()
            local distance_from_init_pos = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.initial_mugger_pos, user_party_leader.Position)

            if (distance_from_init_pos > self.start_chasing_dist) then
                if dash_sfx ~= nil then
                    dash_sfx:Stop()
                    dash_sfx = nil
                end

                local distance_from_init_pos_to_mugger = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(self.initial_mugger_pos, mugger.Position)
                if distance_from_init_pos_to_mugger > 0.05 then
                    self:move_by_one_frame(mugger, self.initial_mugger_pos, mugger.Position, 2)
                else
                    mugger.Position = self.initial_mugger_pos
                    character_util.set_direction(mugger, 'right')
                end
            elseif (distance_from_init_pos < self.start_chasing_dist ) then
                if (dollar_val > self.required_minimum_gold) then
                    if dash_sfx == nil then
                        dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
                    end

                    local distance_mugger_player = vector_util.sqr_distance(mugger.Position, user_party_leader.Position)

                    if distance_mugger_player > self.start_rubbery_dist then
                        self:move_by_one_frame(mugger, user_party_leader.Position, mugger.Position,  10)
                    end
                end
            end

            local distance_mugger_player = vector_util.sqr_distance(mugger.Position, user_party_leader.Position)

demon_world_global_event = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/DemonWorldGlobalEvent')

		Type = progress @
		QuestName = demonworld_mugger @
		Comment = 소매치기를 혼내주는 기사 @
		Index = 0 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.script_key = 'demonworld_mugger_s1_'
	self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_2'
	self.battle_group_name = 'mugger_event'

	-- 엔딩 장면
	self.event_ending_list = {
		self.ending_kick_mugger,
		self.ending_call_police,
		self.ending_leave_mugger_alone
	}

	-- 소매치기가 빙글 빙글 돌때 사용할 웨이포인트들
	self.mugger_flee_waypoints = {
		-- vector(0, 0, 49.5)
		field:GetMarker('mugger_waypoint_1').position,
		-- vector(-16, 0, 49.5)
		field:GetMarker('mugger_waypoint_2').position,
		-- vector(-16, 0, 55)
		field:GetMarker('mugger_waypoint_3').position,
		-- vector(0, 0, 55)
		field:GetMarker('mugger_waypoint_4').position
	}

	-- 소매치기가 현재 위치한 도주로 웨이포인트의 인덱스
	self.current_mugger_flee_waypoint_idx = 1

	-- 소매치기가 플레이어를 계속 피해야하는지에 대한 여부
	self.keep_avoiding = true

	self.avoiding_time = 0

	self.hit_effect_preset = 'FX_hit'
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = 'FX_lasthit'

	--region 소매치기 도망 관련 변수들
	-- 소매치기가 지금 도망치고 있는지에 대한 여부
	self.is_mugger_avoiding = false

	-- 소매치기가 이동해야하는 웨이포인트 인덱스
	self.target_flee_index = 1

	self.is_playing = true

	--endregion
	self.get_mugger = function() return get_character('mugger') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_field_by_progress()

	self.controller.is_able_to_update_oil = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_event, self))
end

--region 업데이트 문
function local_class:update_event()
	while self.is_playing do

        if (not self.controller.is_exclusive_event_on) then
            self:update_mugger_avoiding()
        end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:update_mugger_avoiding()
	if (not self.controller.keep_avoiding) then return end

	local mugger = self.get_mugger()
	local player = user_party.Leader
	local range = 1.5
	local speed = 8

	if (self.controller:is_close_to(player.Position, mugger.Position, range) and not self.is_mugger_avoiding) then
		self.target_flee_index = self:get_next_flee_waypoint(mugger)
		character_util.set_anim(mugger, { name = 'run' })
		self.is_mugger_avoiding = true
	end

	if (not self.is_mugger_avoiding) then return end

	--if self.dash_sfx == nil then
	--	self.dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	--end

	self.avoiding_time = self.avoiding_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

	local init = self.mugger_flee_waypoints[self.current_mugger_flee_waypoint_idx]
	local dest = self.mugger_flee_waypoints[self.target_flee_index]
	local dir = dest - mugger.Position

	mugger.Direction = dir:ToDirection()

	local duration = (vector(dest.x, 0, dest.z) - init).magnitude / speed

	character_util.set_anim(mugger, { name = 'run'})
	mugger.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(init, vector(dest.x, 0, dest.z), self.avoiding_time / duration)

	if self.avoiding_time >= duration then
		mugger.Position = dest
		character_util.remove_anim(mugger)
		self.current_mugger_flee_waypoint_idx = self.target_flee_index
		self.is_mugger_avoiding = false
		self.avoiding_time = 0
	end
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

function local_class:slipped_by_oil(character)
	local is_player = lua_helper.reference_equals(character, user_party_leader)

	if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'left')
	end

	if is_player then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'surprise' })
	if is_player then
		character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'cliff'})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'embarrassed'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'confused' })
	if is_player then
		character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'prostrate'})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'sleep'})
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	if not is_player then
		local mugger = self.get_mugger()
		mugger.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self:remove_oil_range()
	end

	if is_player then
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(character, character.Direction, 2, nil, true)
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

			return 2
		elseif (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
			return 4
		end
	elseif(cur_idx == 2) then

			return 3
		elseif (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
			return 1
		end
	elseif(cur_idx == 3) then
		if (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
			return 4
		elseif (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
			return 2
		end
	elseif(cur_idx == 4) then
		if (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
			return 1
		elseif (player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or player_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
			return 3
		end
	end
end

			util.cs_generator(self.wait_for_change_dollar_state, self, dollar_table, 0.5))
end

-- 떨어진 달러 1초 뒤에 플레이어가 강제로 획득하게 설정
function local_class:wait_for_change_dollar_state(cur_table, wait_delay)
	wait_for_sec(wait_delay)

	cur_table.item.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
	cur_table.item:Fly()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.get_dollar, self, cur_table))
end

function local_class:get_available_direction(pos_to_check, size)

	if self:check_direction_is_hull(pos_to_check + unity_class.vector3.right, unity_class.vector3.one * size) then
		return unity_class.vector3.right
	elseif self:check_direction_is_hull(pos_to_check + unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.one * size) then
		return unity_class.vector3.left
	elseif self:check_direction_is_hull(pos_to_check + unity_class.vector3.forward, unity_class.vector3.one * size) then
		return unity_class.vector3.forward
	elseif self:check_direction_is_hull(pos_to_check + unity_class.vector3.back,unity_class.vector3.one * size) then
		return unity_class.vector3.back
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.left
end

function local_class:check_direction_is_hull(pos_to_check, dir_vec)
	local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(pos_to_check, dir_vec)
	local diff = bound.center - user_party_leader.Bounds.center

	return not field:IsAnythingBlocking(user_party_leader.Bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle,
			vector_util.get_x0z(diff))
end

function local_class:get_dollar(cur_table)
	-- FloatingText 사용
	CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(user_party_leader):JustPrintItemName('+'..(cur_table.num), 0)
end

--endregion

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldPervertSection1')
demon_world_global_event = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/DemonWorldGlobalEvent')

--[[QuestAttribute
      Type = progress@

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- state
	self.pervert_event_states = { none = 0, protect_pink = 1, meet_pervert = 2 }

	self.get_pink_pervert_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('pervert_pink_guy_marker').position end

	self.watching_event = false

	self.is_seen_npc_2 = false
	self.is_seen_npc_3 = false

	self.party = {}

	self.pervert_battle_group = 'pervert_battle'

	self.key_item = nil
	self.is_get_key = false
	self.is_seen_key_event = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self.is_blocking_talk = false

	self.is_exclusive_quest_start = false

	self.is_icon_active = true
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	self:set_pink_guy()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.pervert_quest_key then
		self.is_exclusive_quest_start = true
		if self.is_icon_active then
			quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.get_pink())
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.pervert_quest_key then
		self.is_exclusive_quest_start = false
		if self.is_icon_active then
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.get_pink())
		end
	end
end


function local_class:start()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.party, user_party[i])
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.key_item ~= nil then
		self.key_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.current_state = nil
	self.party = nil
	self.pervert_event_states = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local pink = self.get_pink()
	local npc_5 =  self.get_pervert_npc(5)
	local npc_6 =  self.get_pervert_npc(6)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pink) and
			self.current_state == self.pervert_event_states.none then
		if self.is_exclusive_quest_start == false then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_pink, self)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pink, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_1', skip = false })
			end))
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc_5) and self.is_seen_key_event == false then
		if self.is_get_key then
			self.is_seen_key_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.key_event, self)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_5, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_5', skip = false })
			end))
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc_6) and self.is_seen_key_event == false then
		if self.is_get_key then
			self.is_seen_key_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.key_event, self)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_6, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_6', skip = false })
			end))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.pervert_battle_group then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pervert_ending, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.pervert_event_states.protect_pink then
		return false
	end

	local zone = e.Zone.Name

	if zone == 'pervert_block_1' or zone == 'pervert_block_2' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.blocking_wrong_way, self, vector(0,0,-2))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_block_3' or zone == 'pervert_block_4' or zone == 'pervert_block_5' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.blocking_wrong_way, self, vector(-2,0,0))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_block_6' or zone == 'pervert_block_7' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.blocking_wrong_way, self, vector(2,0,0))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_block_8' or zone == 'pervert_block_9' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.blocking_wrong_way, self, vector(0,0,2))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_npc_zone_1' and self.is_seen_npc_1 == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			self.is_seen_npc_1 = true
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_pervert_npc(1), { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_1', skip = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_pervert_npc(2), { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_2', skip = false })
		end))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_npc_zone_2' and self.is_seen_npc_2 == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			self.is_seen_npc_2 = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = self.get_pervert_npc(3), type_priority = 'event' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_pervert_npc(3), { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_3', skip = false })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = self.get_pervert_npc(4), type_priority = 'event' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_pervert_npc(4), { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_4', skip = false })
		end))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_npc_zone_3' and self.is_seen_npc_3 == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hunting_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_end_zone' then
		self.current_state = self.pervert_event_states.meet_pervert
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_pervert_zone, self))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'pervert_key_zone' and self.is_get_key == false then
		self.is_get_key = true
		self.key_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		self.key_item = nil
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	branches:Add({

	self.get_pervert_npc(2).Position = self.get_pervert_npc_pos(1) + vector(1,0,0)

	self.get_pervert_npc(6).Position = self.get_pervert_npc_pos(3) + vector(1,0,0)
	self.get_pervert_npc(7).Position = self.get_pervert_npc_pos(4)

	if user_party.Count > 1 then

function local_class:hunting_event()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_7, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_16_1', skip = true })

	if vec < 0 then

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	-- 죄송합니다아!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_7, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_npc_19', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0 })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc_7, { npc_7.Position + vector(-10,0,0) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', '01_dash_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	npc_7.Position = vector(999,0,999)

-- 헐크녀 자동 대사 코루틴
function local_class:pink_talk()
	local talk_delay = 2
	local current_talk_idx = 1
	local max_talk_idx = 5

	local pink = self.get_pink()
	local time = 1

	while self.current_state == self.pervert_event_states.protect_pink do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		while current_talk_idx == 2 and self.next_pink_talk == false do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		while self.watching_event == true do
			time = 0
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if time > talk_delay then
			time = 0

			if self.current_state ~= self.pervert_event_states.protect_pink then
				return
			end

			self.is_blocking_talk = false
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pink, { key = 'demonworld_pervert_pink_' .. current_talk_idx, skip = false, type_speed = 0 })

			if self.is_blocking_talk == false then
				if current_talk_idx >= max_talk_idx then
					return
				else
					current_talk_idx = current_talk_idx + 1
				end
			else
				self.is_blocking_talk = false
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		end

	local val = self.wyvern_num
	local index = 1

	while val > 0 do
		local mod = val % 2

		if mod == 1 then
			wyvern_checks[index] = true
		end

		val = math.floor(val / 2)
		index = index + 1
	end

	for i = 1, #wyvern_checks do
		local cur_wyvern = get_character(self.wyvern_names[i])

		self.wyvern_table[i] = {
			wyvern = cur_wyvern,
			not_in_current_stage = cur_wyvern == nil,
			gotten = wyvern_checks[i]
		}

		-- 와이번이 현재 스테이지에 존재하고 잡히지 않은 경우 위치에 생성
		if stage.Name == self.stage_name and self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern ~= nil then
			if not self.wyvern_table[i].gotten then
				character_util.add_listener(cur_wyvern, self.controller)
				if i ~= 1 then
					character_util.set_position(cur_wyvern, field:GetMarker(self.wyvern_marker_names[i]).position)
					character_util.set_direction(cur_wyvern, field:GetMarker(self.wyvern_marker_names[i]).direction)
				end
			-- 잡힌 경우 위치에서 제거
			else
				character_util.set_position(cur_wyvern, vector(999, 0, 999))
			end
		end
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 안쓰게된 와이번 정리
		get_character('wyvern_red_2').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		get_character('wyvern_blue').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	self.wyvern_old_woman = get_character(self.wyvern_old_woman_name)

	if self.wyvern_old_woman ~= nil then
		character_util.add_listener(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.controller)
		character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_old_woman, vector(-148, 0, -30))
		character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.hide_weapon(self.wyvern_old_woman, true)
	end

	-- Exit 사용 불가능하게 설정
	self.wyvern_house_exit = get_field_object(self.entry_wyvern_house_exit_name)

	if self.wyvern_house_exit ~= nil then
		self.wyvern_house_exit_interactable = self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable
		self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.wyvern_num == self.wyvern_max then
		if self.wyvern_old_woman ~= nil then
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(self.wyvern_old_woman)
		end

		local red_wyvern = get_character(self.red_wyvern_name)

		if red_wyvern ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(red_wyvern, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end

	-- 방어 코드
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		for i = 1, #self.wyvern_table do
			if self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern ~= nil and not self.wyvern_table[i].gotten then
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.wyvern_table = nil
	self.wyvern_old_woman = nil

	self.wyvern_names = nil
	self.wyvern_marker_names = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.wyvern_table do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_wyvern_event, self, self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern, i)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_old_woman) then
		if self.wyvern_num == self.wyvern_max then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_old_woman_event, self)
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wyvern_old_woman, { key = self.script_key..7 })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_house_exit) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.close_door_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key then
		-- 와이번 비활성화
		for i = 1, #self.wyvern_table do
			local cur_wyvern = self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern

			if cur_wyvern ~= nil and not self.wyvern_table[i].gotten then
				quest_icon_util.remove(cur_wyvern)
				character_util.remove_relate_event(cur_wyvern, self.controller)

				if e.Fade then
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_wyvern, 0, 0)
					character_util.set_active_state(cur_wyvern, 'disabled')
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, cur_wyvern, true))
				end
			end
		end

		-- 할머니와도 대화 불가
		if self.wyvern_old_woman ~= nil then
			quest_icon_util.remove(self.wyvern_old_woman)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.controller)

			if e.Fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_old_woman, 0, 0)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'disabled')
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_old_woman, true))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	-- 와이번들과 다시 대화 가능
	if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key then
		for i = 1, #self.wyvern_table do
			local cur_wyvern = self.wyvern_table[i].wyvern

			if cur_wyvern ~= nil and not self.wyvern_table[i].gotten then
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(cur_wyvern)
				character_util.add_listener(cur_wyvern, self.controller)

				if e.Fade then
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_wyvern, 1, 0)
					character_util.set_active_state(cur_wyvern, 'enabled')
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, cur_wyvern, false))
				end
			end
		end

		-- 할머니와 대화 다시 가능
		if self.wyvern_old_woman ~= nil then
			if self.wyvern_num == self.wyvern_max then
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(self.wyvern_old_woman)
			end

			character_util.add_listener(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.controller)

			if e.Fade then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_old_woman, 1, 0)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'enabled')
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_old_woman, false))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 캐릭터 알파 페이드
function local_class:alpha_fade_character(character, fade_out)
	if fade_out then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')
	else
		character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어 코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.wyvern_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, #self.wyvern_names do
		self.wyvern_list:Add(get_character(self.wyvern_names[i]))
	end

	self.wyvern_old_woman = get_character(self.wyvern_old_woman_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_old_woman, vector(11, 0, -2))
	character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.wyvern_old_woman, true)

	local wyvern_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(0, 1, 0))
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(-0.1, 1.2, 0.1))
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(0.2, 1.1, -0.1))
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(0.3, 1.2, -0.2))
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(-0.3, 1, 0.2))
	wyvern_pos_list:Add(vector(0.1, 1.3, 0))

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop_shake(self.wyvern_list[i])
		character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_list[i], self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + wyvern_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_list[i], 'right')
	end

	self.ordeal = get_character(self.ordeal_name)

	self.wyvern_cabinet = get_field_object(self.wyvern_house_cabinet_name)
	self.wyvern_cabinet.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.wyvern_cauldron = get_field_object(self.wyvern_house_cauldron_name)
	self.wyvern_cauldron.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.wyvern_cookbook = get_field_object(self.wyvern_house_cookbook_name)
	self.wyvern_cookbook.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.downstair = get_field_object(self.wyvern_house_downstair_name)
	self.downstair_interactable = self.downstair.Interactable
	self.downstair.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.wyvern_house_exit = get_field_object(self.entry_wyvern_house_exit_name)
	-- Exit 사용 불가능하게 설정
	if self.wyvern_house_exit ~= nil then
		self.wyvern_house_exit_interactable = self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable
		self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end -- 방어 코드

	-- 메인 퀘스트 섹션이 10이면 할머니 이벤트가 일어나지 않도록 수정한다.
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

	if main_quest_inner_progress == 9 then
		self.is_blocking_quest = true

		character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'disabled')

		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_list[i], 'disabled')
		end
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_cookbook, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self.wyvern_list = nil
	self.wyvern_old_woman = nil

	self.wyvern_cabinet = nil
	self.wyvern_cauldron = nil
	self.wyvern_cookbook = nil

	self.downstair = nil
	self.downstair_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent) then
		self:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_event_zone_name then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_demonworld_03')

				if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
					self:setting_npcs()
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_in_event_zone_name then
				if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
					self.current_progress = self.progress_state.old_woman_wake

					-- 할머니 이동 시작
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_woman_event, self))
				elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
					-- 터치 감지 재시작
					message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
				end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_underground_event_zone_name then
			self.boiling_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_boiling_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1.5, type_priority = 'loop' })

			-- 틴트 처리
			field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 0)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.go_house_event_zone_1_name or e.Zone.Name == self.go_house_event_zone_2_name then
			if not self.is_blocking_quest and not self.is_get_exclusive_quest
					and self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_house_event then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_house_event

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_house_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_event_zone_name then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
				-- 이동 중단하고 복귀
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_house_event
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_in_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
				-- 출구 처리 때문에 터치 감지 종료
				message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.wyvern_house_underground_event_zone_name then
			if self.boiling_sfx ~= nil then
				self.boiling_sfx:FadeOut(1)
			end

			-- 틴트 해제
			field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_cabinet) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_cabinet_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_cauldron) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_cauldron_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_cookbook) then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.old_woman_sleep then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_cookbook_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_house_exit) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.close_door_event, self)
	else
		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.wyvern_list[i]) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, { key = 'demonworld_pet_wyvern_s1_14' })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_touch_event_type ~= nil then
		if e.TouchEventType == self.current_touch_event_type then
			self.qte_complete = true
		end
	elseif not self.is_detected and self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		-- 공격하면 실패
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action2TouchDown or
				e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
			-- 발각 이벤트
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.old_woman_detected_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_wyvern_old_woman, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.is_detected and e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detected_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.old_woman_detected_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	-- 섹션 10으로 넘어왔을 때
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
		self.is_blocking_quest = true

		self.wyvern_house_exit_interactable = self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable
		self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'disabled')

		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_list[i], 'disabled')
		end
	-- 섹션 11로 넘어왔을 때
	elseif e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 10 then
		self.is_blocking_quest = false

		self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable = self.wyvern_house_exit_interactable

		character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'enabled')

		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_list[i], 'enabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	self.is_get_exclusive_quest = true

	if e.Key ~= self.my_quest_key then
		if e.Fade then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_old_woman, true))

			for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_list[i], true))
			end
		else
			character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'disabled')

			for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_list[i], 'disabled')
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	self.is_get_exclusive_quest = false

	if e.Fade then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_old_woman, false))

		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.alpha_fade_character, self, self.wyvern_list[i], false))
		end
	else
		character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_old_woman, 1, 0)

		for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.wyvern_list[i], 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_list[i], 1, 0)
		end
	end
end

-- 캐릭터 알파 페이드
function local_class:alpha_fade_character(character, fade_out)
	if fade_out then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_active_state(character, 'disabled')
	else
		character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

-- 요리책 생성하고 위치 설정하는 이벤트
function local_class:drop_cookbook()
	local cookbook = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.cookbook_item_id, notforinven = true,
	                                              pos = self.wyvern_cookbook.Position,
	                                              lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	cookbook:SetSortingLayer(true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	cookbook.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.7, 0)
end

-- Exit에 상호작용하면 문이 닫혀 있다고 나레이션 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:close_door_event()
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('demonworld_pet_wyvern_s1_15'), 0, 1))

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

-- 집 밖으로 나오면 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:go_house_event()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, {'pause_car_logic'}))

	camera_util.move(vector(15, 0, -2), 2)

	character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
			8 / 3, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_list[i], self.wyvern_list[i].Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
				8 / 3, nil, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(8 / 3)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move(vector(15, 0, 4), 2)

	character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
			2, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_list[i], self.wyvern_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
				2, nil, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
			5 / 3, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_list[i], self.wyvern_list[i].Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
				5 / 3, nil, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(5 / 3)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_old_woman, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_old_woman, self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_list[i], 0, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to(self.wyvern_list[i], self.wyvern_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
				0.5, nil, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 2, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	-- Exit 복구
	if self.wyvern_house_exit ~= nil then
		self.wyvern_house_exit.Interactable = self.wyvern_house_exit_interactable
	end

	self:setting_npcs()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, {'resume_car_logic'}))
end

-- NPC 세팅
function local_class:setting_npcs()
	local house_center_marker = field:GetMarker(self.house_center_marker_name)
	local wyvern_jail_marker = field:GetMarker(self.wyvern_jail_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_old_woman, house_center_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, house_center_marker.direction)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_old_woman, 1, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, true)

	for i = 0, self.wyvern_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 3)
		local mod2 = i % 2
		local mod3 = i % 3

		character_util.add_listener(self.wyvern_list[i], self.controller)
		character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_list[i],
				wyvern_jail_marker.position + vector(-2 + 2 * mod3, 0, 2 - 4 * val))

		if mod2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_list[i], 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_list[i], 'left')
		end

		character_util.shake(self.wyvern_list[i], 0.04, 9999)
		character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_list[i], { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wyvern_list[i], 1, 0)
	end
end

-- 할머니 이동 시작
function local_class:old_woman_event()
	-- 터치 감지 시작
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	self.wyvern_old_woman.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
			self.wyvern_old_woman, self.detected_event, 3, 60)

	self.wyvern_old_woman.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'doyagao' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.wyvern_old_woman, { key = self.main_script..1 })

	-- 발각된 경우와 나간 경우를 처리하기 위해 매 프레임마다 확인
	local timer = 0
	local wait_duration = 1

	while timer < wait_duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	-- 좌로 2.5칸 이동
	coroutine.yield(self:old_woman_move_frame(
			self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 2.5))

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'tired' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wyvern_old_woman, { key = self.main_script..2 })

	-- 2초 대기
	timer = 0
	wait_duration = 2

	while timer < wait_duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman)

	-- 위로 4칸 이동
	coroutine.yield(self:old_woman_move_frame(
			self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(0, 0, 4), 4))

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'cast' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wyvern_old_woman, { key = self.main_script..3 })

	-- 2초 대기
	timer = 0
	wait_duration = 2

	while timer < wait_duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 우로 1칸 이동
	coroutine.yield(self:old_woman_move_frame(
			self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1))

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	-- 좌로 1칸 이동
	coroutine.yield(self:old_woman_move_frame(
			self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1))

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'tired' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.wyvern_old_woman, { key = self.main_script..4 })

	-- 3초 대기
	timer = 0
	wait_duration = 3

	while timer < wait_duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 좌로 1.5칸, y축으로 0.5칸 이동
	character_util.jump(self.wyvern_old_woman, 0.5, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(self:old_woman_move_frame(
			self.wyvern_old_woman.Position + vector(-1.5, 0.5, 0), 0.5))

	if self.is_detected or not self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman)

	-- 2초 대기
	timer = 0
	wait_duration = 2

	while timer < wait_duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 수면과 동시에 Progress State 넘어감
	if timer >= wait_duration and self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.old_woman_sleep

		self.wyvern_old_woman.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		self.wyvern_old_woman.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'sleep' })

		self.wyvern_cookbook.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		-- 터치 감지 종료
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	else
		-- 이동 중단하고 복귀
		local house_center_marker = field:GetMarker(self.house_center_marker_name)

		character_util.set_position(self.wyvern_old_woman, house_center_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, house_center_marker.direction)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.wyvern_old_woman)
	end
end

-- 매 프레임 이동, 발각되거나 Progress State 변경되면 중단
function local_class:old_woman_move_frame(pos, duration)
	local timer = 0
	local start_pos = self.wyvern_old_woman.Position
	local end_pos = pos

	character_util.set_direction(self.wyvern_old_woman, (end_pos - start_pos):ToDirection())
	character_util.set_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman, { name = 'walk' })

	while timer < duration and not self.is_detected and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.old_woman_wake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)

		self.wyvern_old_woman.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if timer >= duration then
		self.wyvern_old_woman.Position = end_pos
		character_util.remove_anim(self.wyvern_old_woman)
	end
end
