function local_class:phone_booth_ringing(phone_booth)
	if self.is_calling_phone_booth then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local ringing_time = 1.5
	self.is_calling_phone_booth = true
	while self.is_calling_phone_booth do
		-- 부스 울리는 도중에 경고뜨면 안눌리게
		if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_haunted_house_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = phone_booth })
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(phone_booth.Transform, 0.2, 0.4))

			local time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < ringing_time and self.is_calling_phone_booth do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:phone_ringing(bench, trans)
	if self.is_calling_phone_booth then
		return
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_calling_phone_booth = true
	while self.is_calling_phone_booth do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_phone_receive_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = bench })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(trans, 0.1, 0.2))
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_target_circle_loop()
	self.get_fx_target_circle_end()
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood()
	self.get_dead_effect()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	-- 휴대폰 Dispose
	self:dispose_item_phone()

	-- 스나이퍼 에임 Dispose
	self:dispose_sniper_attack_range()

	-- res_holder Dispose
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	-- 폰부스 NonInteractable로 변경
	local phone_booth = self.controller.get_phone_booth()
	phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_sniper_attack_range()

		self.sniper_attack_range = nil
	end

function local_class:dispose_item_phone()
	if self.item_phone == nil then
		return
	end

	self.item_phone:ConsumeComplete()
	self.item_phone = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	local phone_booth = self.controller.get_phone_booth()
	local phone_booth_bench = self.controller.get_phone_booth_bench()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, phone_booth) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.none then
		-- 파트 진행 안했으면서 폰부스에 Interact
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_phone_booth, self, phone_booth)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, phone_booth_bench) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_one then
		-- 파트1 진행중이면서 밴치에 Interact
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_part_one, self, phone_booth_bench))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.controller.hang_phone_booth_zone) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.none then
		-- 파트가 none일 때 전화벨 울려주는 역할
		local phone_booth = self.controller.get_phone_booth()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.phone_booth_ringing, self, phone_booth))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, succubus, self.phone_booth_succubus_hide_zone) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_one then
		-- 파트 1 진행 중이면서 서큐버스가 존 안에 들어왔을 때
		self.controller.cur_part_one_state = self.controller.part_one_state.hide
		if self.sniper_attack_range ~= nil then
			self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
		end
		if self.sniper_attack_range_part1 ~= nil then
			self.sniper_attack_range_part1:Show(0)
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.phone_booth_part_two_zone) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_two then
		-- 파트2 진행중이면서 청소부 존엔터
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_part_two, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.phone_booth_part_three_zone) and self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_three then
		-- 파트3 진행중이면서 아이들쪽 존엔터
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_part_three, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.controller.hang_phone_booth_zone) then
		return false
	end

	if self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.none then
		self.is_calling_phone_booth = false
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_one then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_event_zone, self)
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_one then
		self.is_escape_area_play_progress = true
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_two then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sniping_leader, self, user_party.Leader, 2)
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_two then
		self.is_escape_area_play_progress = true
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.part_three then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sniping_leader, self, user_party.Leader, 1)
		return true
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_three then
		self.is_escape_area_play_progress = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:leave_event_zone()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'demonworld_phonebooth_166' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'demonworld_phonebooth_choose_8', 'mercy' }
	, { 'demonworld_phonebooth_choose_9', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		-- 초기 상태로 초기화
		self:dispose_item_phone()
		self.is_calling_phone_booth = false
		self.controller.cur_part_state = self.controller.part_state.none

		local phone_booth = self.controller.get_phone_booth()
		phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local phone_booth_bench = self.controller.get_phone_booth_bench()
		phone_booth_bench.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.my_quest_key, false))
	else
		local center_pos = self.get_escape_center_marker().position
		local pos
		if center_pos.z > user_party.Leader.Position.z then
			pos = vector(0, 0, 2.5)
		else
			pos = vector(0, 0, -2.5)
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + pos, 2, false)
	end
end

function local_class:sniping_leader(target, sniper_index)
	local save_weapon = user_party.Leader.Weapon1
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	self:equip_phone_leader(user_party.Leader)

	-- 아직 게임 중이야, 내 친구.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
	self:show_voice_bubble(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 171, true)

	-- 멋대로 나가는건 용서못해.
	self:show_voice_bubble(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 172, true)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.choose_key .. 10, 'brutal' }
	, { self.choose_key .. 11, 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		local sniper_pos = self.get_sniper_marker(sniper_index).position
		self:dispose_sniper_attack_range()

		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		if self.sniper_attack_range == nil then
			self.sniper_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(sniper_pos, vector(50, 0))
		end
		self:show_aim_not_loop(target.Bounds.center, sniper_pos)
		self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target.Bounds.center)
		self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood():Instantiate(target.Bounds.center)
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, { name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		local center_pos = self.get_escape_center_marker().position
		local pos
		if center_pos.z > target.Position.z then
			pos = self.get_escape_return_marker(2).position
		else
			pos = self.get_escape_return_marker(1).position
		end
		user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon)
		user_party.Leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

		party_util.align_party(pos, 'right', 0)
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'prostrate' })
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(target, 'left', 2, nil, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		local center_pos = self.get_escape_center_marker().position
		local pos
		if center_pos.z > user_party.Leader.Position.z then
			pos = vector(0, 0, 2.5)
		else
			pos = vector(0, 0, -2.5)
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + pos, 2, false)
		user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon)
		user_party.Leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_one then
		local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, succubus) then
			-- 체력이 0이하로 내려가면 stun 상태로 변경 아니면 누가 좀 살려줘요! 텍스트 출력
			if e.HpBefore <= 1 then
				self.controller.cur_part_one_state = self.controller.part_one_state.stun
			else
				if not self.is_damaged_talking then
					self.is_damaged_talking = true
					-- 누가 좀 살려줘요!
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.damaged_npc_talk, self, succubus, 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_2', '01_linda_scream_01', true))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_state == self.controller.part_state.progress_part_two then
		local sweeper = self.controller.get_sweeper()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, sweeper) then
			if e.HpBefore <= 1 then
				self.controller.cur_part_two_state = self.controller.part_two_state.kill
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')
			else
				if not self.is_damaged_talking then
					self.is_damaged_talking = true
					-- 악! 당신 뭐야?
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.damaged_npc_talk, self, sweeper, 'demonworld_phonebooth_interact_10', '01_villain_scream_04', false))
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e.Info.target.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalObjectDamagedBehaviour) then
			-- 쓰레기봉투가 터졌으면 garbage_bomb 상태로 변경
			local garbage = self.get_garbage()
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, garbage) and garbage.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
				self.controller.cur_part_two_state = self.controller.part_two_state.garbage_bomb
				self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(garbage.Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:damaged_npc_talk(target, key, sfx_key, is_remove_ani)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_key)

	if is_remove_ani then
		character_util.remove_anim(target)
	end
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, { key = key, life_time = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.is_damaged_talking = false
end

function local_class:interact_phone_booth(phone_booth)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.is_calling_phone_booth = false

	local phone_box_center = vector_util.get_x0z(phone_booth.Bounds.center)
	party_util.align_party(phone_box_center + vector(0, 0, -0.25), 'down', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75), 3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(leader, vector(0, 0.4, 0.1), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'attack' })

	local offset = vector(2.7, 0, 2.25)
	-- 안녕하세요, {0}씨죠?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_receive_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = { self.string_key .. 1, user.Name }, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 축하드려요! 당신은 오늘 최고의 행운아 이벤트에 당첨되셨습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 2, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 간단한 미니 게임에 응해주시면 100000 잼을 보상으로 드려요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 3, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 어때요? 참여하시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 4, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 선택지) 물론이죠! / 수상해…
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.choose_key .. 1, 'mercy' }
	, { self.choose_key .. 2, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- 에이… 이런 기회 다시 없는데.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 5, offset = offset, skip = true })

		-- 혹시 마음이 바뀌면 다시 말씀해주세요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 6, offset = offset, skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_call_fail_01')
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.75), 1, nil, false, true)
		user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.phone_booth_ringing, self, phone_booth))
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 시작, npc 제거 및 ExclusiveQuestStartEvent
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.my_quest_key, false))

	-- 탁월한 선택이세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 7, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 그럼 첫 임무는 간단하게!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 8, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 이 공원 어딘가에 있는 벤치에 핸드폰이 울리고 있어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 9, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 그 핸드폰을 찾아 응답해주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(phone_booth, { key = self.string_key .. 10, offset = offset, skip = true })

	-- 폰부스 인터렉트 막기
	phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 핸드폰 생성
	self:create_smart_phone()

	-- 부스에서 나온다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_call_fail_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.75), 1, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 파트1 시작
	self.controller.cur_part_state = self.controller.part_state.part_one
end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		succubus.SpineController:AddColor('phone_booth_succubus', unity_color({ self.add_color, self.add_color, self.add_color, 1 }), 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 유저가 탈출해서 실패한거면 페이드 인 / 아웃으로 옮겨준다.
		if self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			party_util.align_party(self.get_succubus_marker(3).position, 'left', 0, 'linear')
			self:equip_phone_leader(leader)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		else
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
			-- 파티를 방향에 맞춰 정렬
			is_left = leader.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			character_util.set_direction(leader, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
			local add_pos = is_left and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right
			party_util.align_party(leader.Position + add_pos, (is_left and 'right' or 'left'), 0.5, 'linear')
			self:equip_phone_leader(leader)
		end

		-- 목소리 : 크크크크! 그래, 그렇지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 69, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 용사님 얼굴을 하고 있지만, 위급한 상황엔 평민 하나 쯤 죽는 것, 아무것도 아니지?!
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 70, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 즐거워! TV 를 보자마자 알았어..!
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 71, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 너와 나는 동류니까…!
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 72, is_left)
	end

	-- 목소리 : …게임을 계속하지.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 73, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 이번엔 이 공원을 깨끗하게 하는 분들에게 감사를 표해볼까.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 74, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 청소부를 찾아.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 75, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 잊지마. 게임의 컨트롤러는 내가 쥐고 있다는 것을.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 76, is_left)

	-- 01_amb_city_01 재생
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_city_01', loop = true
	, fade_in_time = 2, fade_out_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 리더 무기 원래대로 돌리고 애니메이션 풀어줌
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon)
	leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	self:dispose_sniper_attack_range()

	if not self.sniper_attack_range_part1 then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.sniper_attack_range_part1)
		self.sniper_attack_range_part1 = nil
	end

	-- 컨트롤 돌려줌
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:show_aim_not_loop(pos, sniper_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
	local aim_loop = self.get_fx_target_circle_loop():Instantiate(pos)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.sniper_attack_range, sniper_pos, (vector_util.get_x0z(pos - sniper_pos)).normalized, self.attack_range_height)
	attack_range_util.show(self.sniper_attack_range, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	aim_loop:Dispose()
	self.get_fx_target_circle_end():Instantiate(pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_08')
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			bullet_sprite.transform.position, target_pos, -1, nil, 50, false)
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:show_voice_bubble(target, key, is_left, bubble_type)
	bubble_type = lua_helper.get_or_default(bubble_type, 'talk')
	local offset
	local direction
	if is_left then
		offset = vector(-2.2, 0, 1.3)
		direction = 'lt'
	else
		offset = vector(2.4, 0, 1.3)
		direction = 'rt'
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = key, skip = true
	, bubble_direction = direction, offset = offset, bubble_type = bubble_type })
end

-- 무기를 핸드폰으로 바꿈
function local_class:equip_phone_leader(leader)
	leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'maiden_phone')
	leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_idle' })
end

function local_class:start_timer(duration)
	self.is_timer_start = true
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer)
	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, duration, nil)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true))
end

function local_class:stop_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:progress_part_two()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 파트2 진행
	self.controller.cur_part_state = self.controller.part_state.progress_part_two

	local sweeper = self.controller.get_sweeper()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(sweeper.Position - leader.Position)
	local is_left = direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_direction(leader, is_left and 'left' or 'right')

	-- 컨트롤 멈추고 카메라 이동 청소부가 청소하며 이동하는 것을 보여줌.
	camera_util.move_async(sweeper.Position, 1)

	-- 청소부 : 어우, 청소하기 싫어…
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sweeper, { key = self.string_key .. 77, skip = true })

	-- 쓰레기 차는 연출
	local garbage = self.get_garbage()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(garbage, true))

	garbage.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local garbage_pos = sweeper.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	garbage.Position = garbage_pos
	self:chest_scale_big(garbage, 1)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim(sweeper)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(sweeper, self.get_sweeper_marker(2).position, 2, false
	, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(sweeper, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 카메라가 다시 리더한테 돌아간다
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	local save_weapon = leader.Weapon1
	self:equip_phone_leader(leader)

	-- 목소리 : 저것 봐. 참 고마우신 분이지.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 78, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 저렇게 묵묵히 자기 일을 해주시는 분이 계셔서 아름다운 마계가 유지되는거야.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 79, is_left)

	-- 목소리 :  …그래서 정말 유감이지.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 80, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 이대로가면 청소부 어르신께서 <b>우리</b>가 죽인 안드로이드를 발견할테니까.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 81, is_left)

	-- 목소리 : 그럼 시끄럽고 골치아파질 거란 말이지.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 82, is_left)

	-- 목소리 :  …내가 하고 싶은 말은 알겠지?
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 83, is_left)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	-- 목소리 : 네가 처리해.
	self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 84, is_left)

	if self.controller.cur_part_one_state == self.controller.part_one_state.stun then
		-- 목소리 : 아까 그 여자에게 했던 것 같은 애들 장난은 통하지 않을테니 헛수고는 하지 않는게 좋아.
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 85, is_left)
	elseif self.controller.cur_part_one_state == self.controller.part_one_state.hide then
		-- 목소리 : …그렇지 않으면 내가 할테니까.
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 86, is_left)
	end

	-- 청소부에게 저격 스코프 박히고 청소부 천천히 아까 시체가 있던 곳으로 이동 시작. 이번엔 오브젝트에 막히는 것 없음.
	local sniper_pos = self.get_sniper_marker(2).position
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
	local follow_aim = self.get_fx_target_circle_loop():Instantiate(sweeper.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, sweeper.Transform)
	self.sniper_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(sniper_pos, vector(50, 0))

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.sniper_attack_range, sniper_pos, (vector_util.get_x0z(sweeper.Position - sniper_pos)).normalized, self.attack_range_height)
	attack_range_util.show(self.sniper_attack_range, 0)

	-- 청소부 때릴 수 있도록 변경
	local exp = sweeper.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Exp
	local entity_group = sweeper.EntityGroup

	sweeper.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(0)
	sweeper.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
	sweeper.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0

	sweeper.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
	sweeper.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor('ConstantMonster', 0)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(sweeper, self.controller)
	sweeper.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	character_util.set_immortal(sweeper, true)
	character_util.set_death_type(sweeper, 'prostrate')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(sweeper, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(sweeper)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, save_weapon)
	leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.controller.cur_part_two_state = self.controller.part_two_state.fail

	-- 청소부가 시체 주변으로 이동
	local start_pos = self.get_sweeper_marker(2).position
	local end_pos = self.get_sweeper_marker(3).position

	character_util.remove_anim(sweeper)
	character_util.set_anim(sweeper, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
	local time_passed = 0.0
	local move_time = 6
	self.is_escape_area_play_progress = false
	while time_passed <= move_time do
		if self.controller.cur_part_two_state ~= self.controller.part_two_state.fail
				or self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			break
		end

		local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, move_time)
		local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, move_time)
		sweeper.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	follow_aim:Dispose()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(sweeper)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(sweeper, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	sweeper.EntityGroup = entity_group
	sweeper.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)
	sweeper.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sweeper)

	local magnitude = vector_util.get_x0z(sweeper.Position - leader.Position).magnitude
	local is_near = magnitude <= 1

	is_left = false
	-- 1. 아무 행동도 하지 않고 청소부가 아래로 내려옴
	if self.controller.cur_part_two_state == self.controller.part_two_state.fail then
		sweeper.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		camera_util.move_async(sweeper.Position, 0.5)

		-- 유저가 탈출해서 실패한거면 대사 없이 바로 쏴서죽음
		if not self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			-- 청소부 : ...응?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sweeper, { key = self.string_key .. 88, skip = true })

			-- 청소부 : 이, 이건…!!!
			character_util.set_direction(sweeper, 'down')
			character_util.set_emotion(sweeper, { name = 'surprise' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sweeper, { key = self.string_key .. 89, skip = true })
		end

		-- 청소부 사망 사망 모션
		self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, sweeper.Bounds.center)
		self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood():Instantiate(sweeper.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, sweeper.Transform)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
		character_util.set_direction(sweeper, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(sweeper)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sweeper, { name = 'dead1', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		sweeper.SpineController:AddColor('phone_booth_sweeper', unity_color({ self.add_color, self.add_color, self.add_color, 1 }), 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 유저가 탈출해서 실패한거면 페이드 인 / 아웃으로 옮겨준다.
		if self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
			party_util.align_party(self.get_sweeper_marker(1).position, 'right', 0, 'linear')
			self:equip_phone_leader(leader)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		else
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
			direction = vector_util.to_direction(sweeper.Position - leader.Position)
			is_left = direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			character_util.set_direction(leader, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
			local add_pos = is_left and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right
			if is_near then
				add_pos = add_pos + (is_left and unity_class.vector3.left or unity_class.vector3.right)
			end
			party_util.align_party(leader.Position + add_pos, (is_left and 'right' or 'left'), 0.5, 'linear')
			self:equip_phone_leader(leader)
		end

		-- 목소리 : 크크크크! 그래, 그거지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 90, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 네가 저 불쌍한 노동자를 도울 이유가 뭐가 있어?!
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 91, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 재미도 없고, 퀘스트 보상이 있는 것도 아닌데 말이지.
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 92, is_left)

		-- 목소리 : 즐거워...우리 정말 천생연분인 것 같아, 내 사랑.
		self:show_voice_bubble(leader, self.string_key .. 93, is_left)

	elseif self.controller.cur_part_two_state == self.controller.part_two_state.kill then
		sweeper.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

		-- 청소부 : 왜, 왜…
		self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sweeper, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sweeper, { key = self.string_key .. 94, skip = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(sweeper, { name = 'damaged' })
		sweeper.SpineController:AddColor('phone_booth_sweeper', unity_color({ self.add_color, self.add_color, self.add_color, 1 }), 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		direction = vector_util.to_direction(sweeper.Position - leader.Position)
		is_left = direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.set_direction(leader, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
		local add_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
		if is_near then
			add_pos = add_pos + (is_left and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left)
		end
		party_util.align_party(sweeper.Position + add_pos, (is_left and 'right' or 'left'), 0.5, 'linear')
		self:equip_phone_leader(leader)

function local_class:garbage_bomb_direct(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gather_bush_02')
	local item_id_list = { 20094, 20200, 20173, 20033, 20257, 20009 }
	local end_post_list = { self.get_sweeper_marker(1).position + unity_class.vector3.forward
	, pos + vector(-0.8, 0, -1.05)
	, pos + vector(-1, 0, 0.5)
	, pos + vector(1, 0, -0.4)
	, pos + vector(1., 0, 1)
	, pos + vector(-0.2, 0, 1.2) }

	self.controller.garbage_item_list = {}
	for i = 1, #item_id_list do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = pos,
				  target = end_post_list[i],
				  itemid = item_id_list[i],
				  notforinven = true,
				  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		table.insert(self.controller.garbage_item_list, drop_item)
	end
end

function local_class:chest_scale_big(target, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		target.Transform.localScale = vector(progress, progress, progress)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	target.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
end

	leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	-- 컨트롤 품
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 쥐 폭탄 움직이기 시작. 적당히 빠르게. 아이들에게 7 초 정도에 도달하도록.

	local end_pos = self.get_mouse_bomb_route_marker(2).position

	bomb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_bomb_fuse_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, parent = mouse_bomb })
	self.controller.cur_part_three_state = self.controller.part_three_state.fail
	self.is_escape_area_play_progress = false

	local time_limit = 6
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= time_limit do
		if self.controller.cur_part_three_state ~= self.controller.part_three_state.fail
				or self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			break
		end

		local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_move_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_move_pos.x, time_limit)
		local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_move_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_move_pos.z, time_limit)
		mouse_bomb.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(mouse_bomb.Bounds, leader.Bounds) then
			self.controller.cur_part_three_state = self.controller.part_three_state.success
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	wheel_sfx:Stop()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	is_left = false
	if self.controller.cur_part_three_state == self.controller.part_three_state.fail then
		if self.is_escape_area_play_progress then
			mouse_bomb.Position = end_pos
		end

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 폰부스 위치
	self.get_phone_booth = function() return get_field_object('phone_booth') end

	-- 스타피스 이팩트 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end

	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	-- 스타피스
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('phone_booth_star_piece') end

	-- 인터렉트 했는지?
	self.is_interact = false

	-- 지급할 마계 달러량
	self.add_demon_dollar = 6000

end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	local phone_booth = self.get_phone_booth()
	phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(phone_booth.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_star_piece_effect()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:dispose_star_piece_effect()

	local phone_booth = self.get_phone_booth()
	phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local phone_booth = self.get_phone_booth()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, phone_booth) and not self.is_interact then
		self.is_interact = true
		phone_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.drop_star_piece, self, phone_booth)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:drop_star_piece(phone_booth)
	self:dispose_star_piece_effect()

	local pos = phone_booth.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	-- 달러 지급
	local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
	local dollar_data = require('utils/DemonWorldDollarData')

	demon_world_dollar:add_dollar_async(dollar_data.demonworld_phonebooth, false, { pos = pos, target_pos = pos - vector(1.5, 0, 0.7) })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, phone_booth.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false, false)
end

-- 스타피스 이팩트 dispose
function local_class:dispose_star_piece_effect()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	self.evil_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.evil_fx_name)

	self.plague_doc = get_character('plague_doctor')
	self.master_default = field:GetMarker('master_pos')

	self.faint_marker = field:GetMarker('restaurant_faint')

	character_util.set_with_marker(self.master, self.master_default)
	character_util.add_listener(self.master, self.controller)
	self.master.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.5, 1.7))

	self.seat_pos = {
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_5'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_6'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_7'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_8'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_9'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_10'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_11'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_12'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_13'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_14'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_15'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_16'),
	}

	self.path_pos = {
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_3'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_4'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_5'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_6'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_7'),
		field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_8'),
	}

	self.hostage = get_character('basement_guy')
	self.basement_center = field:GetMarker('basement_center').position
	character_util.set_with_marker(self.hostage, field:GetMarker('hostage_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(self.hostage, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hostage, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})

	self.master.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self.hostage.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self.plague_doc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

function local_class:start()
	self.sofa = self.controller.sofa

	for i, fo in ipairs(self.sofa) do
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debugger, self))
end

function local_class:debugger()
	character_util.set_position(self.player, vector(-61, 0, 33))
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.basement_grid_name) then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.basement_grid_name) then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		for i, fo in ipairs(self.sofa) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fo) then
				if self:seat_interact(i) then return true end
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.master) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_master, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hostage) and self.ordered_pasta then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_basement, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--region restaurant

function local_class:talk_with_master()
	character_util.set_direction(self.master, 'left')
	--마스터: 안녕하세요, 날씨가 참 좋죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})
	--마스터: 주문은 자리에서 부탁드리겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	character_util.set_direction(self.master, 'down')
end

function local_class:seat_interact(index)
	local pos = self.player.Position

	valid = index
	local split = (self.seat_pos[index].position.z + self.seat_pos[index + 6].position.z) / 2
	if pos.z < split then
		valid = index + 6
	end
	if not self.ordered_pasta then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_sit, self, valid))
		return true
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.final_pasta, self, valid, true))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:restaurant_sit(index, is_up)
	if self.is_event then return end

	self.is_event = true
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local storage_front = field:GetMarker('storage_front').position
	is_up = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_up, index < 7)
	local up = is_up and 1 or -1
	local marker = self.seat_pos[index]

	yield_return_func(self.jump_up_seat, self, index)

	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_start').position
	local path_index = math.floor((index - 1) / 2) + 1
	local path_pos = self.path_pos[path_index].position
	local route = {start_pos}
	if index > 6 then
		table.insert(route, vector(start_pos.x, 0, path_pos.z))
		table.insert(route, path_pos)
	else
		table.insert(route, vector(start_pos.x, 0, path_pos.z))
		table.insert(route, path_pos)
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, route,
			5, false, 'stop', 'floor', self.path_pos[path_index].direction)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마스터: 어떤 레스토랑입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
	--마스터: 무엇을 주문하시겠습니까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	local food_index = -1
	while true do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
		food_index = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ self.talk_name .. 'food_1', 'intellect' },
			{ self.talk_name .. 'food_2', 'intellect' },
			{ self.talk_name .. 'food_3', 'intellect' },
			{ self.talk_name .. 'food_4', 'brutal' }})

		if food_index < 4 then
			break
		end

		--마스터: 궁금한 것이 많은 손님 분이시군요…?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
		--마스터: 제가 답해드릴 수 있는 거라면 뭐든지 말씀드리죠.
		character_util.remove_anim(self.master)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

		while true do
			character_util.remove_anim(self.master)
			local ask_index = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ self.talk_name .. 'ask_1', 'mercy' },
				{ self.talk_name .. 'ask_2', 'intellect' },
				{ self.talk_name .. 'ask_3', 'brutal' },
				{ self.talk_name .. 'ask_4', 'normal' }})

			if ask_index == 1 then
				--선택지: 주변에 실종된 사람들에 대해 묻는다.
				--마스터: 글쎄요, 그런 소문은 처음 듣습니다만.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'question', loop = false})
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'answer_' .. ask_index, skip = true})
			elseif ask_index == 2 then
				--선택지: 여기서 뭘 하고 있는지 묻는다.
				--마스터: 보시다시피 평범한 레스토랑입니다.
				character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'answer_' .. ask_index, skip = true})
			elseif ask_index == 3 then
				--선택지: 네가 범인이지?
				--마스터: 범… 인? 뭔가 요즘 유행하는 놀이인가요?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'question', loop = false})
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'answer_' .. ask_index, skip = true})
			else
				--선택지: 더 묻고 싶은 것이 없다.
				--마스터: 그거 다행이군요.
				character_util.nod_twice(self.master)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'answer_' .. ask_index, skip = true})
				--마스터: 그럼 무엇을 주문하시겠습니까?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'answer_' .. (ask_index+1), skip = true})
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if food_index == 3 then
		self.ordered_pasta = true
		character_util.set_emotion(self.master, {name = 'smile'})
		--마스터: 오, 탁월한 선택이군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'pasta_0', skip = true})
		--마스터: 사실 그 메뉴가 저희 레스토랑 최고 인기메뉴입니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'pasta_1', skip = true})
	end
	--마스터: 잠시만 기다려주시겠습니까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.master)

	local back_route = {}
	table.insert(back_route, vector(start_pos.x, 0, path_pos.z))
	table.insert(back_route, start_pos)
	table.insert(back_route, self.master_default.position)
	table.insert(back_route, storage_front)
	table.insert(back_route, storage_front + vector(0, 0, 5))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, back_route,
			5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	table.insert(route, 1, storage_front)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_chickenhouse_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'gauntlet_walk'})
	self.master.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", self.item_pool[food_index][1])

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, route,
			4, false, 'stop', 'floor', self.path_pos[path_index].direction)

	--TODO 음식 내려놓는 연출
	character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'})

	--마스터: 주문하신 {음식 이름} 나왔습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 'food_serve_' .. food_index, skip = true})

	local food = self:give_food(food_index, direction_util.to_vector3(self.path_pos[path_index].direction) * 0.6)

	yield_return_func(self.eat_food, self, food)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = self.talk_name .. 'food_desc_' .. food_index, mintotalduration = 1})

	local food_reaction = {
		{'nod', 'smile', 'happy'},
		{'sing', 'sing', 'heart'},
		{'seat', 'damaged', 'angry'}
	}

	if food_index == 3 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.shake(self.player, 0.03, 0.3)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player,
			{name = food_reaction[food_index][1], upper = true},
			{name = food_reaction[food_index][2]})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.player, nil, food_reaction[food_index][3])
	character_util.remove_anim(self.player, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)

	if food_index < 3 then
		-- 음식을 잘 먹은 경우
		yield_return_func(self.jump_down_seat, self, index)
		--character_util.set_direction(self.player, vector_util.to_direction(vector(0, 0, up)))
		--character_util.jump_move(self.player, marker.position + vector(0, 0, up),
		--		2, 1, true, marker.direction)

		character_util.look_at(self.player, self.master)
		character_util.look_at(self.master, self.player)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--마스터: 맛있게 드셨습니까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		--마스터: 다음에 또 들려주시기 바랍니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

		local temp_pos = path_pos
		table.remove(back_route)
		table.remove(back_route)
		table.remove(back_route, 1)
		if index%3==2 or (index%2==1 and index%3==0)then
			temp_pos = path_pos + vector(0, 0, up * 0.5)
		end
		table.insert(back_route, 1, vector(start_pos.x, 0, temp_pos.z))
		table.insert(back_route, 1, temp_pos)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, back_route,
				5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

		self.current_seat = -1
	else
		-- 파스타를 먹은 경우
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		--마스터: 맛있게 드셨습니까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'mad'})
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.master, {name = 'tired'})

		--마스터: 죄송합니다. 다시 만들겠습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})

		--마스터: 돈은 안 내셔도 됩니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.master)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, back_route,
				5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
		character_util.add_listener(self.hostage, self.controller)

		local wait_index = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ self.talk_name .. 'wait_1', 'normal' },
			{ self.talk_name .. 'wait_2', 'intellect' }})
		self.is_event = false

		if wait_index == 1 then
			yield_return_func(self.final_pasta, self, index, false)
		else
			yield_return_func(self.jump_down_seat, self, index)
			--마스터: 이제 곧 완성입니다. 자리에서 기다려주세요.
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.master, self.controller)
			self.master.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 'wait_pasta'
			character_util.set_with_marker(self.master, field:GetMarker('master_storage_pos'))
			character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'eat'})
		end
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.is_event = false
end

function local_class:jump_up_seat(index)
	self.current_seat = index

	local marker = self.seat_pos[index]
	local pos = self.player.Position
	is_up = index < 7
	local up = is_up and 1 or -1
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(marker.direction)

	local route = {}
	if pos.z * up < marker.position.z * up + 0.5 then
		table.insert(route, vector(pos.x, 0, marker.position.z + up))
	end
	table.insert(route, marker.position + vector(0, 0, up))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.player, route, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor')

	character_util.set_direction(self.player, marker.direction)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'smile'})

	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(member, {
			vector(marker.position.x - (dir.x * (i + 0.5)) * 0.6, 0, member.Position.z),
			marker.position - vector((dir.x * (i + 0.5)) * 0.6, 0, 0),
		}, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', marker.direction)
	end
	character_util.jump(self.player, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.player, marker.position + vector(0, 0.45, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, false)

	character_util.set_direction(self.player, marker.direction)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'idle'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
end

function local_class:jump_down_seat(index)
	local marker = self.seat_pos[index]
	is_up = index < 7
	local up = is_up and 1 or -1

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, vector_util.to_direction(vector(0, 0, up)))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.player, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.player, marker.position + vector(0, 0, up),
			nil, 2, true, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, marker.direction)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player, true)
	self.current_seat = -1
end

function local_class:final_pasta(index, back)
	if self.is_event then return end

	self.is_event = true
	if back then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local wait_index = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ self.talk_name .. 'wait_1', 'normal' },
			{ self.talk_name .. 'wait_2', 'intellect' }
		})

		if wait_index == 2 then
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			self.is_event = false
			return
		end

		yield_return_func(self.jump_up_seat, self, index)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.master)
	local storage_front = field:GetMarker('storage_front').position
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('restaurant_path_start').position
	local path_index = math.floor((index - 1) / 2) + 1
	local path_pos = self.path_pos[path_index].position
	local route = {
		storage_front,
		start_pos
	}
	if index < 3 then
		table.insert(route, vector(path_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		table.insert(route, path_pos)
	elseif index < 5 then
		table.insert(route, vector(start_pos.x, 0, path_pos.z))
		table.insert(route, path_pos)
	else
		table.insert(route, vector(start_pos.x, 0, path_pos.z))
		table.insert(route, path_pos)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_chickenhouse_01')
	-- TODO 그 파스타를 들고 오는 마스터...
	character_util.set_anim(self.master, {name = 'gauntlet_walk'})
	self.master.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", self.item_pool[3][1])

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.master, route,
			5, false, 'stop', 'floor', self.path_pos[path_index].direction)


	--TODO 어질어질한 맛
	local food = self:give_food(3, direction_util.to_vector3(self.path_pos[path_index].direction) * 0.6)

	--마스터: 자, 다시 드셔보시죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.master, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})

	yield_return_func(self.eat_food, self, food)


	--나레이션박스: 이번엔 멀쩡한 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = self.talk_name .. 'pasta_end_0'})
	--나레이션박스: 갑자기 눈 앞이 흐려진다.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = self.talk_name .. 'pasta_end_1'})
	--fade out
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

function local_class:give_food(item, dirv)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.master)
	self.master.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", 'empty')

	local timer = 0.5
	local offset = direction_util.to_vector3(self.player.Direction) * 0.8
	local init_pos = vector(self.player.Position.x + offset.x, 0.6, self.master.Position.z + dirv.z * 0.5)
	local destination = vector_util.get_x0z(self.player.Position, 0.6) + offset
	local drop = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = init_pos,
											 itemid = self.item_pool[item][2], notforinven = true, skip_text = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
	drop.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if dirv.z < 0 then
		drop:SetSortingLayer(true)
	else
		drop:SetSortingLayer(false)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.master, dirv * 0.6, 0.5, 0.3)
	while timer > 0 do
		drop.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(init_pos, destination, (0.5 - timer) * 2)

		timer = timer - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	drop.Position = destination
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	return drop
end

function local_class:eat_food(item)
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'smile'})

	local timer = 2
	while timer > 0 do
		item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (timer / 2)

		timer = timer - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	item:ConsumeComplete()

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'idle'})
end

	character_util.set_position(self.player, vector(-61, 0, 33))
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'basement_zone' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.player) and not self.on_boss_event then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_boss, self, true))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_boss, self))
		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

		field:Tint('plague_field', self.controller.tint_color, 0)
		self.controller:party_tint(self.controller.tint_color, 0)
		self.hostage.SpineController:AddColor('plague_field', self.controller.tint_color, 1, 0)
		self.boss.SpineController:AddColor('plague_field', self.controller.tint_color, 1, 0)

	end

		self.hostage.SpineController:RemoveColor('plague_field', 0)

	end

function local_class:enter_boss(entrance)

	if entrance then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		party_util.align_party(self.basement_center, 'right', 2, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('basement_door', false))
	end

	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title[1], self.boss_title[2], 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	self.boss.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss))

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(3.5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		self:interact_event(e)
	end

	return false

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.beggar) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_beggar, self)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_beggar()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.beggar, self.controller)
	party_util.align_to_target(self.beggar, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 'a', skip = true})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.shake(self.beggar, 0.05, 9999)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.beggar, nil, 'heart')
	character_util.stop_shake(self.beggar)

	--노숙자 (right, seat) : 이 위는 엉덩이가 따뜻해서 좋단 말이지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.beggar, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'down')
	--노숙자 (down) : 그런데 넌 처음 보는 얼굴인데 용건이 뭐야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

	--선택지 : 비켜달라고 부탁한다.
	--선택지 : 삶이란 무엇인가요?
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{self.talk_name .. 'ask', 'mercy'},
		{self.talk_name .. 'intimidate', 'intellect'}
	})

	if result == 2 then
		local talk_name = self.talk_name .. 'scholar_'

		--그렇군….
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

		--허물을 벗지 않는 뱀은 결국 죽고 말지. 우리 마족도 이와 같아.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

		--낡은 사고에 언제까지고 갇혀있으면 성장은 커녕 안쪽부터 썩어 죽을 뿐이지.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

		--결국 삶이란 늘 새롭게 살아가기 위한 사고의 신진대사가 아닐까?
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'cast2'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

		--아 미안. 말이 길어졌군.
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

		--…젊은이.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

		--먹고 살고 싶으면 절대 철학 전공하지마.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'blush'})

		character_util.add_listener(self.beggar, self.controller)
		return
	end

	--노숙자 (mad, cast2) : [shout] 뭐야?! 요즘 신입은 버릇이 없구만!
	character_util.normal_jump(self.beggar, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'cast2'}, {name = 'mad'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--노숙자 (attack, release) : 여긴 내 자리야! 그냥 비켜줄 수는 없지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	--노숙자 (question) : 정 이 자리를 원한다면… 그래! 소일렌트 레드!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
	--노숙자 : 편의점 신상품인 소일렌트 레드가 그렇게 맛있다던데
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})
	--노숙자 : 그걸 사주면 생각해 보지.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'blush'})

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end


function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:exit()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldPrincessSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldPrincess @
		Comment = 마계 12챕터 꼬마 공주 스타피스 이벤트 시작 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'substage_12_1'

	-- 꼬마공주NPC, 마커, 스타피스, 이벤트 존
	-- 위 4가지가 추가되어 있어야 한다.
	self.princess_name = 'princess'
	self.beggar_name = 'manhole_beggar'
	self.beggar_marker_name = 'beggar_pos'
	self.marker_name = 'princess_pos'

	self.talk_name = 'ch12_princess_pre_'

	self.soylent_red_id = 20367

	-- 마계 달러 관련들
	self.data_storage = nil
	self.dollar_data_key = 'dollar'
	self.dollar_val = 0

	self.soylent_item_name = 'store_soylent_red'

	self.soylent_item = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	self.beggar = get_character(self.beggar_name)
	self.beggar_marker = field:GetMarker(self.beggar_marker_name)
	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)
	self.princess_marker = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(self.beggar, self.beggar_marker.position, false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'blush'})

	character_util.set_with_marker(self.princess, self.princess_marker, false)
	character_util.set_position(self.princess, self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})

	self.manhole = get_field_object('tower_manhole_entrance')
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.controller.hole_interact = self.manhole.Interactable
		self.manhole.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	-- 마계 달러 저장소
	local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
	self.data_storage = storage_create.create(221)

	-- 아이템 구매 여부
	self.has_soylent = self.data_storage:get_data(self.soylent_item_name)

	if self.has_soylent > 0 then
		character_util.add_listener(self.beggar, self.controller)
	else
		--노숙자(right, seat) : 소일렌트 레드는 아직이야?
		self.beggar.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 7
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.beggar) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_soylent, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:custom_stage_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'item_purchased' then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.soylent_item_name then
			self.beggar.Interactable.Talk = nil
			character_util.add_listener(self.beggar, self.controller)
			self.has_soylent = self.has_soylent + 1
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:give_soylent()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.beggar, self.controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(self.beggar, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--노숙자(right, seat) : 소일렌트 레드는 아직이야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

	--선택지 : 소일렌트 레드를 준다.
	local choose_pool = {{self.talk_name .. 'yes', 'mercy'}, {self.talk_name .. 'no', 'normal'}}

	result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_pool)

	if result == 2 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'blush'})
		character_util.add_listener(self.beggar, self.controller)
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	self.data_storage:set_data(self.soylent_item_name, self.has_soylent - 1)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
	local soylent_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.player.Position,
													  target = self.beggar.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
													  itemid = self.soylent_red_id, notforinven = true,
													  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	soylent_item.ConsumeTarget = self.beggar
	soylent_item:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노숙자(down, surprise) : 오오! 이게 바로 말로만 듣던…!
	character_util.remove_anim(self.beggar)
	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.beggar, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

	--노숙자 오른쪽으로 이동 후 left 방향
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.beggar, self.beggar_marker.position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, true)

	--노숙자 (left) : 약속대로 소일렌트 레드를 가져왔으니 지나가도 좋아.
	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'left')
	self.beggar.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'soylent_red_can')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.beggar, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})

	--노숙자 (left, seat) : 천천히 아껴먹어야지 후후...
	self.beggar.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 10

	self.manhole.Interactable = self.controller.hole_interact

	self.soylent_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.beggar_marker.position + vector(1.75, 0, 0),
													 itemid = self.soylent_red_id, notforinven = true,
													 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.soylent_item ~= nil then
		self.soylent_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
end


return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldPrincessSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldPrincess @
		Comment = 마계 12챕터 꼬마 공주 스타피스 이벤트 시작 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 꼬마공주NPC, 마커, 스타피스, 이벤트 존
	-- 위 4가지가 추가되어 있어야 한다.
	self.princess_name = 'princess'
	self.beggar_name = 'manhole_beggar'
	self.zone_name = 'princess_zone'
	self.marker_name = 'princess_pos'
	self.beggar_marker_name = 'beggar_pos'
	self.star_piece_name = 'princess_star_piece'

	self.in_princess_zone = false
	self.is_repeat = false

	self.talk_name = 'ch12_princess_s1_'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)
	self.princess_marker = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name)
	self.beggar = get_character(self.beggar_name)
	self.beggar_marker = field:GetMarker(self.beggar_marker_name)

	character_util.set_with_marker(self.princess, self.princess_marker, false)
	character_util.add_listener(self.princess, self.controller)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_position(self.princess, self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

	character_util.set_position(self.beggar, self.beggar_marker.position + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.beggar, 'left')
	self.beggar.Interactable.Talk = 'ch12_princess_pre_10'
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.beggar, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'smile'})
	--character_util.set_anim(self.beggar, {name = 'gauntlet_idle', upper = true})

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			self.in_princess_zone = true
			if not self.is_repeat then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.repeat_princess, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			self.in_princess_zone = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.princess) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_princess, self)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_princess()
	self.in_princess_zone = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.princess)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.princess, self.controller)

	local dir = self.princess.Direction
	local opdir = direction_util.get_opposite(dir)
	party_util.align_party(self.princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), dir, 1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_anim(self.player, {name = 'idle'})
	self.player:HideWeapon(true)
	--꼬마 공주 상호작용 시 왼쪽 정렬
	--꼬마 공주 (left, surprise, jump) : 앗! 너는…?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

	--잠깐 멈춰서 주인공 쳐다보는 느낌으로 텀을 줌. 꼬마 공주 idle
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	--주인공 (right, tired, release)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'tired'})
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.set_anim(self.player, {name = 'idle'})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마 공주 : ……
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.princess, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.princess, self.princess_marker.position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			0.3, nil, false, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마 공주 (right) : {주인공}에게 들었어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = { self.talk_name .. 2, user.Name }, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (tired) : 유명한 사람을 동경해서 사칭하는 사람들도 있다고...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, opdir)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (left) : 아무리 {주인공}처럼 되고 싶다고 해도
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, dir)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = { self.talk_name .. 4, user.Name }, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (attack, release) : 거짓말은 안돼! 그건 나쁜 짓이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.player)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.set_anim(self.player, {name = 'idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--주인공 (tired)
	--꼬마 공주 : (말줄임표 말풍선)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.princess, nil, 'silence')
	--꼬마 공주 (nod 1회) : 네가 왜 그랬는지는 알 거 같아.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.princess, {name = 'nod', count = 1})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (right) : {주인공}... 항상 든든하게 모두를 지켜주고 힘든 사람들을 도우니까
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, opdir)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = { self.talk_name .. 7, user.Name }, skip = true})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--꼬마 공주 (left, smile) : 너도 그렇게 되고 싶었던 거지?
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, dir)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.set_anim(self.player, {name = 'idle'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

	--꼬마 공주 스타피스를 꺼냄 (left, smile, get)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'get'}, {name = 'smile'})
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(self.princess.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--꼬마 공주 : 근처에서 찾은 건데... 특별히 너 줄게!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (smile) : 대신 앞으로 거짓말하면 안돼 알았지?
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true})
	--주인공 (tired, nod 2회)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{self.talk_name .. 'okay_1', 'normal'},
		{self.talk_name .. 'okay_2', 'intellect'},
		{self.talk_name .. 'okay_3', 'mercy'}})
	if result == 3 then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.player, {name = 'smile'})
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
	character_util.nod_twice(self.player)
	character_util.set_anim(self.player, {name = 'idle'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--꼬마 공주 (right) : 그러면 잘 가… 나는 여기서 친구를 기다려야 해서...
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, opdir)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})
	--꼬마 공주 (right, tired, seat) : 요즘 바빠서인지 언제 돌아올지는 모르겠지만...
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.player)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, {key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, dir)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.jump(self.princess, 0.5, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.princess, self.princess_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
			0.5, nil, false, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	self.player:HideWeapon(false)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
