local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldTeatanWomanSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_teatan_woman = function() return get_character('teatan_woman') end
	self.get_punk_demon = function(num) return get_character('teatan_punk_demon_' .. num) end

	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('teatan_woman_star_piece') end

	self.get_fx_twinkle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end
	self.get_fx_roar = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_battleroar') end

	self.active_zone_name = 'teatan_woman_speech_activate'

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		in_zone = 1,
		before_accept_quest = 3,
		after_accept_quest = 4,
		talk_with_woman = 5,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.on_off_request = {
		none = 0,
		on = 1,
		off = 2,
	}
	self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none

	self.listener_added_dict = {}

	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_teatan_woman(),
		self.get_punk_demon(1),
		self.get_punk_demon(2),
		self.get_punk_demon(3),
		self.get_punk_demon(4),
		self.get_punk_demon(5),
	}

	self:custom_add_listener(npcs)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if is_unity_null(self.twinkle_effect) == false then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.active_zone_name)
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_zone

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_nonstop_event, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.listener_added_dict[e.Target] == true and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_zone then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_accept_quest
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.woman_speech, self)
			return true

		elseif self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_accept_quest then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_accept_quest
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_demon, self)
			return true

		elseif self.current_event_state == self.event_state.after_accept_quest then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_with_woman
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_woman, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)

end

function local_class:show_nonstop_event()
	local woman = self.get_teatan_woman()
	local demons = {
		self.get_punk_demon(1),
		self.get_punk_demon(2),
		self.get_punk_demon(3),
	}

	--멈춰서지 않는 이벤트로
	--티탄 아줌마가 “이것은 아주 심각한 인권 침해에요.”,
	-- “우리 모두가, 종족을 뛰어넘어 손을 맞잡고 이 불의에 맞서 싸워야 해요!”
	character_util.play_speech_action(woman, nil,
			'attack', {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_1'})

	if self:check_force_end() then return end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_ready_01', parent = woman,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(woman, nil,
			nil, {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_2'})

	if self:check_force_end() then return end

	--펑크 악마들 “옳소!” , “맞아요, 자매님!”, “생긴거답지 않게 옳은 말을 하시는군!”
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = demons[2],
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.normal_jump(demons[2])
	character_util.play_speech_action(demons[2], nil,
			'attack', {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_3'})

	if self:check_force_end() then return end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = demons[1],
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = demons[1],
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.normal_jump(demons[1])
	character_util.play_speech_action(demons[1], nil,
			'awesome', {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_4'})

	if self:check_force_end() then return end

	character_util.play_speech_action(demons[3], nil,
			'smile', {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_5'})
end

function local_class:check_force_end()
	return self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.in_zone or self.controller.exclusive_on
end

function local_class:stop_nonstop_event()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_teatan_woman(),
		self.get_punk_demon(1),
		self.get_punk_demon(2),
		self.get_punk_demon(3),
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_woman()
	local woman = self.get_teatan_woman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local demons = {
		self.get_punk_demon(1),
		self.get_punk_demon(2),
		self.get_punk_demon(3),
		self.get_punk_demon(4),
		self.get_punk_demon(5),
	}

	self:custom_remove_listener({woman})

	--티탄 아줌마에게 말 걸면)
	party_util.align_to_target(woman, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	--티탄 : …? 나한테 용건이 있나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(woman)
	woman.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.play_speech_action(woman, nil,
			nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_37')

	--선택지
	--토론 배틀을 신청한다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'demonworld_teatan_woman_38', 'intellect'},
		{'demonworld_teatan_woman_39', 'mercy'}
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--티탄 : 호오… 도전을 하는 것인가요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, {name = 'question', loop = false},
				'doyagao', 'demonworld_teatan_woman_40')

		--티탄 : 당신의 친구가 예상하지 못한 면접 질문에 폭사한 취업준비생 같은 모습을 보였음에도 불구하고…
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, 'cross_arm',
				nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_41')

		--티탄 : 오히려 이 나에게 맞서는 것인가요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, 'bow_idle',
				nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_42')

		--(주인공 attack 표정 + 삿대질)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--티탄 : 좋아요! 그 도전 받아들이도록 하죠.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, {name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_43')

		--(페이드 아웃 - 주인공 / 아줌마 서로 마주보고 앉아 있고 펑크 악마들은 주인공 뒤에서 걱정하는 표정으로, cast 애니메이션 하고 서있음)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		local woman_origin_pos = woman.Position
		local demon2_origin_pos = demons[2].Position
		local back_demons_index = {
			1, 3, 4, 5
		}
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			user_party[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
		leader.Position = demons[2].Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		woman.Position = leader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
		woman.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		demons[2].Position = demon2_origin_pos + vector(1, 0, 2)

		for _, index in pairs(back_demons_index) do
			demons[index].Position = demons[index].Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(woman, {name = 'seat'})
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'seat'})

		character_util.set_group_anim(demons, {name = 'cast'})

		local camera_pos = leader.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)
		coroutine.yield()

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_chasing', state = 'event', mix = 2.0})

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		--티탄 : 지금 이 자리에서 가장 중요한 것은 마계 경찰 내부의 종비 불균형이에요.
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, {name = 'cast2', upper = true},
				nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_44')

		--티탄 : 티탄 족은 전세계 인구의 10% 를 구성하고 있어요.
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, nil,
				nil, 'demonworld_teatan_woman_45')

		--티탄 : 그런데 마계 경찰에 고용된 티탄족의 비율은 정말 비극적이게도 0.01%…!
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman, {name = 'cast', upper = true},
				'tired', 'demonworld_teatan_woman_46')

		--티탄 : 이게 티탄족 차별이 아니고 뭐라는거죠?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(woman,
				{name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				'attack', 'demonworld_teatan_woman_47')
		character_util.set_anim(woman, {name = 'seat'})

		--선택지
		--지금 51 구역 내부에서는 생사여부가 걸린 사람들이 있어!
		--애초에 마계에 사는 티탄족은 극소수다.
		--기전의 분석 결과값만으로 인과를 설명하는 것은 옳지 않아.
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{'demonworld_teatan_woman_48', 'mercy'},
			{'demonworld_teatan_woman_49', 'brutal'},
			{'demonworld_teatan_woman_50', 'intellect'},
		})

		--(주인공 attack 포즈로 bomb_idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'attack'})
		leader:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		--(1 초 후 hold_loop)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'cast2'})
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		--(1 초 후 삿대질)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--(1 초 후)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman, {key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_72', skip = true})

		--티탄 아줌마 : 꾸짖을…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(woman,
				{key = 'demonworld_teatan_woman_51', skip = true, keep_display = true})
		camera_util.resize_to(3.3, 2)

function local_class:custom_add_listener(targets)
	for _, npc in pairs(targets) do
		if not self.listener_added_dict[npc] then
			self.listener_added_dict[npc] = true
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:custom_remove_listener(targets)
	for _, npc in pairs(targets) do
		if self.listener_added_dict[npc] == true then
			self.listener_added_dict[npc] = false
			character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end
end

		end

function local_class:drop_item_pos(item_id, start_pos, duration, end_pos, height, scale)
	local sprite_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = start_pos, itemid = item_id, sprscale = sprite_scale,
								 notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.move_rotate_item, self, item, duration, end_pos, height, 3))
	return item
end

-- 아이템 회전하면서 이동하는 함수
function local_class:move_rotate_item(item, duration, end_pos, height, rotate_count)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = item.Position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0,cur_y,0)

		local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:active_door_npc(active_succubus, fade)

	local succubus_2 = self.get_succubus(5)

	if active_succubus ~= nil then
		if active_succubus then
			succubus_1.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			succubus_2.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			if fade == false then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(succubus_1, 0 ,0)

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(succubus_2, 1, 0.5)

			end
		else

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(succubus_1, 0 ,0.5)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(succubus_2, 0, 0.5)

	self.trash_can_id = 20081

	-- object pool
	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	self.zone_in_check = false

	-- custom_key
	self.custom_key = 'vampire_idol'

	-- sound
	self.loop_sfx = nil

	self.event_state = {
		event_none = 0,
		event_end = 1,
		leave_end = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.event_state.event_none

	self.zone_enter_check = false
	self.exclusive_quest_check = false
	self.exclusive_quest_fade = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	local custom_data = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	if custom_data == 1 then return end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local idol = self.get_vampire_idol()
	local idol_position = field:GetMarker(self.idol_marker_name).position
	local diff = idol.Position - idol_position
	idol.Position = idol_position

	--region npc setting
	self.civilian_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.civilian_count do
		local civilian = self.get_civilian(i)
		civilian.Position = civilian.Position - diff
		table.insert(self.civilian_list, civilian)
	end
	--endregion

	--region effect setting
	self.get_hit_effect()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	--endregion

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.next_section_check, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.civilian_list = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		self.exclusive_quest_check = true
		self.exclusive_quest_fade = e.Fade

		if self.current_state == self.event_state.event_none then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_active, self, false, e.Fade))
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		self.exclusive_quest_check = false
		self.exclusive_quest_fade = e.Fade

		if self.current_state == self.event_state.event_none then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_active, self, true, e.Fade))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name or self.exclusive_quest_check then return false end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.vampire_idol_zone_name) then

		self.zone_enter_check = true
		if self.current_state < self.event_state.event_end then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				-- 팡파레, 새로운 캐릭터 얻는 상태의 예외처리
				if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare
						or music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
					self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
				end

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_idol', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
			end))
		end

		if not self.zone_in_check then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_vampireidol, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.vampire_idol_zone_name) then
		return false
	end

	if not self.exclusive_quest_check and self.current_state ~= self.event_state.leave_end then
		self.zone_enter_check = false

		if self.current_state == self.event_state.event_end then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.leave_end
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.prev_stage_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 2 })
			else
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.prev_stage_bgm_name, state = 'field', mix = 2 })
			end
		end))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:next_section_check()
	local custom_data = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	if custom_data == 1 then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	end
end

-- 관중들이 세실에게 깡통을 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:throw_trash_can_event()
	local idol = self.get_vampire_idol()

	-- 랜덤으로 던지는 방향, 몇 번째 NPC가 던지는지, 던지고 나서 다음 던질 때까지의 대기 시간을 설정함
	local rand_delay = 0
	local talk_count = 0

	while true do
		talk_count = talk_count + 1
		local index = talk_count % #self.civilian_list + 1
		local thrower = self.civilian_list[index]

		rand_delay = unity_class.random.Range(0.5, 1.0)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_trash_can_to_target, self, thrower, idol, talk_count))

		if talk_count == 1 then
			-- 무슨 염치로 돌아왔어?!
			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01',
										  parent = thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thrower, 'demonworld_a_vampireidol_6')
			while self.exclusive_quest_check do
				self.zone_in_check = false
				return
			end
		elseif talk_count == 2 then
			-- 그 추태를 보였으면 알아서 쥐죽은 듯이 살아야지!
			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01',
										  parent = thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thrower, 'demonworld_a_vampireidol_7')
			while self.exclusive_quest_check do
				self.zone_in_check = false
				return
			end
		elseif talk_count == 3 then
			-- 뱀파이어의 수치!
			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_female_shout_01',
										  parent = thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thrower, 'demonworld_a_vampireidol_8')
			while self.exclusive_quest_check do
				self.zone_in_check = false
				return
			end
		elseif talk_count == 4 then
			-- 너를 괴롭힘으로써 내 도덕적 우월감을 증명할거야!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(thrower, 'demonworld_a_vampireidol_9')
			while self.exclusive_quest_check do
				self.zone_in_check = false
				return
			end
		elseif talk_count >= 8 and self.exclusive_quest_check then
			self:npc_active(false, self.exclusive_quest_fade)
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(rand_delay)
	end
end

-- 깡통 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_trash_can_to_target(thrower, target, count)
	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_swing_01',
								  parent = thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_emotion(thrower, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "attack", loop = false })

	local trash = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = self.trash_can_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
	if (trash.Position - target.Position).magnitude < 0.6 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01',
									  parent = target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		if count == 1 then
			character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'tired' })
		elseif count == 8 then

			if self.zone_enter_check == true then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
			end

			self.zone_in_check = true
			self.current_state = self.event_state.event_end
			quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.custom_key, 1)

			character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		end

		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	trash:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:npc_active(active, fade)
	local idol = self.get_vampire_idol()

	if active then
		for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
			character_util.set_active_state(civilian, 'enabled')
		end
		idol.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		if fade == false then
			for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilian, 0, 0)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(idol, 0, 0)
			coroutine.yield()

			for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilian, 1, 0.5)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(idol, 1, 0.5)
		else
			for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilian, 1, 0)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(idol, 1, 0)
		end
	else
		if fade == false then
			for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilian, 0, 0.5)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(idol, 0, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
		for _, civilian in ipairs(self.civilian_list) do
			character_util.set_active_state(civilian, 'disabled')
		end
		idol.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:start_members_lynch_routine()
	if self.current_lynch_state == self.lynch_state.none then
		self.current_lynch_state = self.lynch_state.lynching
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.members_lynch_routine, self))
	elseif self.current_lynch_state == self.lynch_state.lynch_stop then
		-- 아직 루틴이 끝나지 않았다는 의미이므로 상태만 변경해줌
		self.current_lynch_state = self.lynch_state.lynching
	end

end

function local_class:stop_members_lynch_routine()
	if self.current_lynch_state == self.lynch_state.lynching then
		self.current_lynch_state = self.lynch_state.lynch_stop
	end
end

function local_class:members_lynch_routine()
	local idol = self.get_vampire_idol()
	local members = {
		self.get_idol_member(1),
		self.get_idol_member(2),
		self.get_idol_member(3),
	}
	self.current_lynching_index = 1

	while self.current_lynch_state == self.lynch_state.lynching do
		self:member_hit_idol(members[self.current_lynching_index], idol, nil, 0.3)

		self.current_lynching_index = self.current_lynching_index + 1
		if self.current_lynching_index > #members then
			self.current_lynching_index = 1
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	self.current_lynch_state = self.lynch_state.none
end

function local_class:member_hit_idol(fo, target, talk_key, deviate_scale, non_shake, before_talk_sfx)
	local deviate_dir = (target.Position - fo.Position).normalized
	local deviate = deviate_dir * deviate_scale
	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	target.SpineController:DeviateLocal(deviate, 0.2, 0.15)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + deviate_dir * -0.2 + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
			.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) and not non_shake then
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = target,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	if talk_key ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(before_talk_sfx)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, {key = talk_key, skip = true})
	end
end

			nil, 'demonworld_vampire_idol_2_20')

	--세실: 여기선 보이지 않지만….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(idol, {key = 'demonworld_vampire_idol_2_21', skip = true})

	--세실: 당신이 누군지… 알 것 같아요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(idol, {key = 'demonworld_vampire_idol_2_22', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(idol, {name = 'cast'})

	--스타피스가 세실로 부터 나와 햇빛이 있는 곳에 떨어진다.
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	local start_pos = idol.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0)
	local target_pos = sunshine_center_pos
	local move_dur = 1.7 + (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / 4.5

	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, start_pos, target_pos)

	wait_for_sec(move_dur + 0.5)

	local star_piece_pool_tf = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('star_piece').transform
	local star_piece_shadow_tf = nil
	for i = 0, star_piece_pool_tf.childCount - 1 do
		local star_piece_tf = star_piece_pool_tf:GetChild(i)
		-- 적당히 FO랑 가까운 GameObject 찾음
		if star_piece_tf.gameObject.activeSelf and (star_piece_tf.position - star_piece.Position).magnitude < 1 then
			star_piece_shadow_tf = star_piece_tf:Find('shadow')
			break
		end
	end

	if star_piece_shadow_tf == nil then
		-- BUG : 스타피스 접근을 실패했을 경우
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Cannot Find StarPiece Shadow')
	end

	--세실 deep_sleep + cast(손을 머리 위로 올린상태)
	character_util.set_anim(idol, {name = 'hold_loop', scale = 0, loop = false})

	-- 초반엔 1-cos(x) 함수를 따라 움직임
	-- 나중엔 linear 하게
	local height_func = function(time_passed)
		local cos_max_height = 2
		local cos_move_dur = 1.5
		if time_passed < cos_move_dur then
			return (1 - math.cos((time_passed / cos_move_dur) * (math.pi / 2))) * cos_max_height
		else
			return cos_max_height + (time_passed - cos_move_dur) * cos_max_height
		end
	end
	local shadow_scale_func = function(time_passed)
		if time_passed < 2 then
			return 1 - (time_passed / 2)
		else
			return 0
		end
	end

	local star_piece_moving = true
	local star_piece_shadow_local_pos = star_piece_shadow_tf.localPosition
	local star_piece_shadow_world_pos = star_piece_shadow_tf.position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local time_passed = 0

		while star_piece_moving do
			star_piece.Position = target_pos + vector(0, height_func(time_passed), 0)
			-- 스타피스 그림자는 그 위치에 계속 고정시켜놓음
			star_piece_shadow_tf.position = star_piece_shadow_world_pos

			star_piece_shadow_tf.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * shadow_scale_func(time_passed)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	--스타피스가 점점 하늘 위로 떠오른다. fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	star_piece_moving = false
	star_piece_shadow_tf.localPosition = star_piece_shadow_local_pos
	star_piece_shadow_tf.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_hole_pos(), 0)
	coroutine.yield()

	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = true
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, self.get_hole_pos(), self.star_piece_origin_pos)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})

	--fade in 지상
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--구멍으로부터 스타피스 나와서 플레이어가 먹을 수 있는 지역에 스타피스가 떨어진다.
	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	--hidden quest 클리어
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	if in_convenience_store then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_store',
											 state = 'event', mix = 1.2 })
	elseif in_roof_top then
		field.RooftopManager:ResetVisible()
	end

	--지하에 다시 가보면 아무도 없다.
	local npcs = {
		members[1],
		members[2],
		members[3],
		idol
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)

	user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
			stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

    if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
    if not e.FullEnter then return end

    if self.controller.is_able_to_process == false then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if (zone_name == self.beth_ally_zone)
            and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none
            and self.is_player_qualified then

        self.current_section_state = self.section_state.beth_pity
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beth_pity_herself, self))

        self.is_player_qualified = true
        self:set_labors()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self.kid = get_character(self.kid_name)
		character_util.add_listener(self.kid, self.controller)

		-- 메인 퀘스트 섹션이 7 이상인 경우에만 수행 가능
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

		if main_quest_inner_progress < 7 then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.kid, 'disabled')
		end

		self.entered_stage_2 = true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.entered_stage_2 then
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

		if main_quest_inner_progress >= 7 then
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.kid)
		end
	end
end

	if self.entered_stage_2 then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		self.kid = nil
	end
end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.kid) then
		if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party_leader) == nil then

demon_world_global_event = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/DemonWorldGlobalEvent')

--[[QuestAttribute
        Type = pre @

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_2'
	self.entered_stage_2 = false

	-- 대사 스크립트
	self.script_key = 'demonworld_worst_criminal_s1_'

	-- 범죄자 꼬마
	self.kid = nil

	-- NPC 이름
	self.kid_name = 'criminal_kid'

	-- 악명 체크 플래그
	self.notoriety_checks = { false, false, false, false, false }

	-- 악명 체크 인덱스
	self.notoriety_lv_index = 1

	-- 대화 반복 막기 위해 최근 대화 전 악명 레벨 저장
	self.recent_notoriety_lv = -1

	-- 이벤트 중일 때는 수치 업데이트 안되게 막는 플래그
	self.cannot_update_notoriety = false

	self.reward_custom_key = 'reward'
	self.reward = 0
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 현재 스테이지가 맞는지 확인 꼭 할 것.
	--if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 메시지 구독 관련
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self.kid = get_character(self.kid_name)
		character_util.add_listener(self.kid, self.controller)

		-- 악명 정보를 불러와서 저장함
		self.reward = self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.reward_custom_key)

		if self.reward == -1 then
			self.reward = 0
		end

		local val = self.reward

		while val > 0 do
			local mod = val % 2

			if mod == 1 then
				self.notoriety_checks[self.notoriety_lv_index] = true
			end

			val = math.floor(val / 2)
			self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
		end

		self.entered_stage_2 = true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.entered_stage_2 then
		self:set_quest_icon()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.entered_stage_2 then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		self.kid = nil
		self.notoriety_checks = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.kid) then
		if self.controller.notoriety_lv >= self.notoriety_lv_index or self.controller.defeat_erina == 1 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_kid_event, self)
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.kid, { key = 'demonworld_worst_criminal_pre_12' })
		end
	end
end

-- 컨트롤러에서 호출되는 퀘스트 아이콘 설정
function local_class:set_quest_icon()
	if self.controller.notoriety_lv >= self.notoriety_lv_index or self.controller.defeat_erina == 1 then
		if not self.quest_icon_is_changed then
			self.quest_icon_is_changed = true

			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.kid)
		end
	end
end

-- 소년과 상호작용
function local_class:interact_with_kid_event()
	quest_icon_util.remove(self.kid)

	local notoriety_lv = self.controller.notoriety_lv
	local defeat_erina = self.controller.defeat_erina

	party_util.align_party(self.kid, 'left', 1)

	if self.notoriety_lv_index <= 1 and notoriety_lv >= 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'attack' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..3, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..4, skip = true })

		coroutine.yield(self:give_reward(1))

		self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
	end

	if self.notoriety_lv_index <= 2 and notoriety_lv >= 2 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'sing' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..5, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..6, skip = true })

		coroutine.yield(self:give_reward(2))

		self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
	end

	if self.notoriety_lv_index <= 3 and notoriety_lv >= 3 then
		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..7, skip = true })

		clap_sfx:FadeOut()

		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..8, skip = true })

		coroutine.yield(self:give_reward(3))

		self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
	end

	if self.notoriety_lv_index <= 4 and notoriety_lv >= 4 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..9, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..10, skip = true })

		coroutine.yield(self:give_reward(4))

		self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
	end

	if self.notoriety_lv_index <= 5 and notoriety_lv >= 5 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'success' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'awesome' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..11, skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'sing' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'smile' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..12, skip = true })

		coroutine.yield(self:give_reward(5))

		self.notoriety_lv_index = self.notoriety_lv_index + 1
	end

	if defeat_erina == 1 then

		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(self.kid, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..13, skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..14, skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kid, { key = self.script_key..15, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.kid, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.kid)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid)

		-- 퀘스트 완료 Grade 0

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	end

	if self.controller.notoriety_lv ~= 5 then
		self.quest_icon_is_changed = false
	end
end

-- 보상 주기
function local_class:give_reward(id)
	character_util.set_anim(self.kid, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	local dollar_data = require('utils/DemonWorldDollarData')


	local dollars = { dollar_data.demonworld_worst_criminal_1,
					  dollar_data.demonworld_worst_criminal_2,
					  dollar_data.demonworld_worst_criminal_3,
					  dollar_data.demonworld_worst_criminal_4,
					  dollar_data.demonworld_worst_criminal_5 }

	-- 달러 지급
	local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
	demon_world_dollar:add_dollar_async(dollars[id], false, { pos = self.kid.Position, target_pos = user_party_leader.Position })

	self.reward = self.reward + 2^(id - 1)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.reward_custom_key, self.reward)

	local is_replaying = CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying

	-- 당시 해당 시점에 무조건 서버에 저장 해야 된다고 해서 강제로 통신 주고 받았던 작업
	-- 다시하기는 필요 없기때문에 따로 처리
	if not is_replaying then
		local save_success = true
		local on_success = function (res)
			save_success = true
		end

		fail_count = 0

		while true do
			save_success = false

			local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(
					stage.StageId, self.controller.quest_id, self.controller.quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)

			r:Then(on_success)

			coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if not save_success then
				fail_count = fail_count + 1

				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("WorstCriminal : SendProgressQuest Retry")

				wait_for_sec(5 + fail_count)
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 퀘스트 컨트롤러 관련
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kk, { key = text })

	if zone_bound:Intersects(user_party.Leader.Bounds) then
		self:play_kk_song()
	end

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.alway_playing_music

	local talkers = { get_character('sheep'), get_character('duck') }
	local keys = {'kk_song_reaction_1', 'kk_song_reaction_2'}

	local idx = 1
	while true do
		wait_for_sec(5)
		local talker = talkers[idx]
		local key = keys[idx]
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(talker, {key = key})

		idx = idx == #keys and 1 or idx + 1
	end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local player_holding = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
			table_util.contain_value(self.place_npcs, user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.place_npcs, 'place_animal') and not player_holding then
		local rescued_animal = e.FieldObject
		local carrier_number = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.carry_npcs)
		local table_number = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.place_tables)
		local place_table = self.place_tables[table_number]
		local carrier = self.carry_npcs[carrier_number]
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.meerkat_carry_animal, self, carrier, rescued_animal, place_table))
		table.remove(self.place_tables, table_number)
		table.remove(self.carry_npcs, carrier_number)
		table.remove(self.place_npcs, lua_helper.reference_equals(rescued_animal, get_character('duck')) and 1 or 2)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) and table_util.contain_value(self.place_npcs, e.Target) then
		local target_point = field:GetZone('place_animal').Bounds.center
		local marker_name = e.Target.Name
		if CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:IsActiveMarker(marker_name) then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, target_point)
		else
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.controller.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, target_point)
		end
		--quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, e.Target.Name, field:GetZone('place_animal').Bounds.center)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:meerkat_carry_animal(carrier, target, place_table)
	if carrier == nil or target == nil or place_table == nil then return end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker(target.Name)
	target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	-- 옮겨질 대상이 다 던져질때까지 대기
	while (target.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(target.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState)) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(carrier, { waypoints = target.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, speed = 4.5, run = true })

	command_util.execute_holdup(carrier, target, carrier.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(carrier, {waypoints = place_table.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, speed = 4.5, run = true})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.look_at(carrier, place_table)
	message_system:SendSync(target, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance);
	message_system:SendSync(carrier, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(carrier));
	character_util.move_to_async(target, place_table.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.45, 0.25)

	-- 동물들을 다 구조해줬으면 섹션을 넘김.
	self.carry_count = self.carry_count + 1
	if self.carry_count == 2 then
		local meerkat = get_character('meerkat')
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(meerkat, {waypoints = meerkat.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, speed = 2})
		meerkat.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:swing_butterfly_net()
	local swing_hit_time = 0.366

	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(user_party.Leader)))

	-- 벌이 잠자리채 휘두르는 범위안에 들어와있으면 미리 멈춰줌.
	local swing_length = 1
	local catch_bee
	local center = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * (swing_length / 2)
	local swing_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3.one * swing_length)
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, swing_bound)

	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = list[i]
		if string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'desert_bee') then
			catch_bee = fo
			-- FIXME: GhostGuardPatrolState 수정에 의한 사이드 이펙트
			-- 054b1f8f462a3b80fa23e0e3d512430af609f4a5 해당 커밋에서 발생 한 이슈.
			local bee_pos = catch_bee.Position
			character_util.stop(catch_bee)
			catch_bee.Position = bee_pos
		end
	end
	list:Dispose()

	local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('twohand_attack', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation(req)

	-- 스윙소리가 나는 시간까지 기다림.
	wait_for_sec(swing_hit_time)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')

	-- 판정상 잡힌 벌이 있다면 벌 잡히는 연출 실행
	if catch_bee ~= nil then
		self.caught_bee_count = self.caught_bee_count + 1
		if self.caught_bee_count == 3 then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('complete_catch', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.controller.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_character('meerkat'))
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_comic_01')
		catch_bee.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 휘둘렀는데 벌이 아닌 NPC라면 데미지를 줌
	local center = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * (swing_length / 2)
	local swing_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3.one * swing_length)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, swing_bound)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		local swing_to_npc = not string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'desert_bee') and
				fo.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(fo.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour)
		if swing_to_npc then

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(survivor)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	yield_return_func(self.scene.fight_with_wolf, self.scene)

	local wolf = get_character(self.wolf_name)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(wolf, self.battle_group_name)
	character_util.set_death_type(wolf, 'smallexplosion')

	character_util.set_immortal(survivor, true)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.survivor_talk, self))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 서바이버의 혼잣말
function local_class:survivor_talk()
	wait_for_sec(3)

	local timer = 4
	local index = 0

	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)

	while self.survivor_talk_bool do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= 2 then
			local string_key = self.talk_string_key .. index
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(survivor, { key = string_key, portraitname = 'survivor' })

			timer = 0
			if index == 2 then
				index = 0
			else
				index = index + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local speech_bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(survivor)
	if speech_bubble ~= nil then
		speech_bubble:ResetBubble()
	end
end

	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(survivor)

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(survivor)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	wait_for_sec(2)

	yield_return_func(self.scene.defeat_wolf, self.scene)

	-- 서브 스테이지 언락
	local chapter_data = CS.Oak.ChapterData.Value:GetChapterData(stage.Spec.ChapterCode)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.NewStageTheatre.Show, chapter_data.ChapterCode, 'snowmountain_1_4', 'substage_3_6',
		{ game_string:Format("opened_stage", game_string:GetString("substage_3_6")) }, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:survivor_talk_once()
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	local string_key = 'different_world_survivor_s1_3'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(survivor, { key = string_key, skip = true, portraitname = 'survivor' })
end

function local_class:fall_down_survivor()
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	survivor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(survivor, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(survivor, { name = 'damaged' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local cur_pos = survivor.Position
	local target_pos = vector(9, 0, -78)
	local falling_time = 1.5
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falling_time, cur_pos.y, 0)

	character_util.spine_rotate(survivor, 360, falling_time)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < falling_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.time)

		local ip = screen_util.get_interpolations('linear')
		local cur_x = ip(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, cur_pos.x, target_pos.x - cur_pos.x, falling_time)

		ip = screen_util.get_interpolations('ease_in_quad')
		local cur_scale = ip(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, 1, -1, falling_time)
		survivor.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale, 0)

		character_util.set_position(survivor, vector(cur_x, cur_pos.y + free_fall:GetDistance(), target_pos.z))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	survivor.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

return local_class

	CS.Oak.BasicHealEffect.Instance:PlayHitSfx(survivor, survivor, hit_sfx_info)
	survivor.SpineController:HealGreenPulse()
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(survivor, 100, unity_class.color.green, survivor.Position)

function local_class:show_item()
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	local item_target_pos = vector(survivor.Position.x, survivor.Position.y + 1.2, survivor.Position.z - 0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(survivor, { name = 'get' })

	-- 보여줄 아이템 생성
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = survivor.Position, itemid = 20022, notforinven = true })
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter
	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)

	local item_highlight_duration = 1.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	-- 아이템 위로 들어 올림
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < item_highlight_duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(survivor.Position, item_target_pos,
			(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / item_highlight_duration)
		item:SetPosition(cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.remove_anim(survivor)
end

	local pos = vector(-0.5, 0, 13.5)

	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	character_util.set_anim(survivor, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(survivor, { name = 'damaged' })

	local cal = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(10, 10, 20, 2)
	cal:SetElasticity(0.2)
	cal:ScaleTime(1.5)
	character_util.set_position(survivor, vector(pos.x, cal:GetDistance(), pos.z))

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	local drop = false
	while cal ~= nil and not cal:IsDone() do
		cal:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		character_util.set_position(survivor, vector(pos.x, cal:GetDistance(), pos.z), true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if cal:GetDistance() <= 0.2 then
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
			if drop == false then
				drop = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_01')
				self:drop_phone()
			end
		end
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if zone_name == 's4_event_0' and self.inner_progress == 0 then
				self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_event, self))
			elseif zone_name == 'house_up' or zone_name == 'house_down' then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
				local marker = field:GetMarker('entry_home_up').position
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_id,self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker)
			elseif zone_name == 'house_out_up' or zone_name == 'house_out_down' then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
				local marker = field:GetMarker('s4_mech').position
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_id,self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker)
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' and self.inner_progress == 1 then
			-- 보스방 문들을 연다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('trio_boss_door_1', false))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('trio_boss_door_2', false))

			self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_boss, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:boss_event()

	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('s4_survivor').position
	character_util.align_party(marker_pos + vector(1, 0, 1), 'down')

	local cmd = CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(boss_mech, user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	-- 파티를 배틀존안으로 강제로 집어넣는다.
	local push_pos = {
		vector(-20.5, 0, 74.5),
		vector(-22, 0, 73.5),
		vector(-19, 0, 73.5),
		vector(-20.5, 0, 73.5)
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]

			character_util.jump(member, 0.5, 0.25)
			wait_routine[i + 1] = coroutine_class.coroutine(util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, member, push_pos[i + 1], 0.25, nil, true))

	end
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(wait_routine)))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:defeat_boss()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local boss_mech = get_character(self.boss_mech_name)
	character_util.set_anim(boss_mech, { name = 'damaged' })

	local boss = get_character(self.trio_boss_name)
	boss.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	boss.Position = boss_mech.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0)

	local man = get_character(self.trio_man_name)
	man.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	man.Position = boss_mech.Position + vector(-0.3, 1.3, 0)

	local panda = get_character(self.trio_panda_name)
	panda.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	panda.Position = boss_mech.Position + vector(0.3, 1.3, 0)

	camera_util.move(boss_mech.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trio_talk, self))

	local focus_in_time = 2.5
	local stay_time = 2.5
	local focus_out_time = 0.4
	local explosion_time_step = 0.25

	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = self.dying_sfx_handle_name
	sfx_info.loop = true
	sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
	sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc

	local dying_audio_source_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)

	character_util.shake(boss_mech, 0.05, 1000)

	camera_util.shake(0.04, 2, false)

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 3)

	local fX_explosion_boss_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_effect_preset)
	fX_explosion_boss_pool:Instantiate(boss_mech.Position)

	local time_left = focus_in_time
	local is_stay = false

	while time_left > 0 do
		local center = boss_mech.Bounds.center
		local x_width = boss_mech.Hitbox.size.x
		local z_depth = boss_mech.Hitbox.size.z
		local radius_rand = 0.5 + CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 0.5
		x_width = radius_rand
		z_depth = radius_rand

		local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * math.pi * 2
		local pos = center + vector(math.cos(rand) * x_width, 0, math.sin(rand) * z_depth)

		local explosion_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_small')
		local explosion = explosion_pool:Instantiate(pos)
		explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		wait_for_sec(math.min(explosion_time_step, time_left))
		time_left = time_left - explosion_time_step

		if not is_stay and time_left <= 0 then
			time_left = stay_time
			is_stay = true

			camera_util.shake(0.06, stay_time, false)
		end
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.08, focus_out_time, false)

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, focus_out_time, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, focus_out_time)

	dying_audio_source_holder:Stop()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.final_explosion_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.boss_death_sfx_handle_name)

	boss_mech.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(survivor)
	yield_return_func(self.scene.mech_defeat, self.scene)

	yield_return_func(self.survivor_event, self)
end

function local_class:survivor_event()
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	local survivor_character = survivor

	local is_max_party = user_party.Count >= user.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount
	local already_has_character = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Survivor, true) ~= nil

	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = survivor_character
	character_theatre_data.CardName = self.character_card_name
	character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString(self.character_title)
	character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString(self.character_subtitle)
	character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString(self.character_description)
	character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = is_max_party
	character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = already_has_character
	character_theatre_data.VoiceId = self.survivor_voice_id
	character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

	local is_ended_threatre = false

	CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
		is_ended_threatre = true
	end)

	-- NewCharacterTheatre가 안 끝났다면 끝날때까지 기다린다.
	while not is_ended_threatre do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, true, false)

	if not is_max_party and not already_has_character then
		local getted_character = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Survivor)
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Assert(getted_character ~= nil, 'Getted Character(Different World Survivor) is null')

		CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(survivor_character, getted_character, user, user_party)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 소스를 주운후 보여주는 서바이버
function local_class:show_sauce_last()
	local survivor = get_character(self.survivor_name)
	self.hot_sauce = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = survivor.Position, itemid = 20098, notforinven = true })
	self.hot_sauce.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	self.hot_sauce.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	self.hot_sauce.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter
	self.hot_sauce.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	self.hot_sauce:SetSortingLayer(true)

	local item_target_pos = vector(survivor.Position.x, survivor.Position.y + 1.2, survivor.Position.z - 0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(survivor, { name = 'get' })

	-- 보여줄 아이템 생성
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	local item_highlight_duration = 1.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	-- 아이템 위로 들어 올림
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < item_highlight_duration do
		local time_passed = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / item_highlight_duration
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(survivor.Position, item_target_pos, time_passed)
		self.hot_sauce:SetPosition(cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

return local_class

function local_class:change_coat()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local cloth = get_character('staff_cloth')
	party_util.align_to_target(cloth, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	if not self.change_coat_check then
		-- 은행장 복장으로 갈아 입으시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_1', skip = true })
	else
		-- 원래 복장으로 갈아 입으시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_2', skip = true })
	end

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s5_talk_branch_0_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s5_talk_branch_0_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(cloth, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

		music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, duration = 1})
		character_util.set_anim(cloth, { name = "eat", loop = true })
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		character_util.remove_anim(cloth)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equip_finish_01')

		local bank_leader = get_character('bank_leader')
		character_util.set_direction(bank_leader, 'left')
		if not self.change_coat_check then

			local partymember = {}
			local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1
			for i = 1, loop_count do
				table.insert(partymember, user_party[i])
			end
			--플레이어 캐릭터 교체
			local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
			param.HidePreviousParty = false

			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(bank_leader, param)
			character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, user_party_leader.Position)
			character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(-999, 0, -999))

			for _, member in ipairs(partymember) do
				character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party)
			end

			partymember = nil

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_guild_event'))

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, 'left')

			-- 의상 입으신 채로는 세트 밖으로 나가지 마세요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_3', skip = true })

			self.change_coat_check = true
		else
			--플레이어 캐릭터 교체
			character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, cloth.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

			--- 파티 매니저에 파티원을 원복 하도록 요청
			party_manager:RestorePlayerParty()

			camera_util.move(cloth.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
			wait_for_sec(1.0)
			character_util.set_position(bank_leader, vector(-999, 0, -999))

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_event'))

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, 'left')

			-- 다시 입어보고 싶어지시면 언제든지 말씀하세요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_4', skip = true })

			self.change_coat_check = false
		end

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	else
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DisappearExtraSection1')

		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.disappear_extra_staff_name = controller.disappear_extra_staff_name
	self.disappear_extra_name = controller.disappear_extra_name
	self.extra_zone_name = 'BATTLE_4'
	self.exit_zone_name = 'section_2_4'
	self.brazier_name = 'brazier_extra'
	self.find_extra = false
	self.change_coat_check = controller.change_coat_check
	self.branch_next = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local staff = get_character(self.disappear_extra_staff_name)
	staff.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(staff)

	get_character(self.disappear_extra_name).Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_event'))

	get_character('staff_cloth').Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('bank_leader'), user_party.Leader) then
		self.change_coat_check = true
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_event'))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	get_character(self.disappear_extra_staff_name).Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	get_character(self.disappear_extra_name).Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	get_character('staff_cloth').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if not self.find_extra then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(
					e.Target, get_character(self.disappear_extra_staff_name)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_talk, self))
				return true
			end
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(
					e.Target, get_character(self.disappear_extra_name)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.extra_talk, self))
				return true
			end
		else
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(
					e.Target, get_character(self.disappear_extra_staff_name)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.find_extra_talk, self))
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('staff_cloth')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_coat, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
				e.Zone.Name == 'bank_section' and self.change_coat_check then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cloth_talk, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('DoctorWhoSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DoctorWho @
		Comment = 타티스 내부에 있는 스타피스를 획득 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 캐릭터를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_doctor = function() return get_character('doctor') end

	-- 기믹을 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_tardis = function() return get_field_object('tardis') end
	self.get_console = function() return get_field_object('tardis_console') end
	self.get_console_obj = function(num) return get_field_object('tardis_console_obj_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_reset_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('doctor_who_reset').position end
	self.get_tardis_inside_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('doctor_who_tardis_inside').position end
	self.get_star_piece_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('doctor_who_star_piece_position').position end

	-- 스타 피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'doctor_who_star_piece'

	-- 스타 피스를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name) end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_thunder_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Thunder') end
	self.get_teleport_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object') end
	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	-- 선택지 분기에 따른, 마지막 대사 key
	self.goodbye_key = 1

	-- 닥터와 근접한 파티원을 넉백시키는 중인지, 아닌지
	self.is_doctor_do_knockback = false

	self.tardis_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_thunder_effect()
	self.get_teleport_effect()
	self.get_hit_effect()

	local tardis = self.get_tardis()
	tardis.Position = vector(86, 0, 104)

	local console = self.get_console()
	local hit_box = console.Hitbox
	hit_box.size = vector(4, 1, 2)
	console.Hitbox = hit_box

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local has_star_piece = star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name)

	if has_star_piece then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.event_clear, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent))

	if self.tardis_sfx ~= nil then
		self.tardis_sfx:Stop()
		self.tardis_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent) then
		return self:on_star_piece_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local tardis = self.get_tardis()
	local console = self.get_console()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tardis) then
		local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(91)
		if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.IsComplete then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_tardis, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cannot_use_tardis, self)
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, console) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_console, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_star_piece_get_event(e)
	if CS.Oak.StageProgress.Current:HasStarPiece(self.star_piece_name) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.appear_doctor, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:cannot_use_tardis()
	-- 현재 지반이 불안정해, 안정화 전까지 상호작용을 차단합니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'doctor_who_17' })
end

-- 공중 전화 부스에 상호작용
function local_class:interact_tardis()
	local tardis = self.get_tardis()

	-- 평범한 공중전화 박스처럼 생겼지만 왠지 내부가 훨씬 넓은 것 같다.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'doctor_who_1' })

	-- 카멜레온 서킷 작동 중…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_2', skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'doctor_who_2_1', 'mercy' }, { 'doctor_who_2_2', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 2 then
		-- 전화 좀 쓰려고 왔는데요 (실패)

		-- 전기 충격
		yield_return_func(self.electric_shoke, self)
		return
	end

	-- 우리 함께 여행을 가야지 (성공)
	-- …닥터? 재생성한 거예요?
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sci_fi_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_3', skip = true })

	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'doctor_who_3_1', 'mercy' }, { 'doctor_who_3_2', 'forced' }, { 'doctor_who_3_3', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 3 then
		-- 지나가던 행인입니다 (실패)
		-- 전기 충격
		yield_return_func(self.electric_shoke, self)
		return
	end

	-- 알롱-지! (성공)
	-- 제로니모! (성공)-- 누구세요?
	self.goodbye_key = choose_result

	-- 그냥 열어주긴 싫은데, 날 뭐라고 불러줄 거죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_4', skip = true })

	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'doctor_who_4_1', 'mercy' }, { 'doctor_who_4_2', 'forced' }, { 'doctor_who_4_3', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 시간과 상대적 차원의 공간 (성공)
		-- 재미없긴…
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sci_fi_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_5', skip = true })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 섹시 (성공)
		-- 드디어 그렇게 불러주네요? 유머가 늘었어요, 닥터!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sci_fi_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_6', skip = true })
	else
		-- 공중 전화 부스? (실패)
		-- 전기 충격
		yield_return_func(self.electric_shoke, self)
		return
	end

	-- 타티스 내부로 이동
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	local tardis_inside_marker = self.get_tardis_inside_marker()
	party_util.position_party(tardis_inside_marker, 'up', 'arc')
	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	self.tardis_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_scifi_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', fade_in_time = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	-- 여기저기서 신기한 기계음이 들린다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'doctor_who_7' })
end

-- 전기 충격 받는 연출
function local_class:electric_shoke()
	local tardis = self.get_tardis()

	-- 카멜레온 서킷 작동 중…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tardis, { key = 'doctor_who_2', skip = true })

	local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(user_party_leader.Position - tardis.Position))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_lightning_strike_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]

		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, direction, 13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(party, knockback_info);
		party.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(-direction)
		message_system:Send(party.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'confused' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
	wait_for_sec(2.4)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	party_util.shake(0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	party_util.shake(0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		character_util.mario_jump_new(party, 'right')
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

function local_class:knockback_user_party(doctor, party)
	while true do
		if not self.is_doctor_do_knockback then
			return
		end

		local distance = (party.Position - doctor.Position).magnitude

		if distance <= 1 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 좌, 우 옆으로만 밀쳐내게 방향을 정리
	local side_direction = vector_util.to_side_dir((party.Position - doctor.Position).normalized)
	local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(side_direction)
	local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, direction, 13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(party.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, party.Transform)
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(party, knockback_info);
	message_system:Send(party.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
end

-- 3d 오브젝트 alpha fade
function local_class:alpha_fade_3d_object(fo, alpha, duration)
	local renderer = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	local material = renderer.material
	local start_alpha = material.color.a
	local end_alpha = alpha

	local time_passed = 0

	local fade_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sci_fi_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object' })

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)
		local color = material.color

		color.a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		material.color = color

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	fade_sfx:Stop()

	local color = material.color
	color.a = end_alpha
	material.color = color
end

-- 3d 오브젝트 color pulse
function local_class:color_pulse_3d_object(fo, color, duration, pulse_duration)
	local renderer = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	local material = renderer.material
	local start_color = material.color
	local end_color = color

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / pulse_duration)
		local c = material.color

		c.r = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.r, end_color.r, unity_class.mathf.PingPong(progress, 1))
		c.g = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.g, end_color.g, unity_class.mathf.PingPong(progress, 1))
		c.b = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.g, end_color.g, unity_class.mathf.PingPong(progress, 1))
		material.color = c

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	local c = material.color
	c.r = start_color.r
	c.g = start_color.g
	c.b = start_color.b
	material.color = c
end

function local_class:event_clear()
	local tardis = self.get_tardis()
	character_util.set_active_state(tardis, 'disabled')

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

	get_character('dovahkiingirl').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
