function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_2' or
					e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_3' then
				self.fail_zone_name = nil
				return true
			end

		elseif e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == 'chair_leave_zone' then
			local chair = get_field_object('dragon_boy_chair_6')
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, chair) and not self.is_chair_fail then
				if chair.Holdable.IsHeld then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.out_chair, self)
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.reset_chair, self, chair))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_2' or
				e.Zone.Name == 'chair_fail_zone_3' then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
				self.fail_zone_name = e.Zone.Name
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('dragon_boy_chair_6')) then
			if self.fail_zone_name ~= nil then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.fail_girl, self, self.fail_zone_name))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local girl = get_character('dovahkiingirl')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, girl) then
			-- 킁킁… 이 체취… 희미하지만 드래곤?!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(girl,
					{ key = 'nightmare_china_dovahkiin_2', skip = true })
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 의자를 따라다니는 도바킨 소녀
function local_class:follow_chair()
	local girl = get_character('dovahkiingirl')
	local chair = get_field_object('dragon_boy_chair_6')

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(chair.Position - girl.Position).normalized
	local dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((chair.Position - girl.Position).magnitude)

	while true do
		character_util.set_direction(girl, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
				vector_util.to_direction(chair.Position - girl.Position)))

		dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((chair.Position - girl.Position).magnitude)
		dir = vector_util.get_x0z(chair.Position - girl.Position).normalized

		if dist > 2 then
			character_util.set_emotion(girl, { name = 'greed' })
			character_util.set_anim(girl, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
			character_util.move_to(girl, girl.Position + dir, nil, 2.5)
		elseif dist < 1.2 then

			if chair.Holdable.IsHeld then
				character_util.set_emotion(girl, { name = 'greed' })
				character_util.set_anim(girl, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(girl, { name = 'greed' })
				character_util.set_anim(girl, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_chair(chair)

	stop_coroutine(self.follow_chair_coroutine)
	self.follow_chair_coroutine = nil

	chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	wait_for_sec(1.3)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(chair.Position)

	if chair.Position.z < 40 then
		chair.Position = vector(chair.Position.x, 0, 44)
	else

	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(chair.Position)
	chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, 1), 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:fail_chair(zone_name, dir)
	local chair = get_field_object('dragon_boy_chair_6')

	self.is_chair_fail = true

	local free_fall
	if zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_1' or zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_2' then
		free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(4.9, 9.8, chair.Position.y, 0)
	elseif zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_3' then
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(7.84, 9.8, chair.Position.y, 0)
		elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(4.9, 9.8, chair.Position.y, 0)
		end
	end

	chair.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
	chair.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	local pos = chair.Position
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 2.5 do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		if zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_1' or zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_2' then
			chair.Position = pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y + vector(
					(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) * 3.5, 0, 0)
		elseif zone_name == 'chair_fail_zone_3' then
			if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
				chair.Position = pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y + vector(
						0 * 1, 0, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) * 1.5)
			elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
				chair.Position = pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y + vector(
						0, 0, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) * -2)

			end
		end

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= 1.5 then
			chair.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (2 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	chair.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.follow_chair_coroutine = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    self.meatList = nil
    self.seeIntro = false

    self.markerName = "dragon_boy"

function local_class:enter()
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestForcedStartEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    self.dragonBoy = get_character(self.dragonBoyName)

function local_class:start()

    self.controller.scene:add_callback('RemoveObjects', { controller = self, func = self.remove_objects } )

    self.controller.scene:add_callback('EatMeat', { controller = self, func = self.eat_meat } )
    self.controller.scene:add_callback('BreakObjects', { controller = self, func = self.break_objects } )
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.introZoneName then
            local prisonProgress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.chinaPrisonEscapeId).InnerProgress
            if prisonProgress >= 1 and not self.seeIntro then
                self.seeIntro = true
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))
            end
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.QuestForcedStartEvent) then
        if e.QuestId == self.quest_spec.QuestId then
            quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.dragonBoy)
            ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.markerName)
            ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.markerName, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
                    self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.dragonBoy)

            quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
            quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.trackerName1))
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent) then
        if e.DoorHandleName == self.keyDoorName then
            quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
            quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.trackerName2))
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.dragonBoy then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:intro_event()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    yield_return(self.controller.scene, "intro")

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:quest_open()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.dragonBoy)

    character_util.align_party(self.dragonBoy, "down")

    if not self.skipRequest then
        yield_return(self.controller.scene, "quest_open")
        self.skipRequest = true
    end

    local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

    if is_accepted then
        floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

        screen_util.quest_accept_event()

        user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

        yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
        field_ui_manager:Show()
        user_party:ResetControllers()
    else
        screen_util.quest_decline_Event()
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.dragonBoy)
        field_ui_manager:Show()
        user_party:ResetControllers()
    end
end

function local_class:eat_meat()

    local curTime = unity_class.time.time
    local eatTime = 1

    local startScale = 1;
    local endScale = 0;

    local curPos = curMeat.Position;
    local shakeMaxX = 0.2;
    local shakeMaxZ = 0.1;

    while unity_class.time.time - curTime < eatTime do
        local curScale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - curTime, startScale, endScale - startScale, eatTime)

        curMeat.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * curScale;
        curMeat.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * curScale;

        local curShakeX = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, shakeMaxX)
        local curShakeZ = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, shakeMaxZ)

        curMeat.Position = curPos + vector(curShakeX, 0, curShakeZ)

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    curMeat.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero;
    curMeat.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero;

function local_class:blackhole_scaling(scalingTime, startScale, targetScale)
    local tp = 0

    while tp <= scalingTime do
        local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / scalingTime)

        if progress <= 0 then
            progress = 0.01
        end

        self.blackhole.transform.localScale = startScale * (1 - progress) + targetScale * progress

        tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
end

function local_class:fly_dragonboy(startpos, targetpos, duration)
    local tp = 0

    while tp <= duration do
        local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(tp, 0, 1, duration))

        self.dragonBoy.Position = startpos * (1 - progress) + targetpos * progress

        tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

end

function local_class:get_dragonBoy()
    local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId
    local dragonBoyCharacter = self.dragonBoy
    local alreadyHasCharacter =  user:GetCharacter(char_spec.DragonBoy, true) ~= nil
    local ismaxparty = user_party.Count >= CS.Oak.User.Me.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount

    local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
    character_theatre_data.Character = dragonBoyCharacter
    character_theatre_data.CardName = "dragon_boy"
    character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString("dragon_boy_title")
    character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString("dragon_boy_subtitle")
    character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString("dragon_boy_desc")
    character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = ismaxparty
    character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = alreadyHasCharacter
    character_theatre_data.VoiceId = 156
    character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

    local isended_threatre = false

    CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
        isended_threatre = true
    end)

    while not isended_threatre do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("dragon_boy")
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

    yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

    if not ismaxparty and not alreadyHasCharacter then
        local getted_character = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.DragonBoy)
        CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(dragonBoyCharacter, getted_character, user, user_party)
    end
end

end

function local_class:move_waypoint(character, targetpos, duration, speed, prevAnimCancel, run)
    if prevAnimCancel then
        character:RemoveAnimation()
    end

    if duration > 0 then
        local move_done = false
        local diff = (targetpos - character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
        local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(targetpos, diff / duration, run)
        info.callback = function()
            move_done = true
        end

        CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(character, info)

        while not move_done do
            coroutine.yield(nil)
        end
    else
        if speed > 0 then
            local move_done = false
            local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(targetpos, speed, run)
            info.callback = function()
                move_done = true
            end

            CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(character, info)

            while not move_done do
                coroutine.yield(nil)
            end
        else
            character.Position = targetpos
        end
    end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

					self.substage_obj.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.check_marker, self))
		end
	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.dragon_knight = nil
	self.substage_obj = nil
	self.scene = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == "battle_start" then
			if not self.see_battle_intro then
				self.see_battle_intro = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.start_battle, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "dragon_knight" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.defeat_dragon_knight, self))
		end

	return false

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)


end

function local_class:start_battle()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:battle_start())

	screen_util.show_boss_title("dragon_knight_boss_title",
			"dragon_knight_boss_subtitle", 2)

	camera_util.move(self.dragon_knight.Position, 0.5, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.dragon_knight:RemoveAnimation()
	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToMonster(self.dragon_knight, "dragon_knight")
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.dragon_knight, user_party_leader, "battle")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("dragon_knight_door", false))

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	Instantiate(self.dragon_knight.Position)
	--.Instantiate(
			--self.dragon_knight.Position)
	obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	end

function local_class:start()

	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none or self.current_progress == self.event_progress.refused_trade then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trade_with_black, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_addicts' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_to_addicts then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('addict_battle_gate_' .. i))
		end

		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.did_drug
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.player_do_drug, self)
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'illusion_4' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.did_drug then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.awake_illusion, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trade_with_black()
	local black = get_character('black')

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(black)
	party_util.align_to_target(black, black.Direction)

	if self.current_progress < self.event_progress.refused_trade then
		-- 기다리게 한 것 같군. 물건은 여기 있어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(black, { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_11', skip = true })
	end

	-- 원더랜드로 갈 준비는 됐지?
	black:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
	black:SetAnimation('cross_arm', false)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(black, {key = 'substage_drug_dealer_12', skip = true})

	-- 물건을 받는다. / 물건을 받지 않는다
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({{'substage_drug_dealer_14_1', 'brutal'}, {'substage_drug_dealer_14_2', 'mercy'}})

	-- 물건을 받았을 때
	if result == 1 then
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
		black:RemoveEmotion()
		black:SetAnimation('eat', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		eat_sfx:Stop()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crystal_01' })
		black:RemoveAnimation()
		self.player_drug = self.controller:drop_drug(black.Position, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 자, 이게 그린 큐브… 네가 찾던 ‘티켓’이야.
		black:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(black, { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_15', skip = true })

		-- 써보고 더 필요하면 날 찾아와.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(black, {key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16', skip = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(black, { waypoints = black.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 8, speed = 4 })

		local black = get_character('black')
		black.Position = vector(-47.5, 0, -27.5)
		black.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
		black:RemoveEmotion()
		black:RemoveAnimation()
		black:SetAnimation('eat', true)

		self:battle_to_addicts()
	else
		-- 지금 아니면 구하기 힘들건데 괜찮겠어?
		black:SetAnimation('question', false)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(black, { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_14_3', skip = true })

		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.refused_trade
	end
end

function local_class:battle_to_addicts()
	local addicts = {
		get_character('battle_addict_1'),
		get_character('battle_addict_2'),
		get_character('battle_addict_3'),
		get_character('battle_addict_4'),
	}

	--camera_util.move_async(vector(-32, 0, 0), 0.75)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	for _, addict in ipairs(addicts) do
		addict:Shake(0.05, 1)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	party_util.set_emotion('surprise')
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
	for _, addict in ipairs(addicts) do
		character_util.look_at(addict, user_party.Leader)
		addict:SetEmotion('greed', true)
		addict:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.normal_jump(addict)
	end

	-- 원더랜드!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01'})
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[1], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_1', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[2], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_1', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[3], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_1', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[4], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_1', skip = true })
	})

	-- 내가 갈거야! 내놔!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[1], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_2', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[2], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_2', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[3], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_2', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, addicts[4], { key = 'substage_drug_dealer_16_2', skip = true })

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		seen_drug_making = 2,
		interacted_to_dealer = 3,
		battle_drug_dealer = 4,
		ending = 5
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.exposed_drug = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated')
	message_system:Subscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_IronMissile_Explosion')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 and stage.Name == self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(stage_launch_util.default_launch_with_marker_name, 'section_2_start')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.exposed_drug = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('black')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_black, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'see_drug_making') and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.seen_drug_making
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.witness_making_drug, self)
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'battle_to_dealers') and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.interacted_to_dealer then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle_drug_dealer
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_black, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('black')) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_drug_dealer then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
	end

	return false

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'illusion_4' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.interacted_to_dealer then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.end_illusion, self.controller)

function local_class:open_reward_door()
	local reward_door = get_field_object('reward_door')
	local door_opened = reward_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen
	local door_open_handler =
	{
		callback = function(_, e)
			door_opened = e.DoorHandleName == 'reward_door'
			return true
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(door_open_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'callback')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('reward_door', false))
	while not door_opened do coroutine.yield() end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(door_open_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
end

	local y_calc = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(3, 9, 0, 2, cb)
	while not y_calc:IsDone() do

		y_calc:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local cur_pos = drug.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * unity_class.time.deltaTime

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return true end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return true end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_elf_zone_name then
		if not self.see_intro then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_battle, self))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.ignore_poacher_zone_name then
		if self.kickout_elf then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_b, self, true))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.civilian_zone_name then
		if not self.see_civilian_positive_talk then
			self.see_civilian_positive_talk = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.controller.scene.civilian_positive_talk, self.controller.scene))

		elseif not self.see_civilian_nagative_talk and self.kickout_elf then
			self.see_civilian_nagative_talk = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.controller.scene.civilian_negative_talk, self.controller.scene))

		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return true end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return true end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_elf_zone_name then
		if self.save_elf and not self.see_event then
			self.see_event = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elf_archer_request, self))
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.poacher) then
		if self.kickout_elf then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_b, self))
		else
			if stage.Name == "substage_1_7" then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.poacher, {key = self.talk_name1})
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.poacher, {key = self.talk_name2})
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.elf_archer) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.elf_archer, {key = self.talk_name3})
	elseif self.kickout_elf then
		self.controller:check_civilian_talk(e, self.civilians, false)
	else
		self.controller:check_civilian_talk(e, self.civilians, true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_elf_archer, self))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start_battle()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	--??
	--coroutine.yield(nil)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "fight_with_elf_1")

	local wait = true
	local lie = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			lie = true
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.elf_archer, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if lie then
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "lie")
	else
		self.see_intro = true

		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "fight_with_elf_2")

		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.elf_archer, self.battle_group_name)
		character_util.set_death_type(self.elf_archer, "prostrate")
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.elf_archer, user_party_leader, "battle")

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
		self:publish_battle_gate(false)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
	end

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:defeat_elf_archer()
	self:publish_battle_gate(true)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.elf_archer)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "talk_with_elf")

	local wait = true
	local mercy = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name3),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			mercy = true
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name4),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.elf_archer, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if mercy then
		self.save_elf = true
		self.elf_archer.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.poacher_door_name, true))
		self.kickout_elf = true

		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "kick_out_elf")

		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.poacher)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.poacher)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name3))
		CS.SpeechBubble.Return(self.elf_archer)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:ending_b(outofzone)
	local out_of_zone
	if out_of_zone == nil then
		out_of_zone = false
	end

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.poacher)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	if outofzone then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "ignore_poacher_1")
	else
		character_util.set_direction(self.poacher, "right")
		character_util.align_party(self.poacher, "right")
	end

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "ending_violent")
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 2)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:elf_archer_request()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	if user_party_leader.Position.x < 6 then
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "elf_request_align_a")
	else
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "elf_request_align_b")
	end

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "elf_request")

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:player_move_to_poacher()
	return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_poacher, self))
end

function local_class:move_to_poacher()
	self.controller:player_move_to_poacher(self.poacher)
end

function local_class:publish_battle_gate(is_open)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if is_open then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(string.format("battlegate_%d", i)))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(string.format("battlegate_%d", i)))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return true end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.zone_name then
		if self.get_request then
			self.get_request = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.poacher_call_player, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.poacher) then
		if stage.Name == "substage_1_7" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.poacher_call_player, self, true))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.elf_archer, {key = self.talk_name3})
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.elf_archer) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.elf_archer, {key = self.talk_name2})
	else
		self.controller:check_civilian_talk(e, self.civilians, true)
	end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_poacher, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_door_close_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == self.poacher_door_name then
		self.is_closed_poacher_battle_door = true
	end
end

function local_class:poacher_call_player(isinteract)
	local is_interact
	if isinteract == nil then
		is_interact = false
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.poacher)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	if not is_interact then
		character_util.stop(user_party_leader)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		self.poacher_called_player = true

		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "ignore_poacher_2")
	else
		character_util.set_direction(self.poacher, "down")
		character_util.align_party(self.poacher, "down")
	end

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "kick_out_poacher")

	local wait = true
	local give_money = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			give_money = true
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.elf_archer, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if give_money then
		if user.Gold < 1000 then
			character_util.set_emotion(self.poacher, {name = "mad"})
			character_util.set_anim(self.poacher, {name = "release"})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.poacher, {key = self.talk_name4, skip = true})
			self.poacher:RemoveEmotion()
			self.poacher:RemoveAnimation()
		else
			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.StageApiRouter.SendPayGold, stage.StageId, 1000)
			yield_return(self.controller.scene, "give_money_to_poacher")
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		end
	else
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "fight_with_poacher")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.poacher_door_name, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.poacher_battle_gate_name))

		while not self.is_closed_poacher_battle_door do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self. is_fight = true
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.poacher, self.poacher_monster_group_name)
		character_util.set_death_type(self.poacher, "prostrate")

		command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.poacher, user_party_leader, "battle")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
	end

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:defeat_poacher()
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.poacher_door_name, true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.poacher_battle_gate_name))
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.poacher)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "poacher_runaway")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:player_move_to_poacher()
	return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_poacher, self))
end

function local_class:move_to_poacher()
	self.controller:player_move_to_poacher(self.poacher)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	end

	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.dad = nil

function local_class:on_event(e)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_request, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_dad_position_to_interact()
	while true do
		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party_leader.Position, self.dad.Position) then
			if not self.cannot_interact and self.dad.Position.x < 90 or self.dad.Position.x > 103 then
				self.cannot_interact = true
				self.dad.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			elseif self.cannot_interact and (self.dad.Position.x >= 90 and self.dad.Position.x <= 103) then
				self.cannot_interact = false
				self.dad.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
				self.dad.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_request()
	self.controller:stop_run()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.dad, 1, 0)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.dad)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local go = stage.UIRoot.transform:Find("DungeonKingdomRankBoardMini")
	local rank_board_mini
	if go ~= nil then
		rank_board_mini = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.DungeonKingdomRankBoardMini))
	end


	if rank_board_mini ~= nil then
		rank_board_mini.Deactivated = true
	end

	local go2 = stage.UIRoot.transform:Find("DungeonKingdomRankBoard")
	local rank_board
	if go2 ~= nil then
		rank_board = go2:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.DungeonKingdomRankBoard))
	end

	if rank_board ~= nil then
		rank_board.Deactivated = true
	end

	local dir = (user_party_leader.Position - self.dad.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.align_party(self.dad, dir)
	character_util.set_direction(self.dad, dir)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "dadCry")

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if is_accepted then
		stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
			substage_name = self.substage_map.OpenStageName,
			substage_open_string_key = self.substage_map.OpenMessage
		})
		coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.dad)
		self.controller:start_run()
	end

	if rank_board_mini ~= nil then
		rank_board_mini.Deactivated = false
	end

	if rank_board ~= nil then
		rank_board.Deactivated = false
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		self.fortune_teller.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.fortune_teller = nil
	self.table = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fortune_teller) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.table) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.talk_with_fortune_teller, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:talk_with_fortune_teller()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.fortune_teller)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.spell_sfx_name)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller:align())

	if not self.skip_request then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:quest_scene())
		self.skip_request = true
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_progress)

	if accepted then
		if user.Gold < 1000 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fortune_teller, {key = self.talk_name1, skip = true})
			screen_util.quest_decline_Event()
		else
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:got_quest())

			screen_util.quest_accept_event()
			coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.StageApiRouter.SendPayGold(stage.StageId, 1000))
		end
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fortune_teller, {key = self.talk_name2, skip = true})
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.fortune_teller)
	end
	party_util.remove_animation()
end

end

	local agree = false

		end})

		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			agree = true
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.fortune_teller, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

		if user.Gold < 1000 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fortune_teller, {key = self.talk_name2,
			                                                                  skip = true})

			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.fortune_teller)

			                            end_target = user_party_leader})

			user_party:ResetControllers()
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,

			coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))

			                            end_target = user_party_leader})

			party_util.remove_animation()
			user_party:ResetControllers()
		end
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fortune_teller, {key = self.talk_name3,
		skip = true})

		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.fortune_teller)
		party_util.remove_animation()

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(12, 30, 0, 0)
	local flying_time = 0.8

	local start_pos = user_party_leader.Position
	local end_pos = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, 52.5)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_Sfx_name)

		user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
		pot:ConsumeComplete()

		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:flowerpot())
		table.insert(self.fall_zone_list, zone_name)
	elseif zone_name == "fortune_fall_2" then

		local banana = drop_item_util.create_item(

			sfx_name = self.motor_cycle_move_sfx_name, loop = true, fade_in_time = 1.5,
			type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "npc"})

		character_util.set_position(self.rider2, vector(0.7, 0, 36))

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	end
	return false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
		if not self.quest_progress.CustomStates:ContainsKey("gamezone_enter") then
			self.intro = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.enter_fortune_zone, self))
			return true
		else
			self.out_talkable = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fortune_teller) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.table) then
		if self.out_talkable then
			if not self.quest_progress.CustomStates:ContainsKey("gamezone_enter") then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.talk_out_side1, self))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.talk_out_side2, self))
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fortune_teller_monte) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				self.talk_out_side, self))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pot_list[1]) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pot_list[2]) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pot_list[3]) then
		if self.pot_talkable then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.check_pot, self, e.Target))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if string.find(e.FieldObject.Name, "game_pot") then
		if not self.is_crashed then
			self.is_crashed = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.explosion, self, e.FieldObject))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, "bomb") and self.pot_talkable then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				self.pot_disable, self, 5))
	end
end

	self.fx_dead:Instantiate(self.monte_kid.Position)
end

function local_class:thief_effect()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.explosion_sfx_name)
	self.fx_dead:Instantiate(vector(58, 0, 35.5))
end

function local_class:pot_disable(duration)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
	self.pot_talkable = false

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration))

	self.pot_talkable = true
end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.quest_spec.QuestId,

function local_class:move_pots()
	local passed_time = 0
	local progress_x, progress_z
	local duration = 0.5

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.pot_moving_sfx_name)

	local target_list = {}
	local target_idx = {1, 2, 3}

	table.remove(target_idx, math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, #self.pot_list + 1)))

	if self.pot_list[target_idx[1]].Position.x > self.pot_list[target_idx[2]].Position.x then
		table.insert(target_list, self.pot_list[target_idx[2]])
		table.insert(target_list, self.pot_list[target_idx[1]])
	else
		table.insert(target_list, self.pot_list[target_idx[1]])
		table.insert(target_list, self.pot_list[target_idx[2]])
	end

	local target1_x = target_list[1].Position.x
	local target1_z = target_list[1].Position.z
	local target2_x = target_list[2].Position.x
	local target2_z = target_list[2].Position.z

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.monte_kid_move, self, target_list[1], target_list[2]))

	while passed_time <= duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		passed_time = passed_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress_z = 0.7 * math.sin(passed_time / duration * math.pi)
		progress_x = passed_time / duration * (target2_x - target1_x)

		target_list[1].Position = vector(target1_x + progress_x, 0, target1_z - progress_z)
		target_list[2].Position = vector(target2_x - progress_x, 0, target2_z + progress_z)
	end

	local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d",self.fortune_spectator_name,
			math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 11))))
	local talk_key = game_string:GetString(string.format("%s%d", self.fortune_spectator_name,
			math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(5, 16))))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(c, {key = talk_key})

	target_list[1].Position = vector(target2_x, 0, target2_z)
	target_list[2].Position = vector(target1_x, 0, target1_z)
end

function local_class:monte_kid_move(target1, target2)
	local rand = math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 2))

	local target_Start
	if rand % 2 == 0 then
		target_Start = target1
	else
		target_Start = target2
	end

	local target_end
	if rand % 2 == 0 then
		target_end = target2
	else
		target_end = target1
	end

	local upper
	if rand % 2 == 0 then
		upper = 1.2
	else
		upper = -1.2
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.monte_kid, target1.Position)

	local waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoints:Add(vector(target_Start.Position.x, 0, target_Start.Position.z + upper))
	waypoints:Add(vector(target_end.Position.x, 0, target_end.Position.z + upper))
	waypoints:Add(vector(target_end.Position.x, 0, target_end.Position.z))

	local dist = math.abs(target_Start.Position.x - target_end.Position.x) + 2.4
	local move_time = 0.45

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.monte_kid, waypoints, dist / move_time, true, "stop",
			nil, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, true)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(move_time))
end

function local_class:check_pot(target_pot)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.pot_list[1])
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.pot_list[2])
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.pot_list[3])

	character_util.align_party(target_pot, "down")

	for i = 1, #self.pot_list do
		if self.pot_list[i] == target_pot then
			table.remove(self.pot_list, i)
		end
	end

	local fake_pot = self.pot_list[math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, #self.pot_list  + 1))]
	table.insert(self.pot_list, target_pot)

	local move_pos = fake_pot.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.fortune_teller_monte, move_pos, 3, false, "stop",
	"floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:check_pot1())

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.find_coin_sfx_name)

	local item_Data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
	local item_id = item_Data:GetSpec("coin").Id

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{pos = fake_pot.Position, target = self.fortune_teller_monte.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
			itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

	local custom_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("Top Effects")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))

	item:MarkForLooter(self.fortune_teller_monte)
	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("Default")
	item:ConsumeComplete()

	coroutine.yield(lua_helper.call_nullable(self.controller.scene, string.format("%s%d",
			"check_pot2_", math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 4))), self.controller.scene))

	local wait = true
	local about = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			about = true
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.fortune_teller, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.pot_talkable = fake_pot

	if about then
		self.out_talkable = true

		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:abort_game1())
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.fortune_teller)

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.fortune_teller)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)

		camera_util.move(nil, 0, {target = user_party_leader,
		                          end_target = user_party_leader})
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:abort_game2())
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:restart_game())
		self.fail_count = self.fail_count + 1
		coroutine.yield(self:move_pots_cmd())
	end

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:explosion(target)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
	for i = 1, #self.pot_list do
		if self.pot_list[i] == target then
			table.remove(self.pot_list, i)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:quest_end())

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))
end

function local_class:align_stage4()
	camera_util.move(vector(58, 0, 35), 0.5)

	local waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if user_party_leader.Position.x > 58 then
			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 35.7 then
				waypoints:Add(vector(60, 0, 36))
			end
			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 33.3 then
				waypoints:Add(vector(60, 0, 33))
			end
		else
			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 35.7 then
				waypoints:Add(vector(56, 0, 36))

			if user_party_leader.Position.z > 33.3 then

				party_util.remove_animation()

		end

	if waypoints.Count > 0 then

		character_util.move_waypoint(user_party[i], waypoints, 4, false, "stop",
		"floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	end

	while true do
		if user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if user_party_leader.Position.x > 58 then
		character_util.align_party(self.fortune_teller, "right")
	else
		character_util.align_party(self.fortune_teller, "left")
	end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 내기 토끼 전체 수
	self.rabbit_count = 15
	-- 잡은 토끼 수
	self.get_count = 0
	-- 리셋 이펙트
	self.reset_effect = 'FX_reset_object'

	self.party_list = nil
	-- 미니게임 코루틴
	self.mini_game_coroutine = nil
	-- 클리어 했는지
	self.saw_betting_rabbit = false

	-- 배팅을 시작했는지
	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		betting = 2,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= 'fox_1_4' then
		return true
	end

	local rabbit = get_character('betting_rabbit')
	rabbit.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_position(rabbit,
			get_field_object('betting_star_piece').Position + vector(-1, 0, -1))
	rabbit:SetGiantFactor('transform', 1.5)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, self.rabbit_count do

end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.run_sound ~= nil then
		self.run_sound:Stop()
		self.run_sound = nil
	end

	self.mini_game_coroutine = nil
	self.follow_party_list = nil
	self.party_list = nil

	local rabbit = get_character('betting_rabbit')
	rabbit.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) and not self.saw_betting_rabbit then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('betting_rabbit')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.accept_bet, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e.Params[0] == 'over_worm_game' and
			self.current_progress == self.event_progress.betting then
		stop_coroutine(self.mini_game_coroutine)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_betting, self, false)
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent) then
		self.is_pause = true
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent) then
		self.is_pause = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:accept_bet()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	local rabbit = get_character('betting_rabbit')

	self.follow_party_list = {}

	local npcs = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npcs.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(npcs[i].FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState) then
			table.insert(self.follow_party_list, npcs[i])
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.follow_party_list do
		self.follow_party_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		self.follow_party_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.move_to(self.follow_party_list[i], rabbit.Position + vector(1.5 + i * 0.7, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
	end

	character_util.align_party(rabbit, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #self.follow_party_list do
		character_util.set_direction(self.follow_party_list[i], 'left')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 아기 자라들 걷는 속도가 예사롭지 않던데… 훌륭한 선생님이 붙어서 그런가 봐요?

	-- 이러다 우리 애들이 자라보다 뒤처지면 큰일인데~
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rabbit, { key = 'fox_betting_rabbit_talk_2', skip = true })

	-- 선생님, 제가 과외비 넉넉히 드릴게요. 우리 애들 특별 과외 좀 해주시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rabbit, { key = 'fox_betting_rabbit_talk_3', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 도와준다. / 거절한다.
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local accept = false
	local wait = true
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('fox_betting_rabbit_branch_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()

			accept = true

		Text = game_string:GetString('fox_betting_rabbit_branch_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(rabbit, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not accept then
		for i = 1, #self.follow_party_list do
			local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.follow_party_list[i], user_party, i - 1, 0, false)
			self.follow_party_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
			self.follow_party_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()

	else

		rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		rabbit.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		rabbit.Position = stage.Field:GetMarker('move_point_' .. rand_dir).position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

		character_util.move_waypoint(rabbit, {
			rabbit.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5),
			vector(destination.x, 0, rabbit.Position.z + 2.5),
			destination
		}, 4, true, nil, nil, 'up')

		if i > 5 and not token then
			token = true
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'surprise'})
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
	running_sound:FadeOut(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:mini_game()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	local bet_rabbit = get_character('betting_rabbit')
	character_util.set_position(bet_rabbit, vector(99, 0, 99))
	local game_position = stage.Field:GetMarker('start_point').position

	-- 파티원들 제외
	self:deactivate_party(false)

	-- 리더 위치 변경
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, game_position)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 엄마 토끼 설정
	character_util.set_direction(bet_rabbit, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(bet_rabbit, game_position + vector(1,0,0))
	bet_rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(bet_rabbit, user_party, 0, 0, 0.3, false)
	bet_rabbit:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local worm_game_gate = get_field_object('wormgame_gate_' .. i)
		worm_game_gate.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	-- 토끼 세팅
	local current_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	for i = 1, self.rabbit_count do
		local rabbit = get_character('rabbit_' .. i)

		local x = random_util.get_random_int(1, 6)
		local y = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
		local init_pos = stage.Field:GetMarker('move_point_' .. x).position + vector(0, 0, y * 2)

		local rand_dir = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
		if rand_dir == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'left')
		elseif rand_dir == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'up')
		elseif rand_dir == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'down')
		end

		if current_pos ~= init_pos then
			character_util.set_position(rabbit, init_pos)
			rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			rabbit.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		else
			i = i - 1
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--camera_util.move(vector(-99,0,-77), 0)
	--camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = "victory_get", loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 1 })

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.betting

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 플레이어 state 변경
	local speed = 4
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerWormGameMoveState.Create(user_party.Leader, speed, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	self.run_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'run' })
	local cur_position = vector(99,0,99)
	local check_time = 0
	-- 게임 진행 중 다음에 나올 토끼 생성
	while self.get_count < self.rabbit_count do
		local rest = self.rabbit_count - self.get_count
		local rabbit = get_character('rabbit_' .. self.get_count + 1)
		if rabbit.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_guild_warp_01')
			rabbit.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(rabbit.Position)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_collision, self, rabbit))

			if rest == self.rabbit_count then
			elseif rest == self.rabbit_count - 1 then
				-- 꼴찌야!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(bet_rabbit,
						{ key=  game_string:Format("fox_betting_rabbit_count_0", self.rabbit_count)
						})
			elseif rest > 2 then
				-- N등? 잘한다 잘해~
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(bet_rabbit,
						{ key=  game_string:Format("fox_betting_rabbit_count_1", rest + 1)
						})
			elseif rest == 2 then
				-- 3등!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(bet_rabbit,
						{ key=  "fox_betting_rabbit_count_2"})
			elseif rest == 1 then
				-- 2등!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(bet_rabbit,
						{ key=  "fox_betting_rabbit_count_3"})
			end
		end

		if not self.is_pause then
			if cur_position == user_party.Leader.Position then
				check_time = check_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				if check_time > 0.05 then
					self.mini_game_coroutine = nil

					local knock_back_info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
					knock_back_info.type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
					knock_back_info.stun = true
					knock_back_info.direction = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
					knock_back_info.impactForce = 5000
					knock_back_info.impactTime = 0.05
					knock_back_info.muCoefficient = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient

					local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party.Leader, knock_back_info)
					user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_betting, self, false))
					return
				end
			else
				cur_position = user_party.Leader.Position
				check_time = 0
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.get_count == self.rabbit_count then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_betting, self, true)
		return
	end
end

-- 토끼 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_collision(rabbit)
	local move_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_rabbit, self, rabbit))

	local leader_crashed = false
	local next_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local cur_pos = next_pos
	while not leader_crashed and lua_helper.type_compare(rabbit.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour) do
		cur_pos = next_pos
		next_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

		local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(user_party.Leader.Bounds, next_pos - cur_pos)

		if collide_fos:Contains(rabbit) and not leader_crashed then
			leader_crashed = true
		end
		collide_fos:Dispose()
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if leader_crashed then
		stop_coroutine(move_coroutine)
		rabbit.Position = cur_pos
		rabbit.Direction = user_party.Leader.Direction;

		rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(rabbit, user_party, self.get_count + 1, 0, 0.3, false)
		rabbit:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		self.get_count = self.get_count + 1

		rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

-- 토끼 움직임
function local_class:moving_rabbit(rabbit)
	local current_pos = nil
	while lua_helper.type_compare(rabbit.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour) do
		local x = random_util.get_random_int(1, 6)
		local y = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)

		local marker_pos = stage.Field:GetMarker('move_point_' .. x).position
		local next_x = vector(marker_pos.x, 0, rabbit.Position.z)
		local next_y = vector(rabbit.Position.x, 0, -80 + y * 2)
		local next_pos = marker_pos + vector(0, 0, y * 2)

		if current_pos ~= next_pos then
			current_pos = next_pos
			if rand == 1 then
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_x, nil, 4, true, true)
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_pos, nil, 4, true, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			elseif rand == 2 then
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_y, nil, 4, true, true)
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_pos, nil, 4, true, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			elseif rand == 3 then
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_x, nil, 4, true, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			elseif rand == 4 then
				character_util.move_to_async(rabbit, next_y, nil, 4, true, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 전체 파티원 제외
function local_class:deactivate_party(option)
	-- option : false 경우 파티원 제외
	-- option : true 경우 따라다니던 토끼 제외
	if not option then
		self.party_list = {}

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local cur_party_member = user_party[i]

			table.insert(self.party_list, cur_party_member)
		end

		for i = 1, #self.party_list do
			if i ~= 1 then
				character_util.convert_to_npc(self.party_list[i])
				self.party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end
		end

		for i = 1, #self.follow_party_list do
			self.follow_party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end

	else
		for i = 1, self.rabbit_count do
			local rabbit = get_character('rabbit_' .. i)
			rabbit:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.set_position(rabbit, vector(99, 0, 99))
			rabbit.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

end

-- 제외했던 파티원 합류
function local_class:activate_party()
	for i = 1, #self.party_list do
		if i ~= 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.party_list[i], user_party, false)

			self.party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end

	self.party_list = nil

	if self.follow_party_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.follow_party_list do
			local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.follow_party_list[i], user_party, i - 1, 0, false)
			self.follow_party_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
			self.follow_party_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.follow_party_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end

		self.follow_party_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.controller.daegam_starpiece_name) then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
			if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.daegam_zone_name then
				if not self.on_daegam then
					if e.FieldObject == self.get_mouse_knight() then
						self.on_daegam = true
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
								self.daegam_start, self))
					end
				end
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) and self.on_nobi_ready then
					if not self.on_daegam_ready then
						local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
						nobi.Interactable.Talk = ''
						self.daegam.Interactable.Talk = ''
						nobi.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
					else
						self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = self.daegam_init_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -2)
					end
				end
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.player) and self.on_nobi_ready then
					local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
					nobi.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
					nobi.Interactable.Talk = self.daegam_talk_name .. 5
					self.daegam.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
					self.daegam.Interactable.Talk = self.daegam_talk_name .. 4
					self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = vector(999, 999, 999)
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.daegam_nail_interact) and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) then
				if self.on_daegam_ready then
					--쥐 > 대감으로 변신
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.daegam_transform, self)
				end
			end

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)) and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.nobi_interact, self))
			end

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.daegam) and lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.daegam_player) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.daegam_progress, self))
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
			if e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == self.daegam_zone_name then
				if e.FieldObject == self.daegam_player and not self.on_daegam_fail then
					self.daegam_nail_item.Position = self.daegam_init_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -2)
					self.daegam_nail_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
					self.daegam_nail_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
					self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = self.daegam_init_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -2)
					self.daegam.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.daegam_reset, self))
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if e.Params[0] == 'change_end' then
				self.on_transform = false
				-- 기존 ZoneLeaveEvent 에 있던 내용
				--[[
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) and self.on_nobi_ready and not self.on_daegam_ready then
					local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
					nobi.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
				end
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.player) then
					local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
					nobi.Interactable.Talk = ''
					self.daegam.Interactable.Talk = ''
				end
				]]
				-- 기존 ZoneEnterEvent 에 있던 내용
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) and self.on_nobi_ready then
					local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
					nobi.Interactable.Talk = ''
					self.daegam.Interactable.Talk = ''
					if not self.on_daegam_ready then
						nobi.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
					else
						self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = self.daegam_init_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -2)
					end
				end
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.player) and self.on_nobi_ready then
					local nobi = get_character(self.nobi_name .. 1)
					nobi.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
					nobi.Interactable.Talk = self.daegam_talk_name .. 5
					self.daegam.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
					self.daegam.Interactable.Talk = self.daegam_talk_name .. 4
					self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = vector(999, 999, 999)
				end
			else if e.Params[0] == 'change_start' then
				self.on_transform = true
			end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:daegam_transform()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat'})
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true})
	if user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.daegam_nail_item.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end
	local timer = 0
	local duration = 1
	while timer < duration do
		if self.on_transform then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			self.daegam_nail_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
			self.daegam_nail_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
			eat_sfx:Stop()
			return
		end
		self.daegam_nail_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (0.5 - (timer / 2))
		self.daegam_nail_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (0.5 - (timer / 2))
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	self.daegam_nail_item.Position = vector(999, 999, 999)
	self.daegam_nail_interact.Position = vector(999, 999, 999)

	get_field_object(self.daegam_blocker_name).Position = vector(-3, 0, 67)

	self.daegam_player.Position = user_party.Leader.Position
	character_util.set_active_state(self.daegam_player, 'enabled')

	local members = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		members:Add(user_party[i])
	end

	for i = 0, members.Count - 1 do
		if i == 0 then
			members[i]:RemoveGiantFactor('transform')
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.daegam_player)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explode_effect_name):Instantiate(self.daegam_player.Position)
		else
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(members[i], user_party)
			character_util.set_active_state(members[i], 'enabled')
		end
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'transformation_button_disabled' }))

	self.daegam.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

local local_class = newclass('FoxDriveOutCatSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxDriveOutCat @
		Comment = 퀘스트 수주 - 고양이 제압까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		requested_help = 2,
		performing = 3,
		battle = 4,
		fail = 5,
		clear = 6
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.reserved_party_members = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local rat1 = get_character('move_rat_1')
	rat1:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	rat1:SetAnimation('question', false)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(rat1)
	character_util.add_listener(rat1, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.reserved_party_members = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('move_rat_1')) then
		if self.current_progress <= self.event_progress.requested_help then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_help, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local is_hit_cat = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_character('present_cat')) and
						lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, user_party.Leader)
	if is_hit_cat and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.fail
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fail_process, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('present_cat')) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.clear
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.success_process, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'present_cat_battle') and
			(self.current_progress == self.event_progress.performing or self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fail) then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_battle_to_cat, self)
	end

	return false
end

--- 고양이와의 전투 시작
function local_class:start_battle_to_cat()
	local cat = get_character('present_cat')

	quest_marker_util.remove('battle_cat')

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ waypoints = field:GetMarker('player_stand').position, speed = 5.5, run = true })

	local center = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(user_party.Leader.Position, cat.Position, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(center, 1)

	screen_util.show_boss_title('fox_drive_out_cat_14_1', 'fox_drive_out_cat_14_2', 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(cat))

	for i =1, 4 do

function local_class:rat_hit_cat(rat, move_pos)
