	rat:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	rat:RemoveAnimation()
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(rat, { waypoints = move_pos, speed = 4.5, run = true })

	character_util.look_at(rat, cat)

	rat:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	rat:SetAnimation('victory_extra', true)
end

function local_class:fail_process()
	local cat = get_character('present_cat')

	-- 고양이 배틀액션을 전부 제거해주고 혹시 모르니 무적까지 걸어놔줌.
	cat.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()
	cat.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	-- 닫아놨던 배틀게이트 오픈
	for i =1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(cat.Name .. '_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	-- 넣어뒀던 피격음 해제
	if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.ManualCharacterDamagedBehaviour) then
		user_party.Leader.DamagedBehaviour.DamagedSfxHandleName = '01_hit_npc_01'
	end

	-- 고양이가 NPCInteractable이 달리면 자꾸 바운드가 2배씩 커져서 수동으로 NPC로 바꿔줌
	cat.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0;
	cat.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController();
	cat.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create();
	cat.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance;
	cat.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance;
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent.Create(cat,
			CS.Oak.CharacterConvertType.NPC, CS.Oak.CharacterConvertType.Enemy));

	-- 고양이가 플레이어를 바라보며 으르렁거림
	character_util.look_at(cat, user_party.Leader)
	cat:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	cat:SetAnimation('angry', true)

	character_util.stop(cat)
	character_util.look_at(cat, user_party.Leader)

	user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead', keep_anim = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drown_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_cat_hiss_01'})
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	-- 바위 부활시켜줌.
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local cat_rock = get_field_object('cat_battle_rock_' .. i)
		if cat_rock ~= nil then
			cat_rock.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
	end

	-- 고양이를 원래대로 감시병으로 만들어주고 피를 꽉 채워준다.
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = cat
	heal_info.target = cat
	heal_info.heal = cat.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	coroutine.yield()

	self:cat_battle_wait_setting()

	-- 고양이 무적 걸어준거 해제
	cat.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = false

	-- 원래 파티멤버들을 붙여준다.
	for _, member in ipairs(self.reserved_party_members) do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party)
	end
	self.reserved_party_members = {}

	party_util.position_party(field:GetMarker('present_cat_reset').position, 'up')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')
end

-- 퀘스트 요청
function local_class:request_help()
	local cat = get_character('present_cat')
	local rat1 = get_character('move_rat_1')
	local rat2 = get_character('move_rat_2')
	local rat3 = get_character('move_rat_3')

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(rat1)
	party_util.align_to_target(rat1, 'right')

	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		-- 아, 그래서 누가 할건데?
		rat1:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		character_util.normal_double_jump(rat1, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rat1, { key = 'fox_drive_out_cat_1', skip = true })

		-- 히익! 난 못해!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })
		rat2:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		rat2:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rat2, { key = 'fox_drive_out_cat_2', skip = true })
		rat2:RemoveAnimation()

		-- 나… 난 요새 지병이 있어서…
		rat3:SetEmotion('tired', true)
		rat3:SetAnimation('question', false)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rat3, { key = 'fox_drive_out_cat_3', skip = true })
		rat3:RemoveAnimation()

		-- 어떻게 하겠다는 쥐가 한마리도 없냐?
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02' })
		rat1:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rat1, { key = 'fox_drive_out_cat_4', skip = true })

		-- 무슨 일이야?
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'fox_drive_out_cat_5' } }, 'release')

		-- 저기 위쪽에 고양이 보이지?
		character_util.look_at(rat1, user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rat1, { key = 'fox_drive_out_cat_6', skip = true })

		rat1.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')

		camera_util.move_async(cat.Position, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		-- 50년 전인가 어떤 멍청한 쥐가 굴을 고양이한테 들켰다지 뭐야?
		character_util.look_at(rat1, user_party.Leader)
		rat1:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		rat1:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.normal_double_jump(rat1, true)

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()
	local kid_pack = self.get_kid_pack()
	local mom_pack = self.get_mom_pack()
	local dad_pack = self.get_dad_pack()

	self:setting_family_position()

	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mom, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(dad, 'left')

	command_util.execute_holdup(dad, dad_pack, dad.Position)

-- 가족들의 위치를 세팅
function local_class:setting_family_position()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()
	local kid_pack = self.get_kid_pack()

	kid.Position = vector(-50, 0, 36)
	mom.Position = vector(-51, 0, 36)
	dad.Position = vector(-49, 0, 36)

	kid_pack.Position = vector(-49, 0, 35)
	kid_pack.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local kid = self.get_kid()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(kid.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		kid.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local mom = self.get_mom()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(mom.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		mom.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local dad = self.get_dad()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(dad.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		dad.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.kid_pack_damaged_behaviour = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.is_family_hide then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
			return self:on_interact_event(e)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
			return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
			return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
			return self:on_hold_up_event(e)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
			return self:on_throw_event(e)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, mom) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dad) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.finish then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_parent_finish, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_kid, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		local kid = self.get_kid()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.escort_start_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pre_event, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.escort_destination_zone_name then
				self.is_enter_destination_zone = true
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.escort_fail_zone_name then
				self:user_throw_object()
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, kid) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.kidding_kid_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kidding_tao, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.throw_rock_kid_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_tao, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.escort_destination_zone_name then
				self.is_enter_destination_zone = false
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) then
		local kid_pack = self.get_kid_pack()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_pack) then
			-- 스피드 다운 디버프
			buff_manager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent', 40, false, false)
			kid_pack.DamagedBehaviour = self.kid_pack_damaged_behaviour

			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.pick_cargo then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_gate, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	local kid_pack = self.get_kid_pack()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_pack) then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.move_to_gate then
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent')
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_enum.finish then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.pick_cargo

				-- 리셋
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.failed_event, self)
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'fox_stage_night'  then
		self:hide_family()
		return true
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'fox_stage_day' then
		self:show_family()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:hide_family()
	self.is_family_hide = true

	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()

	kid.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	mom.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	dad.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:show_family()
	self.is_family_hide = false

	self:setting_family_position()
end

-- 이벤트 존에 들어왔을 때, 가족들의 대화
function local_class:pre_event()
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.begin

	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()

	-- 거기선 잘 적응해야 할텐데…….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_1' })

	-- 엄마/아빠에게 말을 걸 수 있게 된다.
	mom.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	dad.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle
end

-- 엄마/아빠 한테 인터랙트 시
function local_class:request()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()
	local kid_pack = self.get_kid_pack()
	local mom_pack = self.get_mom_pack()
	local dad_pack = self.get_dad_pack()

	party_util.align_party(dad, 'right', 1)

	-- 아이고, 안녕하세요. 기사 나으리!
	character_util.look_at(dad, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dad, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 몸이 약한 아들을 위해 요양차 이 곳에 왔는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dad, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_2', skip = true })

	-- 아이들의 괴롭힘이 너무 심해서… 몸은 커녕 마음까지 병들고 말았어요.
	character_util.look_at(dad, kid)
	character_util.set_emotion(mom, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_3', skip = true })

	-- 그래서 다시 셴 시로 돌아가려고  합니다. 혹시 이사를 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?
	character_util.look_at(dad, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dad, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_4', skip = true })

	-- 사례는 꼭 할게요. 부탁이에요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_5', skip = true })

	-- 예 / 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'fox_escort_mover_5_1', 'mercy' }, { 'fox_escort_mover_5_2', 'brutal' } })
	if choose_result == 2 then
		-- 아니오
		-- 마침 딱이라 생각했는데… 아쉽네요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_6', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(mom)
		return
	end

	-- 감사합니다. 아이들이 방해할수 있으니… 조심하세요.
	character_util.set_emotion(mom, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, { key = 'fox_escort_mover_7', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(mom)

	-- 주인공이 바로 장독대를 들고 시작.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, { vector(-48, 0, 36), vector(-48, 0, 35) }, 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:set_pack_holdable(kid_pack)
	command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader, kid_pack, user_party.Leader.Position)

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.pick_cargo

	mom.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	dad.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
end

-- 짐을 들고 가기 시작
function local_class:move_to_gate()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local mom = self.get_mom()
	local dad = self.get_dad()

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.move_to_gate
	self.controller:enabled_disrupter()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 아이와 가족이 먼저 이동하면 아이는 이동하는 내내 벌벌 떨고 있다.
	character_util.shake(kid, 0.02, 9999)

	-- 가족 이동
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, dad, { vector(-32, 0, 36), vector(-32, 0, 58), vector(-33, 0, 58), vector(-33, 0, 72) }, 2.5, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, kid, { vector(-49, 0, 36), vector(-32, 0, 36), vector(-32, 0, 58), vector(-33, 0, 58), vector(-33, 0, 71) }, 2.5, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, mom, { vector(-33, 0, 36), vector(-33, 0, 58), vector(-34, 0, 58), vector(-34, 0, 72) }, 2.5, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	})

	character_util.stop_shake(kid)

	-- 가족과 플레이어가 목적지 근처에 왔다면(escort_destination)
	while not self.is_enter_destination_zone do
		if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.move_to_gate then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return_func(self.ending, self)
end

-- 동네 아이들이 지나가는 타오를 놀림
function local_class:kidding_tao()
	local kidding_kid_1 = self.get_kidding_kid(1)
	local kidding_kid_2 = self.get_kidding_kid(2)
	local kidding_kid_3 = self.get_kidding_kid(3)
	local kidding_kid_list = {
		kidding_kid_1,
		kidding_kid_2,
		kidding_kid_3
	}
	local kid = self.get_kid()

	local is_looking_tao = true
	local looking_tao = function(fo)
		while is_looking_tao do
			character_util.look_at(fo, kid)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end

-- 돌을 던지는 루틴
function local_class:throw_rock_routine(fo, position, delay)
	local req_id = self.controller.disrupter_req_id

	while req_id == self.controller.disrupter_req_id do
		yield_return_func(self.throw_rock_to_position, self, fo, position, 1, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

-- 돌 던지는 로직
function local_class:throw_rock_to_position(fo, position, height, duration)
	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.rock_item_id, notforinven = true, pos = fo.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })
	local is_rock_flying = true
	local rock_crash_check = function()
		local kid = self.get_kid()
		local target_list = {
			user_party.Leader,
			kid
		}

		while is_rock_flying and #target_list > 0 do
			-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
			for i = #target_list, 1, -1 do
				local target = target_list[i]
				local distance = (vector_util.get_x0z(rock.Position, 0) - (target.Position)).magnitude

				if distance <= 0.4 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
					self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
					character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

					if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, user_party.Leader) then
						self:user_throw_object()
					end
					table.remove(target_list, i)
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local start_position = rock.Position
	local end_position = position
	local time_passed = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(rock_crash_check))
	while time_passed < duration do
		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * (time_passed / duration)) * height
		rock.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, (time_passed / duration))
		rock.Position = rock.Position + vector(0, y, 0)

		if time_passed >= 0.5 then
			character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', play_pos = position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	rock.Position = end_position
	is_rock_flying = false

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

-- 돌 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target, position, callback, ...)
	position = lua_helper.get_or_default(position, target.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = thrower, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.rock_item_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), target = position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', play_pos = position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
	local distance = (rock.Position - target.Position).magnitude
	if distance < 0.5 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()

	if callback ~= nil then
		local args = { ... }
		yield_return_func(callback, table.unpack(args))
	end
end

-- 짐을 들고 있을때는 짐은 점프되지 않아서, 직접 y축 바꾸는걸로 해결
function local_class:jump(fo, height, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * (time_passed / duration)) * height
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position)
end

function local_class:set_pack_holdable(fo)

	fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

end

function local_class:user_throw_object()
	local current_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		local target = current_state.HoldTarget

	end
end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.controller.hunjang_starpiece_name) then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
			-- 훈장 이벤트 지역 진입
			if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.hunjang_enter_name and not self.on_hunjang then
				if e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.hunjang_checker, self))
					return true
				elseif e.FieldObject == self.get_mouse_knight() then
					self.on_hunjang_fail = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunjang_cat_fail, self))
					return true
				end
			end

			if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.hunjang_exit_name and e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader then
				if e.FieldObject == self.get_mouse_knight() then
					self.on_hunjang_fail = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunjang_cat_fail, self))
					return true
				end
				if self.on_hunjang then
					self.on_hunjang = false
					self:debuff_off()
					return true
				end
				if not self.on_hunjang_first then
					self.on_hunjang_first = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.hunjang_intro, self))
					return true
				end
			end
			-- 훈장 이벤트 중 지정 구역을 벗어남
			if e.Zone.Name == self.hunjang_outer_name and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and self.on_hunjang and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
				self.on_hunjang_fail = true
				self.is_hunjang_end = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.hunjang_fail, self, 1))
				return true
			end
			-- 훈장의 설교 구간에 진입함
			if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.hunjang_point_name and e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader and
					self.on_hunjang and not self.is_hunjang_end and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_mouse_knight(), user_party.Leader) then
					self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.hunjang_speaking, self))
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.on_hunjang then
			-- 훈장 설교중 공격 및 스킬 사용함
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action2TouchDown or e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
				self.on_hunjang_fail = true
				self.is_hunjang_end = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.hunjang_fail, self, 4))
				return true
			end
			-- 달리면 실패
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
				self.on_hunjang_fail = true
				self.is_hunjang_end = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.hunjang_fail, self, 2))
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if e.Params[0] == 'change_end' then
				self.change_end = true
				self.on_change = false
				return true
			elseif e.Params[0] == 'change_start' then
				self.on_change = true
				return true
			elseif e.Params[0] == 'transformation_touch_start' then
				self.cat_wait = true
				return true
			elseif e.Params[0] == 'transformation_touch_end' then
				self.cat_wait = false
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:hunjang_speaking()
	local req_cnt = self.req_cnt

	local hunjang_block = field:GetMarker(self.hunjang_block_name).position
	character_util.move_to_async(self.hunjang, hunjang_block, 0.75, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.hunjang, 'right')

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 0.5 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.on_hunjang_fail then
			self.on_hunjang_speaking = false
			return
		end

		if req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.on_hunjang_speaking = true

	-- 대사
	local index = 1
	while index <= 5 do
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunjang,
				{key = self.hunjang_talk_name .. index, skip = false })
		if self.on_hunjang_fail then
			self.on_hunjang_speaking = false
			return
		end

		if req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then
			return
		end
		index = index + 1
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then
		return
	end

	self.on_hunjang_speaking = false
	self.is_hunjang_end = true

	character_util.move_to_async(self.hunjang, self.hunjang_initial_pos, 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.hunjang, 'down')
end

function local_class:debuff_on()
	-- 달리기, 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
	--슬로우 디버프
	buff_manager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, 'speed_down_persistent', 50, false, false)

end

function local_class:debuff_off()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	--디버프 해제
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, 'speed_down_persistent')
end

function local_class:hunjang_intro()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, self.get_mouse_knight()) then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunjang_cat_fail, self))

function local_class:hunjang_checker()
	self.on_hunjang = true
	local on_cat = false

	self:debuff_on()
	local target_dir = vector_util.to_direction( self.hunjang.Position - user_party_leader.Position)
	while true do
		-- 스타피스 이벤트 종료
		if not self.on_hunjang then
			self:debuff_off()
			break
		end

		-- 훈장이 말할 때 다른데 보면 실패
		if self.on_hunjang_speaking and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_mouse_knight(), user_party.Leader) then
			target_dir = vector_util.to_direction( self.hunjang.Position - user_party_leader.Position)
			if target_dir ~= user_party_leader.Direction and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
				self.on_hunjang_fail = true
				self.is_hunjang_end = false
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.hunjang)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.hunjang_fail, self, 3))
				self.on_hunjang_speaking = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- 플레이어가 쥐로 변신했을 시
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_mouse_knight(), user_party.Leader) and not on_cat and not self.on_hunjang_fail then
			on_cat = true
			self.on_hunjang_fail = true
			self.is_hunjang_end = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunjang_cat_fail, self))
			break
		end

		-- 스타피스 획득시 이벤트 종료
		if stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.controller.hunjang_starpiece_name) then
			self.on_hunjang = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunjang_end, self))
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	party_util.reset_controllers()

function local_class:hunjang_cat_fail()

	--페이드아웃
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mouse)
	self.change_end = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(mouse, { 'change_human_party' }))
	while not self.change_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.set_position(cat, cat_pos)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.05, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, 'right', 0.5, 0.5)

	self.on_hunjang_fail = false
	self:debuff_off()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'transformation_button_enabled' }))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:hunjang_end()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	self:debuff_off()
	character_util.set_direction(self.hunjang, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hunjang, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
	self.hunjang.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.hunjang.Interactable.Talk = self.hunjang_talk_name .. 5

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:hunjang_fail(fail_type)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local hunjang_start = field:GetMarker(self.hunjang_start_name).position

	self.on_hunjang_speaking = false
	character_util.stop(self.hunjang)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.hunjang)

	--훈장 달려와서 마구 때린다
	party_util.look_at(self.hunjang)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 0.3, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
	end

	local hit_pos
	if self.hunjang.Position.x < user_party.Leader.Position.x then
		hit_pos = -1
	else
		hit_pos = 1
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.hunjang, 0.3, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.hunjang, user_party_leader.Position + vector(hit_pos, 0,0), nil, nil, true, true)

	target_dir = vector_util.to_direction( user_party_leader.Position - self.hunjang.Position)
	self.hunjang.Direction = target_dir

	party_util.look_at(self.hunjang)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hunjang, {name = "attack", sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01'}, {name = "mad"})

	self.damage_loop = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damage_effect, self, user_party_leader))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "prostrate", loop = false}, {name = "damaged"})
	if fail_type == 1 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunjang, {key = self.hunjang_talk_fail_name .. 1, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	elseif fail_type == 2 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunjang, {key = self.hunjang_talk_fail_name .. 2, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	elseif fail_type == 3 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunjang, {key = self.hunjang_talk_fail_name .. 3, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunjang, {key = self.hunjang_talk_fail_name .. 4, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	--페이드아웃
	self.on_hunjang = false
	self.damage_loop = false
	--처음 위치로 돌아간다
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.Position = hunjang_start + self.party_pos[i + 1]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
	end
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	self.hunjang.Position =  self.hunjang_initial_pos
	character_util.set_direction(self.hunjang, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.hunjang)
	--페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	self.on_hunjang_fail = false
	self:debuff_off()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:damage_effect(target)
	while self.damage_loop do
		wait_for_sec(0.26)
		if self.damage_loop == false then break end
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.15, 0.85, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.24)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FoxJumpingSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxJumping @
		Comment = 소녀랑 널뛰기 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	--미니 게임 이름
	self.mini_game_name = 'korean_seesaw'

	-- npc 이름
	self.jumping_girl_name = 'jumping_girl'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.jumping_gimmick_name = 'jumping'
	self.jumping_name = '[gimmick]jumping'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.jumping_girl_marker_name = 'jumping_girl_pos'
	self.jumping_party_marker_name = 'jumping_party_pos'

	-- 메인퀘스트의 노인과 함께인지
	self.with_old_man = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	local jumping_girl = get_character(self.jumping_girl_name)
	jumping_girl.Position = field:GetMarker(self.jumping_girl_marker_name).position
	jumping_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local jumping_gimmick = get_field_object(self.jumping_gimmick_name)
	local jumping = jumping_gimmick.transform:Find(self.jumping_name)
	jumping.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 11))

	self.with_old_man = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(60009).InnerProgress == 4 and true or false

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	local jumping_girl = get_character(self.jumping_girl_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(jumping_girl.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		jumping_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local jumping_girl = get_character(self.jumping_girl_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, jumping_girl) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_jumping_girl, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_mini_game, self, e.Success)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 널뛰기 소녀와 대화
function local_class:talk_jumping_girl()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local jumping_girl = get_character(self.jumping_girl_name)
	local old_man = get_character('old_man')

	jumping_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	if self.with_old_man then
		character_util.move_waypoint(old_man, jumping_girl.Position
				+ vector(0.7  * user_party.Count + 1.3, 0, 0),
				4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(jumping_girl, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 와아!!! 손님이다!! 손님!!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_1', skip = true })

	-- 사람들이 모두 사라져서  혼자 너무너무 심심했는데 나랑 놀자!!!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_2', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 선택
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 같이 놀아준다.
			{'fox_1_jumping_3', CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy},
			-- 외면한다.
			{'fox_1_jumping_4'}
		})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		jumping_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

		if self.with_old_man then
			local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(old_man, user_party, 0, 0, false)
			old_man:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

	-- 널뛰기 시작 전 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 파티원들 응원
	local party_anim = { 'clap', 'success', 'release' }
	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.jumping_party_marker_name).position
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].Position = marker + (i - 1) * unity_class.vector3.back
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = party_anim[i] })
	end

	if self.with_old_man then
		old_man.Position = marker + (user_party.Count - 1) * unity_class.vector3.back
		character_util.set_direction(old_man, 'left')
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.mini_game_name))
end

-- 미니게임이 끝난 후
function local_class:end_mini_game(success)
	local jumping_girl = get_character(self.jumping_girl_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local old_man = get_character('old_man')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(jumping_girl)
	character_util.spine_rotate(jumping_girl, 0, 0)
	jumping_girl.Position = field:GetMarker(self.jumping_girl_marker_name).position

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	party_util.position_party(jumping_girl.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 'left', 'linear')

	if self.with_old_man then
		character_util.set_position(old_man,
			user_party[user_party.Count - 1].Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(old_man, 'left')
	end

	camera_util.move(leader.Position, 0, { end_target = leader })
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.with_old_man then
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(old_man, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		old_man:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	if success then
		-- 성공 처리
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		-- 정말 고마워!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_6', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

		character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		-- 너무너무 즐거운 시간 이였어!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_6_1', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

		character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		-- 친구와 널뛰기를 꼭 한번 해 보고 싶었는데...
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_7', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

		character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		-- 이제 엄마아빠에게 가도 될거 같아.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_7_1', skip = true })

		-- 널뛰기 소녀 깜빡깜빡 거리며 사라짐
		for i = 0, 3 do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(jumping_girl, i % 2, 0.6)
			wait_for_sec(0.6)
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(jumping_girl, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1.3)

		character_util.set_active_state(jumping_girl, 'disabled')

		-- 스타피스 드랍
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.controller.star_piece_name)
		message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(star_piece.Position))
		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	else
		-- 실패 처리
		character_util.set_emotion(jumping_girl, { name = 'doyagao'})
		character_util.set_anim(jumping_girl, {name = 'cross_arm'})
		--너무 못하는데?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jumping_girl, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_4_1', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jumping_girl)

		jumping_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FoxKarvardAspirantPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = FoxLover @
		Comment = 퀘스트 완료 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = self.controller.quest_progress

	-- NPC
	self.son = nil
	self.mother = nil
	self.grandson = nil

	-- NPC 이름
	self.son_name = 'karvard_son'
	self.mother_name = 'karvard_mother'
	self.grandson_name = 'karvard_grandson'

	-- 카버드 진학 여부
	self.go_karvard = false

	-- 대화 여부
	self.is_talk = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.son = get_character(self.son_name)
	self.son.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.mother = get_character(self.mother_name)
	self.mother.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.grandson = get_character(self.grandson_name)
	self.grandson.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.grandson, 'enabled')

	-- 카버드에 진학하는 것을 선택한 경우
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		self.go_karvard = true

		character_util.set_anim(self.son, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.son, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 카버드 진학을 포기한 경우
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.son, { name = 'hurt' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.son, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.mother) then
		if self.go_karvard then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.mother, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_s3_6' })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.mother, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_s2_0' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.son) then
		if self.go_karvard then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.son, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_s1_27' })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.son, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_s1_19' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.grandson) then
		if not self.is_talk then
			self.is_talk = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_grandson, self))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.grandson, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_post_1' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.son ~= nil then
		self.son.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.son = nil
	end

	if self.mother ~= nil then
		self.mother.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.mother = nil
	end

	if self.grandson ~= nil then
		self.grandson.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.grandson = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

-- 소년의 손자와 대화하는 이벤트
function local_class:talk_with_grandson()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	party_util.align_party(self.grandson, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.set_anim(self.grandson, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.grandson, { name = 'smile' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.grandson, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_post_1', skip = true })

	if not self.go_karvard then
		character_util.set_anim(self.grandson, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.grandson)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.grandson, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_post_2', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.grandson, { name = 'question', loop = false })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.grandson, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_post_3', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.grandson)

		local wait_for_branch = true
		local selection = 0

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		local talk_branch_1 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("fox_karvard_aspirant_post_4"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		local talk_branch_2 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("fox_karvard_aspirant_post_5"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				selection = 1
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
		branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = self.grandson
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if selection == 1 then
			local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			character_util.set_anim(self.grandson, { name = 'clap' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.grandson, { name = 'doyagao' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.grandson, { key = 'fox_karvard_aspirant_post_6', skip = true })

			clap_sfx:FadeOut()

			character_util.remove_emotion(self.grandson)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's1_fly_1' and self.cnt == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_fly, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's1_fly_2' and self.cnt == 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_fly, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 's1_fly_3' and self.cnt == 4 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_fly, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle_1_start
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('old')
			for i = 1, 2 do
				command_util.execute_monster_notice(get_character('battle_1_' .. i), user_party.Leader, 'battle')
			end
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.garam, user_party)
			self.garam.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_1_start then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'old', self.garam)
			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.garam)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_go, self, 27))
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		return self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		--return self:on_throw_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.take_water then
		local is_hold_up = lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)
		local target = self:get_closest_watering_target()
		if is_hold_up and target ~= nil and self.watering_routine == nil then
			self.watering_routine = sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_water, self, target, random_util.get_random_int(1, 2))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_closest_watering_target()
	for _, target in ipairs(self.watering_people) do
		local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude
		if dist <= self.watering_radius then
			return target
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s1_npc1) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.enter then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.old_talk
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s1_people_event, self))
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.garam) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.enter
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.well_zone_enter, self))
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('old')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('old', 27, true, self.s1_npc1)
			self.garam.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garam_talk, self))
		end

	end

	--if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.magic_well) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.old_talk then
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.magic_well) and not self.is_get_water_bowl then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.take_water
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s1_well_interact_event, self))
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_obj) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exit_func, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.water_bowl) then
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			buff_manager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent', 40, false, false)
			character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.04, 9999)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.water_bowl) then
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent')
		character_util.stop_shake(user_party.Leader)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:give_water(target, num)
	quest_marker_util.remove(target.Name)

	-- 물을 줘야하는 주민들 주변에 상호작용 에어리어 이펙트를 안보이게함.
	for _, target in ipairs(self.watering_people) do
		self:hide_watering_area(target)
	end

	-- 속도 저하 버프랑 떠는거 해제
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent')
	character_util.stop_shake(user_party.Leader)

	party_util.align_party(target.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction), target.Direction)

	local held = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
	character_util.clear_holdup_state(user_party.Leader, held)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	character_util.move_to_async(held, user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction), 0.25)
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	target:Shake(0.05, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drinking_01')
	target:SetAnimation('eat', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(held.Position)
	held.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_magic_heal_01')
	target.SpineController:HealGreenPulse()

	local heal_fx = self.heal_effect_pool():Instantiate(target.Position)
	heal_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	target.SpineController:AddFadeColor(target.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 1, 0, 1), 1, 0)
	target.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(target.Name, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	heal_fx:Dispose()

	heal_fx = self.heal_effect_pool():Instantiate(target.Position)
	heal_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	target.SpineController:AddFadeColor(target.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 1, 0, 1), 1, 0)
	target.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(target.Name, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	heal_fx:Dispose()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	if num % 2 == 0 then
		character_util.mario_jump_async(target, 'left')

		-- 오오... 몸이 개운해!
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, {key='fox_s1_town_3'})
	else
		character_util.mario_jump_async(target, 'right')

		-- 정말 고마워요!
		character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, {key='fox_s1_town_4'})
	end

	user_party.Leader:RemoveEmotion()
	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 물 준 사람을 테이블에서 제거
	local idx = array_util.index_of(self.watering_people, target)
	table.remove(self.watering_people, idx)

	if table_util.get_size(self.watering_people) == 0 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('garam', 27, true, self.garam)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.garam)
		self.garam.Interactable.Talk = ''

		if self.garam.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.garam.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	else
		self.is_get_water_bowl = false
		self.magic_well.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	self.watering_routine = nil
end

function local_class:show_watering_area(target)
	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_circle_effect'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.watering_radius
	effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.AreaCircleEffect)):ClearAnimation()
	effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.AreaCircleEffect)):SetHeal()
	self.watering_effects[target] = effect
end

function local_class:hide_watering_area(target)
	if self.watering_effects[target] ~= nil then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.hide_process_routine, self, self.watering_effects[target]))
		self.watering_effects[target] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:hide_process_routine(effect)
	effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.AreaCircleEffect)):EndHeal()
	wait_for_sec(1)
	effect:Dispose()
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

			self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		end

	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
			if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' then
			local hunter = get_character('hunter')
			hunter.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local dir = {'ct','cb'}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local ghost = get_character('ghost'..i)
		if e.Zone.Name == 's10_ghost'..i and self.cnt_list[i] == 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_spell_01'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ghost, {key = 'fox_s10_ghost_'..i, skip = false, bubble_direction = dir[i%2]})
			self.cnt_list[i] = 1
		end
	end
	if e.Zone.Name == 's10_speech' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.speech then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_speech, self))
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, 'BATTLE_1') and
		self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
		quest_marker_util.remove('hunter')
	end

end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'tint_gird') then
		field:Tint('destroy_town', unity_color({0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 1}), 0)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo,{key = 'fox_s10_'..i, skip = true})
end

function local_class:hunter_talk()
	local hunter = get_character('hunter')
	local nari = get_character('nari')
	local to_past = get_field_object('to_past')

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	hunter.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('hunter')

	character_util.stop_shake(hunter)

	party_util.align_party(hunter.Position + vector(1,0,0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 이런 곳에 여행자라니...
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hunter)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01'})
	character_util.mario_jump_async(hunter, 'right', 0.3, 0.5)
	self:says(hunter,'idle', 'surprise',1)

	-- 이 곳은 위험하오... 자네들도 빨리 돌아가는 것이 좋을 것이오.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hunter, {name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'scared', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hunter, {key = 'fox_s10_2', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(hunter)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'fox_s10_talk_branch_0_0', 'intellect'},{'fox_s10_talk_branch_0_1', 'mercy'}})

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader,
			{ name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' },{ name = 'attack', loop = true })
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 오래 전, 호랑이가 마을을 습격해서 살아남은 사람이 하나도 없다더군.
	self:says(hunter,'bomb_idle', 'scared',3)

	-- 원래 호랑이란게 영물이라 사람을 잘 공격하질 않는데, 이 마을은 무슨 악운이 들었는지...
	self:says(hunter,'idle', 'scared',4)

	-- 나는 이 곳에서 어서 벗어나야겠소.
	self:says(hunter,'nod', 'scared',5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_jump_01'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hunter)
	character_util.remove_anim(hunter)

	character_util.move_waypoint(hunter,
			{vector(hunter.Position.x, 0, -2.5),vector(-20, 0, -2.5)},
			7, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이 근처 호랑이라면 분명... 그런짓을 할 리가 없는데...
	self:says(nari, 'cross_arm', 'tired', '6_0')

	-- 뭔가 잘못된거야...
	self:says(nari, 'cross_arm', 'tired', 7)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--무슨 일이 있었는 지는 모르겠지만..
	self:says(nari, 'cross_arm', 'tired', 9)

	--뭘 해야 할지는 알고 있지?
	self:says(nari, 'nod', 'smile', 10)

	--자! 시작해 볼까!
	character_util.set_anim(nari, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(nari, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(nari, { key = 'fox_s10_11', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nari)

	character_util.set_active_state(hunter, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hunter)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(nari, user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 7)

	self.controller:nari_portal()

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted, 2)

	field:RemoveTint('destroy_town', 0)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('past_start_pos').position
	camera_util.move(marker, 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/fox/audio:bgm_fox_sad', state = 'field', mix = 0 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.controller:exit_portal(marker, false, 'arc')

	self:to_past()
end

function local_class:crowd_cheer(line_num)
	local old = get_character('bad_old')

	local bubble_pos = {
		vector(-300, 100),
		vector(-200, 150),
		vector(-200, 150)
	}
	if line_num == 1 then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.5, 999)
	else
		stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.3)
	end
	for i = 1, 12 do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1,2)
		local anim_table = {'cast2', 'get'}
		local town = get_character('town'..i)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(town,
				{ name = anim_table[rand], loop = true },{ name = 'attack', loop = true })
		if rand == 2 then
			character_util.normal_jump(town)
		end
	end
	-- 우와아아아아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(old,
			{ key = 'fox_s10_crowd_'..line_num, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			  scale = 1.2, screen_pos = bubble_pos[line_num] })
	stage_camera:CancelShake()
	for i = 1, 12 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_character('town'..i))
	end
end

	character_util.set_direction(self.tiger_guards[2], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.tiger_guards[3], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.tiger_guards[4], 'left')

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local town = get_character('town'..i)
		if i == 7 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(town, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
			town.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_s10_town_talk_1'

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(town, {name = 'victory_extra'}, {name = 'smile'})
			town.Interactable.Talk = 'fox_s10_town_talk_2'

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.town_go1, self, town))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('s10')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/fox/preload:bgm_fox_main', state = 'field', mix = 2})

	-- 대감과 대감호위 세팅
	local daegam_pos = field:GetMarker('daegam_default_pos').position
	local guard1 = get_character('old_guard_1')
	local guard2 = get_character('old_guard_2')
	local guard3 = get_character('old_guard_3')
	local guard4 = get_character('old_guard_4')
	local guard5 = get_character('old_guard_5')

	character_util.set_direction(old, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(old, daegam_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(old)

	character_util.set_direction(guard1, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(guard1, daegam_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 1))

	character_util.set_direction(guard2, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(guard2, daegam_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -1))

	character_util.set_direction(guard3, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(guard4, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(guard5, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(guard3, daegam_pos + vector(-2, 0, -5.5))
	character_util.set_position(guard5, daegam_pos + vector(-1, 0, -5.5))
	character_util.set_position(guard4, daegam_pos + vector(0, 0, -5.5))

	--- 다음 섹션으로 진행
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:town_go1(target)

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('FoxMainSection11')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = FoxMain @
		Comment = 인간 형태 호랑이를 발견. 뒤쫓는다. @
		Index = 10 @
		NextSections = 11 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'fox_1_3'

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		old_talk = 1,
		see_tiger_man = 2,
		talk_tiger_mam = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.tiger_talk_over = false
	self.tiger_first_back = false

	self.is_now_tiger_bullying_1 = false
	self.is_now_tiger_bullying_2 = false

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	local old = get_character('bad_old')
	local tiger_man = get_character('tiger_man')

	character_util.set_direction(tiger_man, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(tiger_man, vector(77, 0, -70.5))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tiger_man)

	if old.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		old.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.citizen_hit_tiger, self, i, 0.5))
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('s11', 27, true, old)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tiger_jump1, self, tiger_man))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('tiger_man'), self.cs_controller)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local old = get_character('bad_old')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, old) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.old_talk
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_talk, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 's11_see_tiger_back' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.old_talk then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_tiger_back, self))
			return true

		end
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('tiger_man')) and
		self.current_progress == self.event_progress.see_tiger_man then
		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_tiger, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
